                    <h3>I. សិទ្ធិអតិថិជន</h3>
                    <p>នៅពេលស្វែងរកការព្យាបាលអតិថិជនមានសិទ្ធិដូចខាងក្រោម៖</p>

                    <p><strong>១) សិទ្ធិស្មើភាព និងសិទ្ធិមិនរើសអើងគ្រប់បែបយ៉ាង</strong></p>
                    <ul>
                        <li>សិទ្ធិទទួលបានសេវាប្រកបដោយគុណភាពទៅតាមស្តង់ដារជាតិ ដែលបានកំណត់ដោយមិនប្រកាន់ពូជសាសន៍ សញ្ជាតិ
                            ពណ៌សម្បុរ សាសនា ភាសា អាយុ ភេទ ស្ថានភាពគ្រួសារ ស្ថានភាពសេដ្ឋកិច្ច ស្ថានភាពសង្គម
                            និងនិន្នាការនយោបាយឡើយ ។</li>
                    </ul>

                    <p><strong>២) សិទ្ធិក្នុងការទទួលបានព័ត៌មាន និងការអប់រំសុខភាព</strong></p>
                    <ul>
                        <li>មានសិទ្ធិទទួលបានព័ត៌មានអំពីសេវាដែលមាន ម៉ោងពេលធ្វើការ ចរាចរអតិថិជន
                            និងតំលៃសេវាក៏ដូចជាការលើកលែងបង់ថ្លៃ ព្រមទាំងរបៀបរបបនៃការបង់ថ្លៃផងដែរ ។</li>
                        <li>សិទ្ធិក្នុងការស្នើសុំនូវឯកសារសង្ខេបអំពីរោគវិនិច្ឆ័យ ការថែទាំព្យាបាល
                            និងលទ្ធផលនៃការវិភាគអមវេជ្ជសាស្រ្ត នៅពេលចាកចេញពីមូលដ្ឋានសុខាភិបាល ។</li>
                        <li>សិទ្ធិទទួលបាននូវការអប់រំសុខភាព ជាពិសេសទាក់ទងទៅនឹងការការពារ និង ការលើកកម្ពស់សុខភាព ។</li>
                    </ul>

                    <p><strong>៣) សិទ្ធិ ការទទួលបានការថែទាំ និងព្យាបាលជំងឺ</strong></p>
                    <ul>
                        <li>សិទ្ធិក្នុងការទទួលបានការថែទាំព្យាបាលដែលសមស្របទៅតាមតម្រូវការសុខភាពរបស់គាត់ទាំងការការពារ
                            និងលើកកម្ពស់សុខភាពផងដែរ។
                            អតិថិជនមានសិទ្ធិទទួលបានការយកចិត្តទុកដាក់ជាពិសេសក្នុងករណីដែលត្រូវការសង្គ្រោះបន្ទាន់</li>
                        <li>មានសិទ្ធិក្នុងការទទួលបានការយកចិត្តទុកដាក់ដោយការគោរព
                            និងដោយភាពថ្លៃថ្នូរសមស្របទៅនឹងទំនៀមទម្លាប់ និងសីលធម៌ នៅអំឡុងពេលធ្វើរោគវិនិច្ឆ័យ និងពេលព្យាបាល
                            ។</li>
                    </ul>

                    <p><strong>៤) សិទ្ធិក្នុងការរក្សាភាពអាថ៌កំបាំង</strong></p>
                    <ul>
                        <li>មានសិទ្ធិទទួលបាននូវការរក្សាអាថ៌កំបាំងនូវរាល់ព័ត៌មានទាំងអស់របស់គាត់
                            ទាំងទាក់ទងនឹងស្ថានភាពសុខភាព រោគវិនិច្ឆ័យ ស្ថានភាពជំងឺ ការព្យាបាល
                            និងព័ត៌មានផ្ទាល់ខ្លួនដទៃទៀតសូម្បីតែកាលស្លាប់ក៏ដោយ ។</li>
                    </ul>

                    <p><strong>៥) សិទ្ធិ ក្នុងការទទួលបានភាពឯកជន</strong></p>
                    <ul>
                        <li>អតិថិជនដែលមកពិនិត្យសំរាកព្យាបាលនៅមូលដ្ឋានសុខាភិបាលមានសិទ្ធិទទួលបានភាពបិទបាំង
                            សមរម្យនៅមូលដ្ឋានសុខាភិបាលដែលគាត់ប្រើប្រាស់ជាពិសេសនៅពេលដែលអ្នកផ្តល់សេវាធ្វើការ
                            ពិនិត្យរាងកាយនិងនៅពេលព្យាបាល ។</li>
                    </ul>

                    <p><strong>៦) សិទ្ធិក្នុងការជ្រើសរើស និងការយល់ព្រម</strong></p>
                    <ul>
                        <li>អតិថិជនអាចមានសិទ្ធិក្នុងការជ្រើសរើស ឬផ្លាស់ប្តូរមូលដ្ឋានសុខាភិបាល គ្រូពេទ្យព្យាបាល
                            ឬអ្នកផ្តល់សេវាដទៃទៀតបាន ។
                            អតិថិជនដែលជាស្រ្តីភេទមានសិទ្ធិជ្រើសរើសអ្នកផ្តល់សេវាដែលជាស្រ្តីដូចគ្នាក្នុងកាលៈទេសៈសមស្រប ។
                        </li>
                        <li>អតិថិជនមានសិទ្ធិមិនព្រមទទួល ឬផ្អាកការព្យាបាល និងអន្តរាគមន៍វេជ្ជសាស្ត្រនានាបាន ។</li>
                    </ul>

                    <p><strong>៧) សិទ្ធិក្នុងការបញ្ចេញយោបល់ និង ការចូលរួម</strong></p>
                    <ul>
                        <li>អតិថិជនមានសិទ្ធិក្នុងការបញ្ចេញមតិយោបល់ទាក់ទងទៅនឹងសេវាថែទាំព្យាបាលដែលគេទទួលបានកន្លងមក</li>
                        <li>អតិថិជនមានសិទ្ធិក្នុងការចូលរួមរៀបចំផែនការ និងវាយតម្លៃសេវាសុខាភិបាល និងផ្តល់យោបល់អំពីគុណភាព
                            និងលក្ខណៈដែលសេវាបានផ្តល់កន្លងមក ។</li>
                    </ul>

                    <h3>II. ការទទួលខុសត្រូវរបស់អ្នកជំងឺ</h3>
                    <ul>
                        <li>អតិថិជនមានភារកិច្ចទទួលខុសត្រូវក្នុងការអនុវត្តន៍រាល់វិធានការការពារ
                            និងលើកកំពស់សុខភាពដែលបានផ្តល់ដោយអ្នកផ្តល់សេវាសុខភាពដែលមានការអនុវត្តន៍របៀបរបបរស់នៅប្រកបដោយសុខភាពសម្រាប់ខ្លួនឯងផ្ទាល់
                            និងសម្រាប់អ្នកដែលរស់នៅក្នុងបន្ទប់ ។</li>
                        <li>អតិថិជន ឬអ្នកតំណាង
                            ទទួលខុសត្រូវក្នុងការសាកសួរទៅអ្នកផ្តល់សេវាសុខភាពដើម្បីបញ្ជាក់បំភ្លឺអោយបានយល់ច្បាស់នូវការណែនាំ
                            ឬព័ត៌មានផ្សេងៗដែលផ្តល់ដោយអ្នកផ្តល់សេវាសុខាភិបាល ។</li>
                        <li>អតិថិជនទទួលខុសត្រូវក្នុងការផ្តល់ព័ត៌មានដែលមានលក្ខណៈត្រឹមត្រូវ
                            និងពេញលេញទាក់ទងទៅនឹងស្ថានភាពសុខភាពរបស់ខ្លួនឯង និងត្រូវបង្ហាញនូវរាល់កំណត់ត្រា
                            ឬឯកសារទាំងឡាយដែលមានស្តីពីជំងឺរបស់ខ្លួននៅពេលទៅពិនិត្យព្យាបាលនៅមូលដ្ឋានសុខាភិបាល ។</li>
                        <li>អតិថិជនទទួលខុសត្រូវក្នុងការគោរពតាមការណែនាំ
                            និងការព្យាបាលរបស់អ្នកផ្តល់សេវាសុខាភិបាលហើយផ្តល់ព័ត៌មានទៅអោយអ្នកផ្តល់សេវាប្រសិនបើមិនអាចធ្វើតាមការណែនាំ
                            ឬការព្យាបាល ។</li>
                        <li>អតិថិជនត្រូវទទួលខុសត្រូវក្នុងការផ្តល់ព័ត៌មានពីកំរិតមានលទ្ធភាពបង់ប្រាក់ពិតប្រាកដទៅអោយអ្នកផ្តល់សេវាសុខាភិបាលដោយខ្លួនឯងផ្ទាល់ឬតាមរយៈបងប្អូនញាតិមិត្តឬតាមរយៈគណៈកម្មការដែលជាតំណាងរបស់ក្រុមទ្រទ្រង់សុខភាពភូមិ។
                        </li>
                    </ul>

                    <p style="margin-top: 30px;">នាងខ្ញុំ/ខ្ញុំបាទ បានដឹងអំពីសិទ្ធិ និងការទទួលខុសត្រូវរបស់អ្នកជំងឺ។</p>
                    <p>កាលបរិច្ឆេទ <span class="rights_date_val dots"></span></p>

        function normalizeStaticLabel(value) {
            return String(value || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
        }

        function isClinicalParenthetical(value) {
            var remainder = String(value || '')
                .replace(/(?:SpO2|SPO2|O₂|O2|GCS|I&O|I\/O|IPD|OPD|BP|mmHg|NSSF|ICD10|OI|ART|kg|cm)/gi, '')
                .replace(/[0-9០-៩\s%<>=+&/().,°-]/g, '');
            return remainder === '';
        }

        function removeDescriptiveEnglishFromKhmer(value) {
            var cleaned = normalizeStaticLabel(value);
            if (staticKhmerText[cleaned]) return staticKhmerText[cleaned];
            cleaned = cleaned.replace(/\(([^)]*[A-Za-z][^)]*)\)/g, function (full, inside) {
                return isClinicalParenthetical(inside) ? full : '';
            });
            cleaned = cleaned.replace(/\b(?:Section\s*\d+\s*:|Normal|Other|Left|Right|Cough|Tachypnea|Nasal\s+Flaring|Insufficient\s+Respiratory\s+Effort|Dyspnea|Stridor|Cyanosis|Crackle|Wheezing|Rhonchi\s+sound|Pleural\s+friction\s+rub|Suction|Facial\s+Pain|Maternit[eé]|Pouls|TA)\b/gi, '');
            cleaned = cleaned.replace(/\s+([៖:;,])/g, '$1').replace(/\s{2,}/g, ' ').trim();
            return cleaned;
        }

        function deriveStaticEnglish(value) {
            var source = normalizeStaticLabel(value);
            if (staticTextEnglish[source]) return staticTextEnglish[source];
            var parts = [];
            source.replace(/\(([^)]*[A-Za-z][^)]*)\)/g, function (full, inside) {
                parts.push(inside.trim());
                return full;
            });
            var leading = (source.match(/^((?:[IVX]+|[0-9០-៩]+)[.)]?\s*)/) || [])[1] || '';
            if (parts.length) return (leading + parts.join(': ')).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
            var latinOnly = source.replace(/[\u1780-\u17ff]+/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
            return latinOnly && /[A-Za-z]/.test(latinOnly) ? latinOnly : source;
        }

        function initializeStaticTranslationNode(node) {
            if (!node || node.nodeType !== Node.TEXT_NODE || node._staticKhmer !== undefined) return;
            var parent = node.parentElement;
            if (!parent || parent.closest('[data-key], [contenteditable="true"], script, style, .nursing-medication-source-cell, .nursing-med-time-cell')) return;
            var source = normalizeStaticLabel(node.nodeValue);
            if (!/[\u1780-\u17ff]/.test(source)) return;
            var leading = (node.nodeValue.match(/^\s*/) || [''])[0];
            var trailing = (node.nodeValue.match(/\s*$/) || [''])[0];
            node._staticKhmer = leading + removeDescriptiveEnglishFromKhmer(source) + trailing;
            node._staticEnglish = leading + deriveStaticEnglish(source) + trailing;
        }

        var staticFormTranslationsInitialized = false;

        function applyStaticFormLanguage(lang) {
            var root = document.querySelector('.container');
            if (!root) return;
            var walker = document.createTreeWalker(root, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);
            var node;
            while ((node = walker.nextNode())) {
                if (!node.parentElement.closest('button,a[href],[role="button"]')) initializeStaticTranslationNode(node);
                if (node._staticKhmer !== undefined) node.nodeValue = lang === 'english' ? node._staticEnglish : node._staticKhmer;
            }
            ['placeholder', 'title', 'aria-label'].forEach(function (attribute) {
                root.querySelectorAll('[' + attribute + ']').forEach(function (element) {
                    var originalKey = '_staticOriginal_' + attribute;
                    var englishKey = '_staticEnglish_' + attribute;
                    if (!staticFormTranslationsInitialized && element[originalKey] === undefined && /[\u1780-\u17ff]/.test(element.getAttribute(attribute) || '')) {
                        element[originalKey] = removeDescriptiveEnglishFromKhmer(element.getAttribute(attribute));
                        element[englishKey] = staticAttributeEnglish[normalizeStaticLabel(element.getAttribute(attribute))] || deriveStaticEnglish(element.getAttribute(attribute));
                    }
                    if (element[originalKey] !== undefined) element.setAttribute(attribute, lang === 'english' ? element[englishKey] : element[originalKey]);
                });
            });
            staticFormTranslationsInitialized = true;
        }

        // ADD RX DROPDOWN FUNCTIONS (FIXED VERSION)
        // ==========================================
        function toggleRxDropdown(id) {
            var dropdown = document.getElementById(id);
            if (dropdown) {
                var isShowing = dropdown.classList.toggle("show");

                // Temporarily disable the "overflow: hidden" on table wrappers 
                // so the dropdown menu doesn't get sliced off!
                var scrollContainer = dropdown.closest('.responsive-table-scroll');
                var table = dropdown.closest('.rx-new-table');
                var opdBlock = dropdown.closest('.opd-rx-compact');

                if (isShowing) {
                    if (scrollContainer) scrollContainer.style.overflow = 'visible';
                    if (table) table.style.overflow = 'visible';
                    if (opdBlock) opdBlock.style.overflow = 'visible';
                } else {
                    if (scrollContainer) scrollContainer.style.overflow = 'auto';
                    if (table) table.style.overflow = 'hidden';
                    if (opdBlock) opdBlock.style.overflow = 'hidden';
                }
            }
        }

        function closeRxDropdown(id) {
            var dropdown = document.getElementById(id);
            if (dropdown && dropdown.classList.contains("show")) {
                dropdown.classList.remove("show");

                // Restore wrapper overflows when closed
                var scrollContainer = dropdown.closest('.responsive-table-scroll');
                var table = dropdown.closest('.rx-new-table');
                var opdBlock = dropdown.closest('.opd-rx-compact');

                if (scrollContainer) scrollContainer.style.overflow = 'auto';
                if (table) table.style.overflow = 'hidden';
                if (opdBlock) opdBlock.style.overflow = 'hidden';
            }
        }

        window.onclick = function (event) {
            // Only close if the click happened OUTSIDE the dropdown container
            if (event.target && typeof event.target.closest === 'function') {
                if (!event.target.closest('.add-rx-dropdown')) {
                    var dropdowns = document.querySelectorAll(".add-rx-dropdown-content.show");
                    dropdowns.forEach(function (d) {
                        closeRxDropdown(d.id);
                    });
                }
            }
        };

        function isDedicatedProtocolMedication(med) {
            return med.rowType === 'protocolRow' || (!med.rowType &&
                (med.timingMode === 'protocol' || med.scheduleType === 'protocol') &&
                !med.protocolDose && !med.protocolRepeatValue && !med.protocolMaxDoses && !med.protocolStopAt);
        }

        function restoreSpecificProtocolMedication(row, med, fallbackStart) {
            var prefix = getMedicationRowPrefix(row);
            ['name', 'unit', 'd', 'note'].forEach(function (key) {
                var input = row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-' + key);
                if (input && med[key] !== undefined && med[key] !== null) input.value = String(med[key]);
            });
            var dose = row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-dose');
            if (dose) dose.value = med.doseAmount || med.protocolDose || '';
            var route = row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-route');
            if (route) populateMedicationRouteSelect(route, med.route || 'po');
            var list = row.querySelector('.med-protocol-interval-list');
            var button = row.querySelector('button[onclick*="addSpecificProtocolInterval"]');
            if (list && button) {
                list.replaceChildren();
                addSpecificProtocolInterval(button, med.effectiveAt || fallbackStart || '', true);
                parseMedicationIntervalItems(med.protocolIntervals).forEach(function (interval) {
                    addSpecificProtocolInterval(button, '', false);
                    var item = list.lastElementChild;
                    item.querySelector('.med-protocol-interval-value').value = interval.value;
                    item.querySelector('.med-protocol-interval-unit').value = interval.unit;
                });
            }
            handleMedicationProtocolFieldChange(row);
        }

        function clearMonitoringProtocolRows() {
            document.getElementById('mon_rx_protocol_tbody')?.replaceChildren();
            var container = document.getElementById('mon_protocol_rx_container');
            if (container) container.style.display = 'none';
        }

        function addSpecificProtocolInterval(btn, dateVal, isFirstOverride) {
            var list = btn.previousElementSibling;
            var item = document.createElement('div');
            item.className = 'med-protocol-interval-item';

            var count = list.querySelectorAll('.med-protocol-interval-item').length + 1;
            var isFirst = isFirstOverride || count === 1;

            if (isFirst) {
                if (!dateVal) {
                    var now = new Date();
                    now.setMinutes(now.getMinutes() - now.getTimezoneOffset());
                    dateVal = now.toISOString().slice(0, 16);
                }
                item.innerHTML = `
                    <span class="protocol-dose-label" style="font-size:11px; color:#0369a1; font-weight:bold;">លើកទី1:</span>
                    <input type="datetime-local" class="med-effective-at" value="${dateVal}" style="width: 140px; height: 24px; padding: 2px 4px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 4px; font-size:11px;" onchange="handleMedicationProtocolFieldChange(this); updateProtocolCalculatedTimes(this)">
                `;
            } else {
                item.innerHTML = `
                    <span class="protocol-dose-label" style="font-size:11px; color:#0369a1; font-weight:bold;">លើកទី${count}:</span>
                    <input type="number" min="0" step="0.1" class="med-protocol-interval-value" style="width: 65px; height: 24px; padding: 2px 4px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 4px; font-size:12px;" placeholder="-" oninput="handleMedicationProtocolFieldChange(this); updateProtocolCalculatedTimes(this)">
                    <select class="med-protocol-interval-unit" style="height: 24px; padding: 2px 4px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 4px; font-size:11px;" onchange="handleMedicationProtocolFieldChange(this); updateProtocolCalculatedTimes(this)">
                        <option value="minutes">នាទី</option>
                        <option value="hours">ម៉ោង</option>
                    </select>
                    <span class="protocol-calculated-time" style="color:#ea580c; font-weight:bold; margin-left:6px; font-size:12px;"></span>
                    <button type="button" data-protocol-remove style="color: #ef4444; background: transparent; border: 0; cursor: pointer; padding: 0 4px; font-size:16px;" onclick="var row=this.closest('tr'); this.parentElement.remove(); handleMedicationProtocolFieldChange(row);">×</button>
                `;
            }

            list.appendChild(item);
            refreshMedicationProtocolIntervalLanguage(btn.closest('tr'));
            handleMedicationProtocolFieldChange(item);
            updateProtocolCalculatedTimes(item);
        }

        window.updateProtocolCalculatedTimes = function (element) {
            if (!element) return;
            var row = element.closest('tr');
            if (!row) return;
            var items = row.querySelectorAll('.med-protocol-interval-item');
            if (!items.length) return;

            var baseTimeInput = items[0].querySelector('.med-effective-at');
            if (!baseTimeInput || !baseTimeInput.value) return;

            var currentTime = new Date(baseTimeInput.value);
            if (isNaN(currentTime.getTime())) return;

            for (var i = 1; i < items.length; i++) {
                var valInput = items[i].querySelector('.med-protocol-interval-value');
                var unitInput = items[i].querySelector('.med-protocol-interval-unit');
                var calcSpan = items[i].querySelector('.protocol-calculated-time');

                if (!valInput || !unitInput || !calcSpan) continue;

                var val = parseFloat(valInput.value);
                if (isNaN(val) || val <= 0) {
                    calcSpan.textContent = '';
                    continue;
                }

                if (unitInput.value === 'hours') {
                    currentTime = new Date(currentTime.getTime() + val * 3600000);
                } else {
                    currentTime = new Date(currentTime.getTime() + val * 60000);
                }

                var hh = String(currentTime.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
                var mm = String(currentTime.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
                var dd = String(currentTime.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
                var mo = String(currentTime.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');

                calcSpan.textContent = (currentLang === 'khmer' ? 'ម៉ោង ' : 'Time ') + hh + ':' + mm + ' (' + dd + '/' + mo + ')';
            }
        };

        function removeProtocolRxRow(btn, containerId) {
            var tr = btn.closest('tr');
            var tbody = tr.parentElement;
            if (tr) tr.remove();

            var rows = tbody.querySelectorAll('tr.protocol-main-row');
            rows.forEach(function (row, idx) {
                var indexCell = row.querySelector('td[class$="-index"]');
                if (indexCell) indexCell.textContent = idx + 1;
            });

            if (rows.length === 0) {
                document.getElementById(containerId).style.display = 'none';
            }
            syncNursingMedicationOrders();
        }

        window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            var rxBlock = document.getElementById('shared_rx_block');
            if (rxBlock) {
                var ipdContainer = document.getElementById('ipd_rx_container');
                if (ipdContainer) ipdContainer.appendChild(rxBlock);
            }

            var today = new Date();
            var dateInput = document.getElementById('web_date');
            if (dateInput) {
                var localYear = today.getFullYear();
                var localMonth = String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
                var localDay = String(today.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
                dateInput.value = localYear + '-' + localMonth + '-' + localDay;
            }
            var timeInput = document.getElementById('web_time');
            if (timeInput) {
                timeInput.value = today.toTimeString().slice(0, 5);
            }
            syncFields();

            var activeRole = String(window.emrSession?.user?.activeRole || window.sessionStorage?.getItem('borkeo-active-role') || '').toUpperCase();
            var requestedBedView = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('view') || '';
            if (activeRole === 'TRIAGE') requestedBedView = 'triage';
            var isDirectBedView = ['opd', 'medical', 'daily', 'nursing', 'discharge'].indexOf(requestedBedView) !== -1;
            if (isDirectBedView && activeRole !== 'TRIAGE') {
                switchPage(3);
                if (requestedBedView === 'opd') switchOpdTab('opd');
                else if (requestedBedView === 'nursing') switchOpdTab('nursing');
                else switchOpdTab('ipd');
            } else if (requestedBedView === 'triage' || activeRole === 'TRIAGE') {
                switchPage(2);
            } else {
                switchPage(1);
                switchSubTab('reg');
            }

            // Add 5 default rows to the OPD table
            for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
                addOpdRxRow(true);
            }

            // Main IPD treatment table starts empty: create five working medication rows.
            for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
                addRxRow(true);
            }
            // Daily monitoring already contains one starter row, so add four more.
            for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                addMonRxRow(true);
            }

            initializeMedicationPrescriptionRows();

            populateDropdowns();
            initializeNursingCarePages(); // <-- Added to initialize the drawing canvas
            window.addEventListener('resize', scheduleNursingChartRender);
            initializeDirectorApprovalBanner();
        });

                '<button type="button" id="btn-director-reject" style="background:#fff;color:#dc2626;border:1px solid #f87171;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:bold;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;">✖ បដិសេធ</button>' +
                '<a href="/requests" style="background:rgba(255,255,255,0.18);color:#fff;text-decoration:none;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:600;font-size:13px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3);">🔙 ត្រឡប់ទៅការស្នើសុំ</a>' +
            '</div>';

            var container = document.querySelector('.container') || document.body;
            container.insertBefore(banner, container.firstChild);

            banner.querySelector('#btn-director-approve').onclick = async function () {
                var btn = this;
                btn.disabled = true;
                btn.textContent = 'កំពុងរក្សាទុក…';
                try {
                    var token = window.emrSession?.csrfToken || '';
                    var res = await fetch('/api/requests/' + encodeURIComponent(requestId) + '/review', {
                        method: 'POST',
                        credentials: 'same-origin',
                        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRF-Token': token },
                        body: JSON.stringify({ approved: true, note: 'Approved by Director', revision: revision })
                    });
                    if (!res.ok) {
                        var err = await res.json().catch(function(){ return {}; });
                        throw new Error(err.error || 'Unable to approve.');
                    }
                    window.alert('បានអនុម័ត និងចុះហត្ថលេខាជោគជ័យ!');
                    window.location.href = '/requests';
                } catch (e) {
                    window.alert(e.message);
                    btn.disabled = false;
                    btn.textContent = '✔ អនុម័ត និងចុះហត្ថលេខា';
                }
            };

            banner.querySelector('#btn-director-reject').onclick = async function () {
                var note = window.prompt('សូមបញ្ចូលមូលហេតុនៃការបដិសេធ ៖');
                if (!note || !note.trim()) return;
                var btn = this;
                btn.disabled = true;
                try {
                    var token = window.emrSession?.csrfToken || '';
                    var res = await fetch('/api/requests/' + encodeURIComponent(requestId) + '/review', {
                        method: 'POST',
                        credentials: 'same-origin',
                        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRF-Token': token },
                        body: JSON.stringify({ approved: false, note: note.trim(), revision: revision })
                    });
                    if (!res.ok) {
                        var err = await res.json().catch(function(){ return {}; });
                        throw new Error(err.error || 'Unable to reject.');
                    }
                    window.alert('បានបដិសេធសំណើ!');
                    window.location.href = '/requests';
                } catch (e) {
                    window.alert(e.message);
                    btn.disabled = false;
                }
            };
        }

        function populateDropdowns() {
            // Handled dynamically by cambodia-address.js using official national administrative census data
        }

        function getPatientVitalRange(ageData) {
            var totalMonths = ageData && isFinite(ageData.totalMonths) ? ageData.totalMonths : null;
            if (totalMonths === null || totalMonths < 0) return VITAL_REFERENCE_RANGES[VITAL_REFERENCE_RANGES.length - 1];
            for (var i = 0; i < VITAL_REFERENCE_RANGES.length; i++) {
                if (totalMonths < VITAL_REFERENCE_RANGES[i].maxMonths) return VITAL_REFERENCE_RANGES[i];
            }
            return VITAL_REFERENCE_RANGES[VITAL_REFERENCE_RANGES.length - 1];
        }

        function assessVitalValue(fieldName, rawValue, ageData) {
            var value = nursingNumber(rawValue);
            var reference = getPatientVitalRange(ageData || getExactAge());
            var range = fieldName === 'spo2' ? [95, 100] : reference[fieldName];
            if (value === null) return { hasValue: false, abnormal: false, value: null, range: range || null };
            var abnormal = !range || value < range[0] || value > range[1];
            return { hasValue: true, abnormal: abnormal, value: value, range: range };
        }

        function assessBloodPressure(rawSystolic, rawDiastolic, ageData) {
            var systolic = nursingNumber(rawSystolic);
            var diastolic = nursingNumber(rawDiastolic);
            var reference = getPatientVitalRange(ageData || getExactAge());
            if (systolic === null || diastolic === null) {
                return { complete: false, abnormal: false, systolic: systolic, diastolic: diastolic, pulsePressure: null, reasons: [], systolicRange: reference.bpSys, diastolicRange: reference.bpDia || null };
            }

            var pulsePressure = systolic - diastolic;
            var reasons = [];
            if (systolic <= diastolic) reasons.push('Invalid systolic/diastolic order');
            if (systolic < reference.bpSys[0] || systolic > reference.bpSys[1]) reasons.push('Systolic BP outside age range');
            if (reference.bpDia && (diastolic < reference.bpDia[0] || diastolic > reference.bpDia[1])) reasons.push('Diastolic BP outside adult range');
            if (pulsePressure <= NURSING_BP_RULES.narrowPulsePressure) reasons.push('Narrow pulse pressure');
            if (pulsePressure >= NURSING_BP_RULES.widePulsePressure) reasons.push('Wide pulse pressure');

            return {
                complete: true,
                abnormal: reasons.length > 0,
                systolic: systolic,
                diastolic: diastolic,
                pulsePressure: pulsePressure,
                reasons: reasons,
                systolicRange: reference.bpSys,
                diastolicRange: reference.bpDia || null
            };
        }

        function applyVitalInputState(input, assessment) {
            if (!input) return;
            input.classList.remove('vital-normal', 'vital-abnormal');
            if (assessment && assessment.range) {
                input.title = (currentLang === 'khmer' ? 'កម្រិតតាមអាយុ៖ ' : 'Age range: ') + assessment.range[0] + '–' + assessment.range[1];
            }
            if (!assessment || (!assessment.hasValue && !assessment.complete)) return;
            input.classList.remove('vital-missing');
            input.classList.add(assessment.abnormal ? 'vital-abnormal' : 'vital-normal');
        }

        function applyVitalTextState(element, assessment) {
            if (!element) return;
            element.classList.remove('vital-normal', 'vital-abnormal');
            if (!assessment || (!assessment.hasValue && !assessment.complete)) return;
            element.classList.add(assessment.abnormal ? 'vital-abnormal' : 'vital-normal');
        }

        function updateTriageBpRequirementNote() {
            var ageData = getExactAge();
            var isOptional = ageData.totalMonths !== null && ageData.totalMonths < 36;
            var systolicInput = document.getElementById('p2_bp_sys');
            var diastolicInput = document.getElementById('p2_bp_dia');
            var bothBlank = (!systolicInput || !String(systolicInput.value).trim()) && (!diastolicInput || !String(diastolicInput.value).trim());
            var bpIsRequired = !isOptional || !bothBlank;
            var requiredStar = document.getElementById('triage_bp_required_star');
            if (requiredStar) requiredStar.hidden = !bpIsRequired;
            if (systolicInput) systolicInput.setAttribute('aria-required', bpIsRequired ? 'true' : 'false');
            if (diastolicInput) diastolicInput.setAttribute('aria-required', bpIsRequired ? 'true' : 'false');
            if (isOptional) {
                if (bothBlank) {
                    if (systolicInput) systolicInput.classList.remove('vital-missing');
                    if (diastolicInput) diastolicInput.classList.remove('vital-missing');
                }
            }
        }

        function evaluateTriageVitalStates() {
            var ageData = getExactAge();
            var fieldMap = {
                temp: 'p2_temp',
                pulse: 'p2_pulse',
                resp: 'p2_resp',
                spo2: 'p2_spo2'
            };

            Object.keys(fieldMap).forEach(function (fieldName) {
                var input = document.getElementById(fieldMap[fieldName]);
                var assessment = assessVitalValue(fieldName, input ? input.value : '', ageData);
                applyVitalInputState(input, assessment);
                var dashboardId = {
                    temp: 'dash_temp', pulse: 'dash_pulse', resp: 'dash_resp', spo2: 'dash_spo2'
                }[fieldName];
                applyVitalTextState(document.getElementById(dashboardId), assessment);
            });

            var systolicInput = document.getElementById('p2_bp_sys');
            var diastolicInput = document.getElementById('p2_bp_dia');
            var bpAssessment = assessBloodPressure(
                systolicInput ? systolicInput.value : '',
                diastolicInput ? diastolicInput.value : '',
                ageData
            );
            applyVitalInputState(systolicInput, bpAssessment);
            applyVitalInputState(diastolicInput, bpAssessment);
            var bpReference = getPatientVitalRange(ageData);
            if (systolicInput) systolicInput.title = (currentLang === 'khmer' ? 'កម្រិតលេខលើតាមអាយុ៖ ' : 'Age systolic range: ') + bpReference.bpSys[0] + '–' + bpReference.bpSys[1] + ' mmHg';
            if (diastolicInput && bpReference.bpDia) diastolicInput.title = (currentLang === 'khmer' ? 'កម្រិតលេខក្រោម៖ ' : 'Diastolic range: ') + bpReference.bpDia[0] + '–' + bpReference.bpDia[1] + ' mmHg';
            applyVitalTextState(document.getElementById('dash_bp'), bpAssessment);
            updateTriageBpRequirementNote();

            ['p2_weight', 'p2_height'].forEach(function (id) {
                var input = document.getElementById(id);
                if (input && String(input.value).trim() !== '' && nursingNumber(input.value) !== null) {
                    input.classList.remove('vital-missing');
                }
            });

            var message = document.getElementById('triage_vital_validation');
            if (message && !document.querySelector('#page2 input.vital-missing')) message.classList.remove('active');
        }

        function validateTriageVitalsForForm() {
            var requestedBedView = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('view') || '';
            if (['medical', 'daily', 'nursing', 'discharge'].indexOf(requestedBedView) !== -1) {
                return true;
            }
            var loadedPatient = window.getLoadedEmrPatient?.();
            if (loadedPatient && (String(loadedPatient.serviceMode || '').toLowerCase() === 'ipd' || loadedPatient.admissionStatus === 'admitted')) {
                return true;
            }
            var activeRole = String(window.emrSession?.user?.activeRole || '').toUpperCase();
            if (['DOCTOR', 'ADMIN', 'VICE_DIRECTOR', 'DIRECTOR', 'NURSE', 'MIDWIFE'].indexOf(activeRole) !== -1) {
                return true;
            }
            var ageData = getExactAge();
            var bpOptional = ageData.totalMonths !== null && ageData.totalMonths < 36;
            var requiredIds = ['p2_temp', 'p2_pulse', 'p2_resp', 'p2_spo2', 'p2_weight', 'p2_height'];
            var systolicInput = document.getElementById('p2_bp_sys');
            var diastolicInput = document.getElementById('p2_bp_dia');
            var systolicHasValue = !!(systolicInput && String(systolicInput.value).trim());
            var diastolicHasValue = !!(diastolicInput && String(diastolicInput.value).trim());

            if (!bpOptional || systolicHasValue || diastolicHasValue) {
                requiredIds.push('p2_bp_sys', 'p2_bp_dia');
            }

            var invalidInputs = [];
            requiredIds.forEach(function (id) {
                var input = document.getElementById(id);
                if (!input) return;
                var validNumber = String(input.value).trim() !== '' && nursingNumber(input.value) !== null;
                input.classList.toggle('vital-missing', !validNumber);
                if (!validNumber) invalidInputs.push(input);
            });

            var message = document.getElementById('triage_vital_validation');
            if (invalidInputs.length) {
                var language = dictionary[currentLang] || dictionary.khmer;
                var bpMissing = invalidInputs.some(function (input) {
                    return input.id === 'p2_bp_sys' || input.id === 'p2_bp_dia';
                });
                if (message) {
                    message.textContent = language.triage_vitals_required + (bpMissing && !bpOptional ? ' ' + language.triage_bp_required : '');
                    message.classList.add('active');
                }
                var triagePage = document.getElementById('page2');
                if (triagePage && !triagePage.classList.contains('active')) switchPage(2);
                setTimeout(function () {
                    invalidInputs[0].focus();
                    invalidInputs[0].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
                }, 0);
                return false;
            }

            requiredIds.forEach(function (id) {
                var input = document.getElementById(id);
                if (input) input.classList.remove('vital-missing');
            });
            if (message) message.classList.remove('active');
            return true;
        }

        function updateBreadcrumb(pageNumber) {
            var currentLink = document.getElementById('breadcrumb_current');
            if (!currentLink) return;

            var pageKeys = {
                1: 'tab_admission',
                2: 'tab_triage',
                3: 'tab_Form'
            };
            var pageKey = pageKeys[pageNumber];
            if (!pageKey) return;

            currentLink.setAttribute('href', '#page' + pageNumber);
            currentLink.setAttribute('data-page', String(pageNumber));
            currentLink.setAttribute('data-key', pageKey);
            currentLink.textContent = dictionary[currentLang] && dictionary[currentLang][pageKey]
                ? dictionary[currentLang][pageKey]
                : pageKey;
        }

        function openBreadcrumbPage(event) {
            event.preventDefault();
            var currentLink = event.currentTarget;
            var pageNumber = Number(currentLink.getAttribute('data-page'));
            if (![1, 2, 3].includes(pageNumber)) return false;

            if (!switchPage(pageNumber)) return false;
            var pageElement = document.getElementById('page' + pageNumber);
            if (pageElement) pageElement.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
            return false;
        }

        function validateCaregiverInfoForForm() {
            var activeRole = String(window.emrSession?.user?.activeRole || window.sessionStorage?.getItem('borkeo-active-role') || '').toUpperCase();
            var requestedBedView = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('view') || '';
            if (['medical', 'daily', 'nursing', 'discharge', 'triage'].indexOf(requestedBedView) !== -1) {
                return true;
            }
            var loadedPatient = window.getLoadedEmrPatient?.();
            if (loadedPatient && (String(loadedPatient.serviceMode || '').toLowerCase() === 'ipd' || loadedPatient.admissionStatus === 'admitted') && ['DOCTOR', 'NURSE', 'MIDWIFE'].indexOf(activeRole) !== -1) {
                return true;
            }

            var nameInput = document.getElementById('web_caregiver_name');
            var phoneInput = document.getElementById('web_caregiver_phone');
            var relationSelect = document.getElementById('web_caregiver_relation');
            var sexRadio = document.querySelector('input[name="web_caregiver_sex"]:checked');

            var nameVal = String(nameInput?.value || '').trim();
            var phoneVal = String(phoneInput?.value || '').trim();
            var relationVal = String(relationSelect?.value || '').trim();
            var sexVal = String(sexRadio?.value || '').trim();

            var missingFields = [];
            if (!nameVal) missingFields.push('ឈ្មោះអ្នកកំដរ');
            if (!phoneVal) missingFields.push('លេខទូរសព្ទ');
            if (!relationVal) missingFields.push('ទំនាក់ទំនង');
            if (!sexVal) missingFields.push('ភេទ');

            if (nameInput) nameInput.classList.toggle('field-missing', !nameVal);
            if (phoneInput) phoneInput.classList.toggle('field-missing', !phoneVal);
            if (relationSelect) relationSelect.classList.toggle('field-missing', !relationVal);

            if (missingFields.length > 0) {
                alert('សូមបំពេញព័ត៌មានអ្នកកំដរឱ្យបានគ្រប់ជ្រុងជ្រោយ (' + missingFields.join(', ') + ') មុនបន្ត!');
                if (!nameVal && nameInput) nameInput.focus();
                else if (!phoneVal && phoneInput) phoneInput.focus();
                else if (!relationVal && relationSelect) relationSelect.focus();
                return false;
            }

            if (phoneVal && typeof window.validateCambodianPhone === 'function') {
                var currentLang = document.documentElement.lang === 'en' ? 'en' : 'km';
                var check = window.validateCambodianPhone(phoneVal, currentLang);
                var phoneErrDiv = document.getElementById('web_caregiver_phone_error');
                if (!check.valid) {
                    if (phoneInput) phoneInput.classList.add('field-missing');
                    if (phoneErrDiv) {
                        phoneErrDiv.textContent = check.error;
                        phoneErrDiv.style.display = 'block';
                    }
                    if (phoneInput) phoneInput.focus();
                    alert(check.error);
                    return false;
                } else {
                    if (phoneInput) {
                        phoneInput.classList.remove('field-missing');
                        phoneInput.value = check.normalized;
                    }
                    if (phoneErrDiv) {
                        phoneErrDiv.textContent = '';
                        phoneErrDiv.style.display = 'none';
                    }
                }
            }
            return true;
        }

        function switchPage(pageNumber) {
            var activeRole = String(window.emrSession?.user?.activeRole || window.sessionStorage?.getItem('borkeo-active-role') || '').toUpperCase();
            if (activeRole === 'TRIAGE' && Number(pageNumber) !== 2) return false;
            if (Number(pageNumber) > 1 && document.getElementById('page1')?.classList.contains('active')) {
                if (typeof window.validateCaregiverInfo === 'function') {
                    var caregiverErr = window.validateCaregiverInfo();
                    if (caregiverErr) {
                        alert(caregiverErr);
                        return false;
                    }
                } else if (typeof validateCaregiverInfoForForm === 'function' && !validateCaregiverInfoForForm()) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
            if (pageNumber === 3 && !validateTriageVitalsForForm()) return false;
            var pageIds = ['page1', 'page2', 'page3'];
            pageIds.forEach(function (id) {
                var el = document.getElementById(id);
                if (el) el.classList.remove('active');
            });

            var stepIds = ['btn_page1', 'btn_page2', 'btn_page3'];
            stepIds.forEach(function (id) {
                var el = document.getElementById(id);
                if (el) el.classList.remove('active');
            });

            var pageEl = document.getElementById('page' + pageNumber);
            if (pageEl) pageEl.classList.add('active');

            var stepEl = document.getElementById('btn_page' + pageNumber);
            if (stepEl) stepEl.classList.add('active');
            if (pageNumber === 1 || pageNumber === 2) {
                if (typeof syncFields === 'function') syncFields();
            }
            if (pageNumber === 3) {
                if (typeof window.configureTreatmentWorkflow === 'function') {
                    window.configureTreatmentWorkflow();
                }
                scheduleNursingChartRender();
            }
            return true;
        }

        function switchSubTab(tabName) {
            var tabs = ['sub_reg', 'sub_rights', 'sub_agreement'];
            tabs.forEach(function (id) {
                var el = document.getElementById(id);
                if (el) el.classList.remove('active');
            });

            var btns = ['btn_sub_reg', 'btn_sub_rights', 'btn_sub_agreement'];
            btns.forEach(function (id) {
                var el = document.getElementById(id);
                if (el) el.classList.remove('active');
            });

            var targetMap = {
                'reg': { tab: 'sub_reg', btn: 'btn_sub_reg' },
                'rights': { tab: 'sub_rights', btn: 'btn_sub_rights' },
                'agreement': { tab: 'sub_agreement', btn: 'btn_sub_agreement' }
            };

            var target = targetMap[tabName];
            if (target) {
                var tabEl = document.getElementById(target.tab);
                if (tabEl) tabEl.classList.add('active');
                var btnEl = document.getElementById(target.btn);
                if (btnEl) btnEl.classList.add('active');
                if (tabName === 'rights' || tabName === 'agreement') {
                    syncRightsForm();
                }
            }
        }

        function switchOpdTab(tabName) {
            var tabs = ['sub_opd', 'sub_ipd', 'sub_nursing', 'emr-daily-view', 'emr-discharge-view'];
            tabs.forEach(function (id) {
                var el = document.getElementById(id);
                if (el) {
                    el.classList.remove('active');
                    el.style.display = '';
                }
            });

            var btns = ['btn_sub_opd', 'btn_sub_ipd', 'btn_sub_nursing'];
            btns.forEach(function (id) {
                var el = document.getElementById(id);
                if (el) el.classList.remove('active');
            });

            var rxBlock = document.getElementById('shared_rx_block');
            if (rxBlock) {
                if (tabName === 'ipd') rxBlock.removeAttribute('hidden');
                else rxBlock.setAttribute('hidden', '');
            }

            if (tabName === 'opd') {
                var subOpd = document.getElementById('sub_opd');
                if (subOpd) {
                    subOpd.classList.add('active');
                    subOpd.removeAttribute('hidden');
                    subOpd.style.display = '';
                }
                var btnOpd = document.getElementById('btn_sub_opd');
                if (btnOpd) btnOpd.classList.add('active');
            } else if (tabName === 'ipd') {
                var subIpd = document.getElementById('sub_ipd');
                if (subIpd) {
                    subIpd.classList.add('active');
                    subIpd.removeAttribute('hidden');
                    subIpd.style.display = '';
                }
                var btnIpd = document.getElementById('btn_sub_ipd');
                if (btnIpd) btnIpd.classList.add('active');

                var ipdContainer = document.getElementById('ipd_rx_container');
                if (ipdContainer && rxBlock) ipdContainer.appendChild(rxBlock);
                window.ensureFirstExamDateTime?.();
            } else if (tabName === 'nursing') {
                var subNursing = document.getElementById('sub_nursing');
                if (subNursing) {
                    subNursing.classList.add('active');
                    subNursing.removeAttribute('hidden');
                    subNursing.style.display = '';
                }
                var btnNursing = document.getElementById('btn_sub_nursing');
                if (btnNursing) btnNursing.classList.add('active');
                var nursingSelector = document.getElementById('nursing_process_selector');
                var formToSwitch = nursingSelector && nursingSelector.value ? nursingSelector.value : 'general';
                switchNursingForm(formToSwitch);
                scheduleNursingChartRender();
            }
        }

        // ==========================================
        // PARTOGRAPH TAB
        // ==========================================
        var partographLoadPromise = null;

        function setPartographEmbedStatus(message, isError) {
            var status = document.getElementById('partograph_embed_status');
            if (!status) return;
            status.textContent = message || '';
            status.style.color = isError ? '#b42318' : '#376078';
        }

        function decodePartographPayload() {
            var payloadNode = document.getElementById('partograph_payload');
            if (!payloadNode) throw new Error('Partograph payload is missing.');

            var encoded = payloadNode.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, '');
            if (!encoded) throw new Error('Partograph payload is empty.');

            var binary = window.atob(encoded);
            var bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
            for (var index = 0; index < binary.length; index += 1) {
                bytes[index] = binary.charCodeAt(index);
            }

            if (window.TextDecoder) {
                return new TextDecoder('utf-8').decode(bytes);
            }

            var escaped = '';
            for (var byteIndex = 0; byteIndex < bytes.length; byteIndex += 1) {
                escaped += '%' + bytes[byteIndex].toString(16).padStart(2, '0');
            }
            return decodeURIComponent(escaped);
        }

        function loadPartographFrame() {
            var frame = document.getElementById('partograph_frame');
            var loading = document.getElementById('partograph_loading');
            if (!frame) return Promise.reject(new Error('Partograph frame was not found.'));
            if (frame.dataset.ready === 'true') return Promise.resolve(frame);
            if (partographLoadPromise) return partographLoadPromise;

            frame.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'true');
            if (loading) loading.classList.remove('is-hidden');
            setPartographEmbedStatus('');

            partographLoadPromise = new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
                var html;
                try {
                    html = decodePartographPayload();
                } catch (error) {
                    partographLoadPromise = null;
                    if (loading) loading.classList.add('is-hidden');
                    frame.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'false');
                    setPartographEmbedStatus('មិនអាចបើក Partograph បាន។', true);
                    reject(error);
                    return;
                }

                var handleLoad = function () {
                    frame.contentDocument.querySelectorAll('[onclick*="print()"]').forEach(function (button) {
                        button.removeAttribute('onclick');
                        button.addEventListener('click',printPartograph);
                    });
                    frame.dataset.ready = 'true';
                    frame.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'false');
                    if (loading) loading.classList.add('is-hidden');
                    resolve(frame);
                };

                var handleError = function () {
                    partographLoadPromise = null;
                    frame.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'false');
                    if (loading) loading.classList.add('is-hidden');
                    setPartographEmbedStatus('មិនអាចបើក Partograph បាន។', true);
                    reject(new Error('Partograph frame failed to load.'));
                };

                frame.addEventListener('load', handleLoad, { once: true });
                frame.addEventListener('error', handleError, { once: true });
                frame.srcdoc = html;
            });

            return partographLoadPromise;
        }

        function getEmrFieldValue(id) {
            var field = document.getElementById(id);
            return field && typeof field.value === 'string' ? field.value.trim() : '';
        }

        function syncPartographPatientData(overwriteExisting) {
            return loadPartographFrame().then(function (frame) {
                var childDocument = frame.contentDocument;
                var childWindow = frame.contentWindow;
                if (!childDocument || !childWindow) throw new Error('Partograph document is unavailable.');

                var patientName = [getEmrFieldValue('web_last_name'), getEmrFieldValue('web_first_name')]
                    .filter(Boolean)
                    .join(' ');
                var recordNumber = getEmrFieldValue('web_health_id') || getEmrFieldValue('web_adm_no');
                var mappings = [
                    { selector: 'input[aria-label="ឈ្មោះ"]', value: patientName },
                    { selector: 'input[aria-label="លេខប័ណ្ណពេទ្យ"]', value: recordNumber },
                    { selector: 'input[aria-label="ថ្ងៃខែឆ្នាំចូលសម្រាក"]', value: getEmrFieldValue('web_date') },
                    { selector: 'input[aria-label="ម៉ោងចូលសម្រាក"]', value: getEmrFieldValue('web_time') }
                ];
                var updated = 0;

                mappings.forEach(function (mapping) {
                    if (!mapping.value) return;
                    var target = childDocument.querySelector(mapping.selector);
                    if (!target) return;
                    if (!overwriteExisting && target.value.trim()) return;
                    if (target.value === mapping.value) return;

                    target.value = mapping.value;
                    target.dispatchEvent(new childWindow.Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
                    target.dispatchEvent(new childWindow.Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
                    updated += 1;
                });

                if (overwriteExisting) {
                    setPartographEmbedStatus(updated
                        ? 'បានបញ្ចូលព័ត៌មានអ្នកជំងឺពី EMR រួចរាល់។'
                        : 'មិនមានព័ត៌មានថ្មីសម្រាប់បញ្ចូលទេ។');
                }
                return updated;
            }).catch(function (error) {
                setPartographEmbedStatus('មិនអាចបញ្ចូលព័ត៌មានអ្នកជំងឺបាន។', true);
                throw error;
            });
        }

        function printPartograph() {
            setPartographEmbedStatus('កំពុងរៀបចំសម្រាប់បោះពុម្ព…');
            loadPartographFrame().then(function (frame) {
                setPartographEmbedStatus('');
                return window.printEmrReport({sourceDocument:frame.contentDocument,selectors:['body'],title:'Partograph'});
            }).catch(function () {
                setPartographEmbedStatus('មិនអាចបោះពុម្ព Partograph បាន។', true);
            });
        }

        var activeNursingFormKey = null;
        function switchNursingForm(formName) {
            var formMap = {
                general: { pane: 'nursing_general' },
                maternity: { pane: 'nursing_maternity' }
            };
            var selectedKey = formMap[formName] ? formName : 'general';
            if (activeNursingFormKey === selectedKey) return;
            activeNursingFormKey = selectedKey;
            var selected = formMap[selectedKey];

            Object.keys(formMap).forEach(function (key) {
                var item = formMap[key];
                var pane = document.getElementById(item.pane);
                if (pane) {
                    var isActive = item.pane === selected.pane;
                    pane.classList.toggle('active', isActive);
                    pane.style.display = isActive ? 'block' : 'none';
                }
            });

            var selector = document.getElementById('nursing_process_selector');
            if (selector && selector.value !== (selected.pane === 'nursing_maternity' ? 'maternity' : 'general')) {
                selector.value = selected.pane === 'nursing_maternity' ? 'maternity' : 'general';
            }
            scheduleNursingChartRender();
        }

        function nursingNumber(value) {
            var numberValue = parseFloat(value);
            return isFinite(numberValue) ? numberValue : null;
        }

        function normalizeNursingCellText(value) {
            return String(value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
        }

        function findNursingTableRow(table, labelText) {
            if (!table) return null;
            return Array.prototype.slice.call(table.rows).find(function (row) {
                return Array.prototype.slice.call(row.cells).some(function (cell) {
                    return normalizeNursingCellText(cell.textContent) === labelText;
                });
            }) || null;
        }

        function getNursingTrailingCells(row, cellCount) {
            if (!row || !cellCount) return [];
            return Array.prototype.slice.call(row.cells).slice(-cellCount);
        }

        function parseNursingGridNumber(value) {
            var normalized = normalizeNursingCellText(value).replace(',', '.');
            if (!normalized) return null;
            var match = normalized.match(/-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?/);
            if (!match) return null;
            var numberValue = parseFloat(match[0]);
            return isFinite(numberValue) ? numberValue : null;
        }

        function formatNursingGridTotal(value) {
            var rounded = Math.round((value + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100;
            return Number.isInteger(rounded) ? String(rounded) : String(rounded).replace(/0+$/, '').replace(/\.$/, '');
        }

        function calculateNursingFluidTotals(table) {
            var intakeTotalRow = findNursingTableRow(table, 'សរុបទឹកចូល');
            var outputTotalRow = findNursingTableRow(table, 'សរុបទឹកចេញ');
            if (!intakeTotalRow || !outputTotalRow) return;

            var intakeTotalCells = Array.prototype.slice.call(intakeTotalRow.cells, 1);
            var outputTotalCells = Array.prototype.slice.call(outputTotalRow.cells, 1);
            var columnCount = Math.min(intakeTotalCells.length, outputTotalCells.length);
            var intakeRows = [
                findNursingTableRow(table, 'ការចាក់បញ្ចូល'),
                findNursingTableRow(table, 'ការផឹក'),
                findNursingTableRow(table, 'តាមសុង')
            ].filter(Boolean);
            var outputRows = [
                findNursingTableRow(table, 'ទឹកនោម'),
                findNursingTableRow(table, 'ក្អួត'),
                findNursingTableRow(table, 'សុង'),
                findNursingTableRow(table, 'លាមក(ពណ៌)')
            ].filter(Boolean);

            var updateTotalCells = function (sourceRows, totalCells) {
                sourceRows.forEach(function (row) {
                    getNursingTrailingCells(row, columnCount).forEach(function (cell) {
                        cell.classList.add('nursing-editable-cell', 'nursing-io-entry-cell');
                        cell.setAttribute('contenteditable', 'true');
                        cell.setAttribute('inputmode', 'decimal');
                        cell.setAttribute('role', 'textbox');
                    });
                });

                totalCells.slice(0, columnCount).forEach(function (totalCell, columnIndex) {
                    var sum = 0;
                    var hasNumber = false;
                    sourceRows.forEach(function (row) {
                        var valueCells = getNursingTrailingCells(row, columnCount);
                        var numberValue = parseNursingGridNumber(valueCells[columnIndex] ? valueCells[columnIndex].textContent : '');
                        if (numberValue !== null) {
                            sum += numberValue;
                            hasNumber = true;
                        }
                    });
                    totalCell.removeAttribute('contenteditable');
                    totalCell.removeAttribute('inputmode');
                    totalCell.classList.remove('nursing-editable-cell');
                    totalCell.classList.add('nursing-calculated-cell');
                    totalCell.textContent = hasNumber ? formatNursingGridTotal(sum) : '';
                    totalCell.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Calculated total');
                });
            };

            updateTotalCells(intakeRows, intakeTotalCells);
            updateTotalCells(outputRows, outputTotalCells);
        }

        function getNursingMedicationSection(table) {
            if (!table || !table.tBodies || !table.tBodies[0]) return null;
            var rows = Array.prototype.slice.call(table.tBodies[0].rows);
            var headerRow = findNursingTableRow(table, 'ការផ្តល់ឱសថព្យាបាល');
            var ioHeaderRow = findNursingTableRow(table, 'បរិមាណទឹកចូល ទឹកចេញ (I&O)');
            if (!headerRow || !ioHeaderRow) return null;
            var headerIndex = rows.indexOf(headerRow);
            var ioIndex = rows.indexOf(ioHeaderRow);
            if (headerIndex < 0 || ioIndex <= headerIndex) return null;
            return {
                body: table.tBodies[0],
                headerRow: headerRow,
                ioHeaderRow: ioHeaderRow,
                rows: rows.slice(headerIndex + 1, ioIndex)
            };
        }

        function getNursingMedicationColumnCount(table) {
            var graphRow = table ? table.querySelector('tr.graph-tr') : null;
            var graphCells = graphRow ? graphRow.querySelectorAll('.graph-td').length : 0;
            return graphCells || 16;
        }

        function getMedicationRouteDefinitions() {
            return [
                { value: 'iv_fluid', priority: 1, khmer: 'សារធាតុរាវតាមសរសៃឈាម (IV)', english: 'IV fluid' },
                { value: 'antibiotic_iv', priority: 2, khmer: 'អង់ទីប៊ីយ៉ូទិកតាមសរសៃឈាម (IV)', english: 'Antibiotic IV' },
                { value: 'antibiotic_im', priority: 2, khmer: 'អង់ទីប៊ីយ៉ូទិកចាក់សាច់ដុំ (IM)', english: 'Antibiotic IM' },
                { value: 'other_iv', priority: 3, khmer: 'ថ្នាំផ្សេងតាមសរសៃឈាម (IV)', english: 'Other medicine IV' },
                { value: 'other_im', priority: 3, khmer: 'ថ្នាំផ្សេងចាក់សាច់ដុំ (IM)', english: 'Other medicine IM' },
                { value: 'subcutaneous', priority: 3.5, khmer: 'ចាក់ក្រោមស្បែក (SC)', english: 'Subcutaneous (SC)' },
                { value: 'injection_unspecified', priority: 3.5, khmer: 'ចាក់ (ត្រូវបញ្ជាក់ផ្លូវ)', english: 'Injection (route needed)' },
                { value: 'po', priority: 4, khmer: 'លេប (PO)', english: 'Oral (PO)' },
                { value: 'topical', priority: 4.5, khmer: 'លាប', english: 'Topical' },
                { value: 'drops', priority: 4.5, khmer: 'បន្តក់', english: 'Drops' },
                { value: 'inhaled', priority: 4.5, khmer: 'ស្រូប', english: 'Inhaled' },
                { value: 'vaginal', priority: 5, khmer: 'តាមទ្វារមាស', english: 'Vaginal' },
                { value: 'rectal', priority: 5, khmer: 'តាមទ្វារធំ (PR)', english: 'Rectal (PR)' },
                { value: 'sublingual', priority: 5, khmer: 'ក្រោមអណ្តាត (SL)', english: 'Sublingual (SL)' }
            ];
        }

        function normalizeMedicationRoute(value) {
            var normalized = normalizeNursingCellText(value).toLocaleLowerCase();
            var aliases = {
                'លេប': 'po', 'oral': 'po', 'po': 'po',
                'ចាក់': 'injection_unspecified', 'injection': 'injection_unspecified',
                'iv fluid': 'iv_fluid', 'iv fluids': 'iv_fluid', 'perfusion': 'iv_fluid', 'serum': 'iv_fluid',
                'antibiotic iv': 'antibiotic_iv', 'antibiotic im': 'antibiotic_im',
                'iv': 'other_iv', 'im': 'other_im',
                'sc': 'subcutaneous', 'subcutaneous': 'subcutaneous', 'ចាក់ក្រោមស្បែក': 'subcutaneous',
                'លាប': 'topical', 'topical': 'topical',
                'បន្តក់': 'drops', 'drops': 'drops',
                'ស្រូប': 'inhaled', 'inhaled': 'inhaled',
                'vaginal': 'vaginal', 'intra vaginal': 'vaginal',
                'rectal': 'rectal', 'intra rectal': 'rectal', 'pr': 'rectal',
                'sublingual': 'sublingual', 'sl': 'sublingual'
            };
            if (aliases[normalized]) return aliases[normalized];
            var known = getMedicationRouteDefinitions().some(function (definition) {
                return definition.value === normalized;
            });
            return known ? normalized : (normalized || 'po');
        }

        function getMedicationRouteDefinition(value) {
            var normalized = normalizeMedicationRoute(value);
            return getMedicationRouteDefinitions().find(function (definition) {
                return definition.value === normalized;
            }) || { value: normalized, priority: 7, khmer: normalizeNursingCellText(value) || '-', english: normalizeNursingCellText(value) || '-' };
        }

        function getMedicationRouteLabel(value, language) {
            var definition = getMedicationRouteDefinition(value);
            return definition[(language || currentLang) === 'khmer' ? 'khmer' : 'english'];
        }

        function getMedicationRoutePriority(value) {
            return getMedicationRouteDefinition(value).priority;
        }

        function getNursingMedicationRouteLabel(value) {
            var route = normalizeMedicationRoute(value);
            var khmer = currentLang === 'khmer';
            var labels = {
                iv_fluid: khmer ? 'IV សារធាតុរាវ' : 'IV fluid',
                antibiotic_iv: 'IV', antibiotic_im: 'IM', other_iv: 'IV', other_im: 'IM',
                subcutaneous: 'SC', injection_unspecified: khmer ? 'ចាក់ (ត្រូវបញ្ជាក់ផ្លូវ)' : 'Injection (route needed)', po: 'PO',
                vaginal: khmer ? 'តាមទ្វារមាស' : 'Vaginal', rectal: 'PR', sublingual: 'SL',
                topical: khmer ? 'លាប' : 'Topical', drops: khmer ? 'បន្តក់' : 'Drops',
                inhaled: khmer ? 'ស្រូប' : 'Inhaled'
            };
            return labels[route] || getMedicationRouteLabel(route);
        }

        function populateMedicationRouteSelect(select, selectedValue) {
            if (!select) return;
            var selected = normalizeMedicationRoute(selectedValue !== undefined ? selectedValue : select.value);
            select.innerHTML = '';
            getMedicationRouteDefinitions().forEach(function (definition) {
                var option = document.createElement('option');
                option.value = definition.value;
                option.textContent = definition[currentLang === 'khmer' ? 'khmer' : 'english'];
                select.appendChild(option);
            });
            if (!getMedicationRouteDefinitions().some(function (definition) { return definition.value === selected; })) {
                var unverified = document.createElement('option');
                unverified.value = selected;
                unverified.textContent = selected + ' (ពិនិត្យផ្លូវប្រើ)';
                select.appendChild(unverified);
            }
            select.value = selected;
        }

        function formatMedicationLocalDateTime(date) {
            var value = date instanceof Date ? date : new Date(date || Date.now());
            if (isNaN(value.getTime())) value = new Date();
            var localValue = new Date(value.getTime() - value.getTimezoneOffset() * 60000);
            return localValue.toISOString().slice(0, 16);
        }

        function createMedicationProtocolIntervalItem(detailRow, value, unit) {
            var list = detailRow ? detailRow.querySelector('.med-protocol-interval-list') : null;
            if (!list) return null;
            var item = document.createElement('div');
            item.className = 'med-protocol-interval-item';
            item.innerHTML = `
                <span class="med-protocol-interval-number"></span>
                <input type="number" min="0" step="0.1" class="med-protocol-interval-value" oninput="handleMedicationProtocolIntervalChange(this)" placeholder="ចំនួន">
                <select class="med-protocol-interval-unit" onchange="handleMedicationProtocolIntervalChange(this)">
                    <option value="minutes">នាទី</option>
                    <option value="hours">ម៉ោង</option>
                </select>
            `;
            var input = item.querySelector('.med-protocol-interval-value');
            if (input && value !== undefined && value !== null) input.value = value;
            var select = item.querySelector('.med-protocol-interval-unit');
            if (select) select.value = unit === 'hours' ? 'hours' : 'minutes';
            list.appendChild(item);
            return item;
        }

        function refreshMedicationProtocolIntervalLanguage(scope) {
            var khmer = currentLang === 'khmer';
            var root = scope && scope.querySelectorAll ? scope : document;
            root.querySelectorAll('.med-protocol-interval-item').forEach(function (item, index) {
                var doseLabel = item.querySelector('.protocol-dose-label');
                if (doseLabel) doseLabel.textContent = (khmer ? 'លើកទី' : 'Dose ') + (Array.from(item.parentElement.children).indexOf(item) + 1) + ':';
                var numberLabel = item.querySelector('.med-protocol-interval-number');
                if (numberLabel) numberLabel.textContent = (khmer ? 'ក្រោយលើកទី ' : 'After dose ') + (index + 1);
                var input = item.querySelector('.med-protocol-interval-value');
                if (input) input.placeholder = khmer ? 'ចំនួន' : 'Number';
                var unit = item.querySelector('.med-protocol-interval-unit');
                if (unit && unit.options[0]) unit.options[0].text = khmer ? 'នាទី' : 'Minutes';
                if (unit && unit.options[1]) unit.options[1].text = khmer ? 'ម៉ោង' : 'Hours';
            });
        }

        function ensureMedicationProtocolIntervalRows(detailRow) {
            var list = detailRow ? detailRow.querySelector('.med-protocol-interval-list') : null;
            if (!list) return;
            var items = Array.prototype.slice.call(list.querySelectorAll('.med-protocol-interval-item'));
            if (!items.length) items.push(createMedicationProtocolIntervalItem(detailRow, '', 'minutes'));
            for (var itemIndex = items.length - 2; itemIndex >= 0; itemIndex--) {
                var intervalInput = items[itemIndex].querySelector('.med-protocol-interval-value');
                if (intervalInput && !normalizeNursingCellText(intervalInput.value)) {
                    items[itemIndex].remove();
                    items.splice(itemIndex, 1);
                }
            }
            while (items.length > 1) {
                var lastValue = normalizeNursingCellText(items[items.length - 1].querySelector('.med-protocol-interval-value').value);
                var previousValue = normalizeNursingCellText(items[items.length - 2].querySelector('.med-protocol-interval-value').value);
                if (lastValue || previousValue) break;
                items[items.length - 1].remove();
                items.pop();
            }
            var lastItem = items[items.length - 1];
            var lastInput = lastItem ? lastItem.querySelector('.med-protocol-interval-value') : null;
            if (lastInput && normalizeNursingCellText(lastInput.value)) {
                createMedicationProtocolIntervalItem(detailRow, '', 'minutes');
            }
            refreshMedicationProtocolIntervalLanguage(detailRow);
        }

        function handleMedicationProtocolIntervalChange(element) {
            var detailRow = element && element.closest ? element.closest('.rx-timing-detail-row') : null;
            if (!detailRow) return;
            ensureMedicationProtocolIntervalRows(detailRow);
            var mainRow = detailRow.previousElementSibling;
            if (mainRow) handleMedicationQuickChange(mainRow.querySelector('.med-schedule-type'));
        }

        function handleMedicationProtocolFieldChange(element) {
            updateProtocolCalculatedTimes(element);
            var detailRow = element && element.closest ? element.closest('.rx-timing-detail-row') : null;
            var mainRow = detailRow ? detailRow.previousElementSibling : getMedicationMainRow(element);
            if (mainRow) {
                if (mainRow.classList.contains('protocol-main-row')) refreshMedicationProtocolIntervalLanguage(mainRow);
                handleMedicationQuickChange(mainRow);
            }
        }

        function serializeMedicationProtocolIntervals(detailRow) {
            if (!detailRow) return '';
            return Array.prototype.slice.call(detailRow.querySelectorAll('.med-protocol-interval-item')).map(function (item) {
                var input = item.querySelector('.med-protocol-interval-value');
                var unit = item.querySelector('.med-protocol-interval-unit');
                var value = input ? normalizeNursingCellText(input.value) : '';
                if (!value || !(parseFloat(value) > 0)) return '';
                return value + (unit && unit.value === 'hours' ? 'h' : 'm');
            }).filter(Boolean).join(',');
        }

        function populateMedicationProtocolIntervals(detailRow, sequence) {
            var list = detailRow ? detailRow.querySelector('.med-protocol-interval-list') : null;
            if (!list) return;
            list.innerHTML = '';
            parseMedicationIntervalItems(sequence).forEach(function (interval) {
                createMedicationProtocolIntervalItem(detailRow, interval.value, interval.unit);
            });
            ensureMedicationProtocolIntervalRows(detailRow);
        }

        function createMedicationTimingDetailRow(mainRow, prefix) {
            if (!mainRow || !mainRow.parentNode) return null;
            var detailRow = document.createElement('tr');

                            <button type="button" class="med-protocol-close" onclick="closeMedicationProtocolPanel(this)" title="បិទ" aria-label="បិទ"><i class="fa-solid fa-chevron-up"></i></button>

                            </label>
                            <label class="rx-timing-field rx-timing-field-small">

                            </label>
                            <label class="rx-timing-field rx-timing-field-small">
                                <span data-med-label="max_doses">ចំនួនសរុបនៃការផ្តល់</span>
                                <input type="number" min="1" step="1" class="med-protocol-max-doses" data-med-placeholder="optional" placeholder="មិនចាំបាច់" oninput="handleMedicationProtocolFieldChange(this)">
                            </label>
                            <label class="rx-timing-field">
                                <span data-med-label="stop_at">បញ្ឈប់នៅ</span>
                                <input type="datetime-local" class="med-protocol-stop-at" onchange="handleMedicationProtocolFieldChange(this)">
                            </label>
                        </span>
                        <div class="med-protocol-preview"><strong data-med-ui-label="preview">សេចក្តីសង្ខេប៖</strong> <span></span></div>
                    </div>
                </td>
            `;
            mainRow.parentNode.insertBefore(detailRow, mainRow.nextSibling);
            ensureMedicationProtocolIntervalRows(detailRow);
            return detailRow;
        }

        function getMedicationTimingDetailRow(mainRow) {
            var nextRow = mainRow ? mainRow.nextElementSibling : null;
            return nextRow && nextRow.classList.contains('rx-timing-detail-row') ? nextRow : null;
        }

        function getMedicationMainRow(element) {
            return element && element.closest ? element.closest('tr.rx-main-row, tr.mrx-main-row, tr.orx-main-row, tr.protocol-main-row') : null;
        }

        function getMedicationRowPrefix(mainRow) {
            if (mainRow && mainRow.classList.contains('protocol-main-row')) return mainRow.closest('#mon_rx_protocol_tbody') ? 'mprx' : 'prx';
            if (mainRow && mainRow.classList.contains('orx-main-row')) return 'orx';
            return mainRow && mainRow.classList.contains('mrx-main-row') ? 'mrx' : 'rx';
        }

        function getMedicationScheduleType(mainRow) {
            if (mainRow && mainRow.getAttribute('data-medication-schedule-type') === 'protocol') return 'protocol';
            var select = mainRow ? mainRow.querySelector('.med-schedule-type') : null;
            if (select && select.value) return select.value;
            if (!mainRow) return '';
            var prefix = getMedicationRowPrefix(mainRow);
            var activeCount = ['m', 'a', 'e', 'n'].reduce(function (total, part) {
                var field = mainRow.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-' + part);
                return total + (field && parseFloat(field.value) > 0 ? 1 : 0);
            }, 0);
            return { 1: 'qd_m', 2: 'bid', 3: 'tid', 4: 'qid' }[activeCount] || '';
        }

        function getMedicationDoseAmount(mainRow) {
            if (!mainRow) return '';
            var prefix = getMedicationRowPrefix(mainRow);
            var doseField = mainRow.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-dose');
            if (doseField && normalizeNursingCellText(doseField.value)) return normalizeNursingCellText(doseField.value);
            var legacyField = mainRow.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-m, .' + prefix + '-a, .' + prefix + '-e, .' + prefix + '-n');
            return legacyField ? normalizeNursingCellText(legacyField.value) : '';
        }

        function updateMedicationLegacyDoseFields(mainRow) {
            if (!mainRow) return;
            var prefix = getMedicationRowPrefix(mainRow);
            var dose = getMedicationDoseAmount(mainRow) || '0';
            var scheduleType = getMedicationScheduleType(mainRow);
            var values = { m: '0', a: '0', e: '0', n: '0' };
            if (scheduleType === 'qd_m') values = { m: dose, a: '0', e: '0', n: '0' };
            if (scheduleType === 'qd_a') values = { m: '0', a: dose, e: '0', n: '0' };
            if (scheduleType === 'qd_e') values = { m: '0', a: '0', e: dose, n: '0' };
            if (scheduleType === 'qd_n') values = { m: '0', a: '0', e: '0', n: dose };
            if (scheduleType === 'bid') values = { m: dose, a: '0', e: dose, n: '0' };
            if (scheduleType === 'tid') values = { m: dose, a: dose, e: dose, n: '0' };
            if (scheduleType === 'qid') values = { m: dose, a: dose, e: dose, n: dose };
            ['m', 'a', 'e', 'n'].forEach(function (part) {
                var field = mainRow.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-' + part);
                if (field) field.value = values[part];
            });
        }

        function getMedicationDailyFrequency(mainRow) {
            var scheduleType = getMedicationScheduleType(mainRow);
            if (scheduleType.startsWith('qd_')) return 1;
            if (scheduleType === 'bid') return 2;
            if (scheduleType === 'tid') return 3;
            if (scheduleType === 'qid') return 4;
            if (scheduleType === 'qh') {
                var qHoursField = mainRow.querySelector('.med-q-hours');
                var qHours = qHoursField ? parseFloat(qHoursField.value) : 0;
                return qHours > 0 ? 24 / qHours : 0;
            }
            return 0;
        }

        function calculateMedicationQuickTotal(mainRow) {
            if (!mainRow) return;
            var prefix = getMedicationRowPrefix(mainRow);
            var totalField = mainRow.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-total');
            if (!totalField) return;
            var dose = parseFloat(getMedicationDoseAmount(mainRow)) || 0;
            var daysField = mainRow.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-d');
            var days = daysField ? parseFloat(daysField.value) || 0 : 0;
            var scheduleType = getMedicationScheduleType(mainRow);
            var total = 0;
            if (scheduleType === 'protocol') {
                var timing = getMedicationTimingData(mainRow, '');
                var doseSequence = String(timing.protocolDose || '').match(/\d+(?:\.\d+)?/g) || [];
                var maxDoses = parseInt(timing.protocolMaxDoses, 10) || doseSequence.length;
                for (var index = 0; index < maxDoses; index++) {
                    total += parseFloat(doseSequence[Math.min(index, Math.max(0, doseSequence.length - 1))]) || dose;
                }
            } else if (scheduleType === 'qh') {
                var qHoursField = mainRow.querySelector('.med-q-hours');
                var qHours = qHoursField ? parseFloat(qHoursField.value) : 0;
                total = dose && days && qHours > 0 ? Math.ceil((days * 24) / qHours) * dose : 0;
            } else {
                total = dose * getMedicationDailyFrequency(mainRow) * days;
            }
