            totalField.value = total ? String(Math.round(total * 100) / 100) : '0';
        }

        function formatMedicationScheduleLabel(scheduleType, qHours, language) {
            var khmer = (language || currentLang) === 'khmer';
            if (scheduleType === 'qd_m') return khmer ? 'QD ព្រឹក' : 'QD Morning';
            if (scheduleType === 'qd_a') return khmer ? 'QD ថ្ងៃ' : 'QD Afternoon';
            if (scheduleType === 'qd_e') return khmer ? 'QD ល្ងាច' : 'QD Evening';
            if (scheduleType === 'qd_n') return khmer ? 'QD យប់' : 'QD Night';
            if (scheduleType === 'bid') return 'BID';
            if (scheduleType === 'tid') return 'TID';
            if (scheduleType === 'qid') return 'QID';
            if (scheduleType === 'qh') return qHours ? ('Q' + qHours + 'H · ' + (khmer ? 'រៀងរាល់ ' + qHours + ' ម៉ោងម្ដង' : 'every ' + qHours + ' hours')) : 'QNH';
            if (scheduleType === 'protocol') return khmer ? 'ពិធីសារព្យាបាល' : 'Treatment protocol';
            return '';
        }

        function refreshMedicationScheduleSummary(mainRow) {
            if (!mainRow) return;
            var summary = mainRow.querySelector('.med-schedule-summary');
            var qHoursField = mainRow.querySelector('.med-q-hours');
            var schedType = getMedicationScheduleType(mainRow);
            var text = formatMedicationScheduleLabel(schedType, qHoursField ? normalizeNursingCellText(qHoursField.value) : '', currentLang);

            // Only show the summary text for the complex "protocol", hide it for QNH
            if (schedType !== 'protocol') {
                text = '';
            }

            if (summary) {
                summary.textContent = text;
                summary.style.display = text ? 'block' : 'none';
            }

            var detailRow = getMedicationTimingDetailRow(mainRow);
            var preview = detailRow ? detailRow.querySelector('.med-protocol-preview span') : null;
            if (preview) preview.textContent = buildMedicationTimingInstruction(Object.assign({
                name: '', route: '', m: '0', a: '0', e: '0', n: '0', d: '', unit: '', note: ''
            }, getMedicationTimingData(mainRow, '')), currentLang) || (currentLang === 'khmer' ? 'បញ្ចូលជំហានពិធីសារ' : 'Enter the protocol steps');
        }

        function handleMedicationQuickChange(element) {
            var mainRow = getMedicationMainRow(element);
            if (!mainRow) return;
            updateMedicationLegacyDoseFields(mainRow);
            calculateMedicationQuickTotal(mainRow);
            refreshMedicationScheduleSummary(mainRow);
            if (mainRow.closest('#rx_tbody, #rx_protocol_tbody')) syncNursingMedicationOrders();
        }

        function handleMedicationScheduleChange(select) {
            var mainRow = getMedicationMainRow(select);
            if (!mainRow) return;
            var scheduleType = select.value || '';
            var qHours = mainRow.querySelector('.med-qh-inline');
            var protocolButton = mainRow.querySelector('.med-protocol-toggle');
            var detailRow = getMedicationTimingDetailRow(mainRow) || createMedicationTimingDetailRow(mainRow, getMedicationRowPrefix(mainRow));
            if (qHours) qHours.hidden = scheduleType !== 'qh';
            if (protocolButton) protocolButton.hidden = scheduleType !== 'protocol';
            if (detailRow) detailRow.classList.toggle('is-open', scheduleType === 'protocol');
            mainRow.classList.toggle('rx-protocol-active', scheduleType === 'protocol');
            handleMedicationQuickChange(select);
        }

        function toggleMedicationProtocolPanel(button) {
            var mainRow = getMedicationMainRow(button);
            var detailRow = getMedicationTimingDetailRow(mainRow);
            if (detailRow) detailRow.classList.toggle('is-open');
        }

        function closeMedicationProtocolPanel(button) {
            var detailRow = button && button.closest ? button.closest('.rx-timing-detail-row') : null;
            if (detailRow) detailRow.classList.remove('is-open');
        }

        function toggleMedicationTimingMode(select) {
            var detailRow = select && select.closest ? select.closest('.rx-timing-detail-row') : null;
            var mainRow = getMedicationMainRow(select) || (detailRow ? detailRow.previousElementSibling : null);
            var scheduleSelect = mainRow ? mainRow.querySelector('.med-schedule-type') : null;
            if (scheduleSelect) {
                scheduleSelect.value = select && select.value === 'protocol' ? 'protocol' : (scheduleSelect.value || 'bid');
                handleMedicationScheduleChange(scheduleSelect);
            }
        }

        function getMedicationTimingData(mainRow, fallbackEffectiveAt) {
            var detailRow = getMedicationTimingDetailRow(mainRow);
            var valueOf = function (selector) {
                var input = (detailRow ? detailRow.querySelector(selector) : null) || (mainRow ? mainRow.querySelector(selector) : null);
                return input ? normalizeNursingCellText(input.value) : '';
            };
            var scheduleType = getMedicationScheduleType(mainRow);
            var qHoursField = mainRow ? mainRow.querySelector('.med-q-hours') : null;
            var doseField = mainRow ? mainRow.querySelector('.' + getMedicationRowPrefix(mainRow) + '-dose') : null;
            var startField = mainRow ? mainRow.querySelector('.med-effective-at') : null;
            var timingMode = scheduleType === 'protocol' ? 'protocol' : 'scheduled';
            var intervalListRow = detailRow || mainRow;
            var protocolRow = mainRow && mainRow.classList.contains('protocol-main-row');
            var intervals = serializeMedicationProtocolIntervals(intervalListRow);
            return {
                timingMode: timingMode,
                scheduleType: scheduleType,
                qHours: qHoursField ? normalizeNursingCellText(qHoursField.value) : '',
                doseAmount: doseField ? normalizeNursingCellText(doseField.value) : getMedicationDoseAmount(mainRow),
                effectiveAt: (startField ? normalizeNursingCellText(startField.value) : '') || valueOf('.med-effective-at') || normalizeNursingCellText(fallbackEffectiveAt),
                protocolDose: valueOf('.med-protocol-dose') || (protocolRow ? getMedicationDoseAmount(mainRow) : ''),
                protocolIntervals: intervals,
                protocolRepeatValue: valueOf('.med-protocol-repeat-value'),
                protocolRepeatUnit: valueOf('.med-protocol-repeat-unit') || 'hours',
                protocolMaxDoses: valueOf('.med-protocol-max-doses') || (protocolRow ? String(1 + parseMedicationIntervalItems(intervals).length) : ''),
                protocolStopAt: valueOf('.med-protocol-stop-at')
            };
        }

        // Capture every admission order, including rows added after the page loaded.
        // Dynamic table rows have no stable auto storage key of their own.
        window.collectInitialIpdMedications = function () {
            return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#rx_tbody tr.rx-main-row, #rx_protocol_tbody tr.protocol-main-row'))
                .map(function (row) {
                    var prefix = row.classList.contains('protocol-main-row') ? 'prx' : 'rx';
                    var value = function (suffix) {
                        var control = row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-' + suffix);
                        return control ? String(control.value || '').trim() : '';
                    };
                    if (!value('name')) return null;
                    var order = Object.assign({
                        rowType: prefix === 'prx' ? 'protocolRow' : 'regularRow',
                        name: value('name'), route: value('route'), unit: value('unit'),
                        m: value('m'), a: value('a'), e: value('e'), n: value('n'),
                        d: value('d'), total: value('total'), note: value('note')
                    }, getMedicationTimingData(row, ''));
                    if (prefix === 'prx') order.doseAmount = value('dose');
                    return order;
                }).filter(Boolean);
        };

        window.restoreInitialIpdMedications = function (medications) {
            if (!Array.isArray(medications)) return;
            var body = document.getElementById('rx_tbody');
            var protocolBody = document.getElementById('rx_protocol_tbody');
            if (!body || !protocolBody) return;
            body.innerHTML = '';
            protocolBody.innerHTML = '';
            var protocolContainer = document.getElementById('protocol_rx_container');
            if (protocolContainer) protocolContainer.style.display = 'none';
            medications.slice(0, 150).forEach(function (med) {
                if (!med || !med.name) return;
                var protocol = isDedicatedProtocolMedication(med);
                if (protocol) addProtocolRowStub('main_rx_dropdown');
                else addRxRow(true);
                var candidates = (protocol ? protocolBody : body).querySelectorAll(protocol ? 'tr.protocol-main-row' : 'tr.rx-main-row');
                var row = candidates[candidates.length - 1];
                if (!row) return;
                if (protocol) { restoreSpecificProtocolMedication(row, med, ''); return; }
                var prefix = 'rx';
                var put = function (selector, value) {
                    var control = row.querySelector(selector);
                    if (control && value !== null && value !== undefined) control.value = String(value);
                };
                ['name', 'dose', 'unit', 'd', 'total', 'note'].forEach(function (part) {
                    put('.' + prefix + '-' + part, part === 'dose' ? med.doseAmount : med[part]);
                });
                var route = row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-route');
                if (route) populateMedicationRouteSelect(route, med.route || 'po');
                    put('.med-q-hours', med.qHours);
                    put('.med-effective-at', med.effectiveAt);
                    var detail = getMedicationTimingDetailRow(row);
                    if (detail) {
                        [['.med-protocol-dose', med.protocolDose],
                            ['.med-protocol-repeat-value', med.protocolRepeatValue],
                            ['.med-protocol-repeat-unit', med.protocolRepeatUnit],
                            ['.med-protocol-max-doses', med.protocolMaxDoses],
                            ['.med-protocol-stop-at', med.protocolStopAt]].forEach(function (item) {
                            var input = detail.querySelector(item[0]);
                            if (input && item[1] !== undefined) input.value = item[1];
                        });
                        populateMedicationProtocolIntervals(detail, med.protocolIntervals);
                    }
                    var schedule = row.querySelector('.med-schedule-type');
                    if (schedule) {
                        schedule.value = med.timingMode === 'protocol' ? 'protocol' : (med.scheduleType || '');
                        if (schedule.value) handleMedicationScheduleChange(schedule);
                    }
                    ['m', 'a', 'e', 'n'].forEach(function (part) { put('.rx-' + part, med[part]); });
            });
            while (body.querySelectorAll('tr.rx-main-row').length < 5) addRxRow(true);
            syncNursingMedicationOrders();
        };

        // OPD prescription rows can also be added after storage keys were
        // assigned. Keep their route and per-dose schedule with the encounter.
        window.collectOpdMedications = function () {
            return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#opd_rx_tbody tr.orx-main-row')).map(function (row) {
                var read = function (suffix) {
                    var input = row.querySelector('.orx-' + suffix);
                    return input ? String(input.value || '').trim() : '';
                };
                if (!read('name')) return null;
                return Object.assign({
                    name: read('name'), route: read('route'), unit: read('unit'),
                    m: read('m'), a: read('a'), e: read('e'), n: read('n'),
                    d: read('d'), total: read('total'), note: read('note')
                }, getMedicationTimingData(row, ''));
            }).filter(Boolean);
        };

        window.restoreOpdMedications = function (medications) {
            if (!Array.isArray(medications)) return;
            var body = document.getElementById('opd_rx_tbody');
            if (!body) return;
            body.innerHTML = '';
            medications.slice(0, 150).forEach(function (med) {
                if (!med || !med.name) return;
                addOpdRxRow(true);
                var rows = body.querySelectorAll('tr.orx-main-row');
                var row = rows[rows.length - 1];
                if (!row) return;
                var put = function (selector, value) {
                    var input = row.querySelector(selector);
                    if (input && value !== null && value !== undefined) input.value = String(value);
                };
                ['name', 'unit', 'd', 'total', 'note'].forEach(function (part) {
                    put('.orx-' + part, med[part]);
                });
                put('.orx-dose', med.doseAmount);
                var route = row.querySelector('.orx-route');
                if (route) populateMedicationRouteSelect(route, med.route || 'po');
                put('.med-q-hours', med.qHours);
                put('.med-effective-at', med.effectiveAt);
                var schedule = row.querySelector('.med-schedule-type');
                if (schedule) {
                    schedule.value = med.scheduleType || '';
                    if (schedule.value) handleMedicationScheduleChange(schedule);
                }
                ['m', 'a', 'e', 'n'].forEach(function (part) { put('.orx-' + part, med[part]); });
            });
            while (body.querySelectorAll('tr.orx-main-row').length < 5) addOpdRxRow(true);
        };

        function formatMedicationProtocolIntervals(sequence, language) {
            var khmer = (language || currentLang) === 'khmer';
            return parseMedicationIntervalItems(sequence).map(function (interval, index) {
                var unitLabel = interval.unit === 'hours'
                    ? (khmer ? 'ម៉ោង' : 'hours')
                    : (khmer ? 'នាទី' : 'minutes');
                return (khmer ? 'ក្រោយលើកទី ' : 'After dose ') + (index + 1) + (khmer ? '៖ ' : ': ') + interval.value + ' ' + unitLabel;
            }).join(' → ');
        }

        function buildMedicationTimingInstruction(order, language) {
            var khmer = (language || currentLang) === 'khmer';
            if (!order) return '';
            if (order.timingMode !== 'protocol') {
                return formatMedicationScheduleLabel(order.scheduleType, order.qHours, language) || buildNursingMedicationDose(order || {});
            }
            var parts = [khmer ? 'តាមពិធីសារព្យាបាល' : 'According to Treatment Protocol'];
            if (normalizeMedicationDoseSequence(order.protocolDose)) {
                parts.push((khmer ? 'កម្រិតប្រើ៖ ' : 'Dose sequence: ') + normalizeMedicationDoseSequence(order.protocolDose));
            }
            if (normalizeNursingCellText(order.protocolIntervals)) {
                parts.push(formatMedicationProtocolIntervals(order.protocolIntervals, language));
            }
            if (parseFloat(order.protocolRepeatValue) > 0) {
                parts.push((khmer ? 'បន្តរៀងរាល់៖ ' : 'Then repeat every: ') + normalizeNursingCellText(order.protocolRepeatValue) + ' ' +
                    (order.protocolRepeatUnit === 'minutes' ? (khmer ? 'នាទី' : 'minutes') : (khmer ? 'ម៉ោង' : 'hours')));
            }
            if (parseInt(order.protocolMaxDoses, 10) > 0) {
                parts.push((khmer ? 'ចំនួនសរុប៖ ' : 'Total administrations: ') + normalizeNursingCellText(order.protocolMaxDoses));
            }
            if (normalizeNursingCellText(order.protocolStopAt)) {
                parts.push((khmer ? 'បញ្ឈប់នៅ៖ ' : 'Stop at: ') + normalizeNursingCellText(order.protocolStopAt).replace('T', ' '));
            }
            return parts.join(' • ');
        }

        function refreshMedicationTimingLanguage() {
            var khmer = currentLang === 'khmer';
            var labels = khmer ? {
                timing_mode: 'របៀបកំណត់ម៉ោង', effective_at: 'កាលបរិច្ឆេទចាប់ផ្តើម', dose_sequence: 'កម្រិតប្រើ',
                interval_sequence: 'ចន្លោះពេលក្រោយការផ្តល់នីមួយៗ', repeat_interval: 'បន្ទាប់មករៀងរាល់', interval_unit: 'ឯកតាពេល',
                max_doses: 'ចំនួនសរុបនៃការផ្តល់', stop_at: 'បញ្ឈប់នៅ'
            } : {
                timing_mode: 'Timing style', effective_at: 'Effective start', dose_sequence: 'Dose sequence',
                interval_sequence: 'Intervals after each dose', repeat_interval: 'Then repeat every', interval_unit: 'Time unit',
                max_doses: 'Total administrations', stop_at: 'Stop at'
            };
            document.querySelectorAll('[data-med-label]').forEach(function (element) {
                var key = element.getAttribute('data-med-label');
                if (labels[key]) element.textContent = labels[key];
            });
            var uiLabels = khmer ? {
                dose: 'កម្រិតប្រើ', schedule: 'ពេលវេលា', open_protocol: 'កំណត់ពិធីសារ',
                protocol_title: 'ពិធីសារព្យាបាល', preview: 'សេចក្តីសង្ខេប៖', add_protocol_interval: '+ បន្ថែមពេលវេលា'
            } : {
                dose: 'Dose', schedule: 'Time/Schedule', open_protocol: 'Set protocol',
                protocol_title: 'Treatment protocol', preview: 'Summary:', add_protocol_interval: '+ Add time'
            };
            document.querySelectorAll('[data-med-ui-label]').forEach(function (element) {
                var key = element.getAttribute('data-med-ui-label');
                if (uiLabels[key]) element.textContent = uiLabels[key];
            });
            document.querySelectorAll('.med-schedule-type').forEach(function (select) {
                Array.prototype.slice.call(select.options).forEach(function (opt) {
                    if (!opt.value) opt.text = khmer ? '-- ជ្រើស --' : '-- Select --';
                    if (opt.value === 'qd_m') opt.text = khmer ? 'QD ព្រឹក' : 'QD Morning';
                    if (opt.value === 'qd_a') opt.text = khmer ? 'QD ថ្ងៃ' : 'QD Afternoon';
                    if (opt.value === 'qd_e') opt.text = khmer ? 'QD ល្ងាច' : 'QD Evening';
                    if (opt.value === 'qd_n') opt.text = khmer ? 'QD យប់' : 'QD Night';
                    if (opt.value === 'protocol') opt.text = khmer ? 'ពិធីសារ' : 'Protocol';
                    if (opt.value === 'bid') opt.text = 'BID';
                    if (opt.value === 'tid') opt.text = 'TID';
                    if (opt.value === 'qid') opt.text = 'QID';
                    if (opt.value === 'qh') opt.text = khmer ? 'QNH (រៀងរាល់ N ម៉ោងម្ដង)' : 'QNH (every N hours)';
                });
            });
            document.querySelectorAll('.med-protocol-repeat-unit').forEach(function (select) {
                if (select.options[0]) select.options[0].text = khmer ? 'ម៉ោង' : 'Hours';
                if (select.options[1]) select.options[1].text = khmer ? 'នាទី' : 'Minutes';
            });
            document.querySelectorAll('[data-med-placeholder="optional"]').forEach(function (input) {
                input.placeholder = khmer ? 'មិនចាំបាច់' : 'Optional';
            });
            refreshMedicationProtocolIntervalLanguage(document);
            document.querySelectorAll('tr.protocol-main-row').forEach(updateProtocolCalculatedTimes);
            document.querySelectorAll('.mrx-name, .orx-name, .rx-name, .prx-name, .mprx-name').forEach(function (input) {
                input.placeholder = khmer ? 'ជ្រើសរើស ឬបញ្ចូលឈ្មោះថ្នាំ...' : 'Select or enter a medicine...';
            });
            document.querySelectorAll('.mrx-note, .orx-note, .rx-note').forEach(function (input) {
                input.placeholder = khmer ? 'សម្គាល់...' : 'Note...';
            });
            document.querySelectorAll('.rx-route, .mrx-route, .orx-route, .prx-route, .mprx-route').forEach(function (select) {
                populateMedicationRouteSelect(select, select.value);
            });
            document.querySelectorAll('tr.rx-main-row, tr.mrx-main-row, tr.orx-main-row').forEach(refreshMedicationScheduleSummary);
        }

        function initializeMedicationPrescriptionRows() {
            var initializeBody = function (bodySelector, mainClass, nameSelector, prefix, useCurrentStart) {
                var body = document.querySelector(bodySelector);
                if (!body) return;
                Array.prototype.slice.call(body.children).forEach(function (row) {
                    if (!row.querySelector(nameSelector)) return;
                    row.classList.add(mainClass);
                    var route = row.querySelector(prefix === 'rx' ? '.rx-route' : (prefix === 'mrx' ? '.mrx-route' : '.orx-route'));
                    if (route) populateMedicationRouteSelect(route, route.value);
                    var detailRow = getMedicationTimingDetailRow(row) || createMedicationTimingDetailRow(row, prefix);
                    var startInput = row.querySelector('.med-effective-at');
                    if (useCurrentStart && startInput && !startInput.value) startInput.value = formatMedicationLocalDateTime(new Date());
                    var scheduleSelect = row.querySelector('.med-schedule-type');
                    if (scheduleSelect) handleMedicationScheduleChange(scheduleSelect);
                });
            };
            initializeBody('#rx_tbody', 'rx-main-row', '.rx-name', 'rx', true);
            initializeBody('#mon_rx_tbody', 'mrx-main-row', '.mrx-name', 'mrx', false);
            initializeBody('#opd_rx_tbody', 'orx-main-row', '.orx-name', 'orx', false);
            refreshMedicationTimingLanguage();
        }

        function normalizeMedicationDoseSequence(value) {
            var values = String(value || '').match(/\d+(?:\.\d+)?/g) || [];
            return values.slice(0, 4).join('-');
        }

        function buildNursingMedicationDose(order) {
            if (order && order.timingMode === 'protocol') {
                return normalizeMedicationDoseSequence(order.protocolDose) || '-';
            }
            if (order && normalizeNursingCellText(order.doseAmount)) {
                var doseText = normalizeNursingCellText(order.doseAmount) + (normalizeNursingCellText(order.unit) ? ' ' + normalizeNursingCellText(order.unit) : '');
                var scheduleText = formatMedicationScheduleLabel(order.scheduleType, order.qHours, currentLang);
                return [doseText, scheduleText].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
            }
            var scheduleValues = ['m', 'a', 'e', 'n'].map(function (key) {
                var value = normalizeNursingCellText(order[key]);
                return value || '0';
            });
            var hasSchedule = scheduleValues.some(function (value) { return parseFloat(value) > 0; });
            return hasSchedule ? scheduleValues.join('-') : '-';
        }

        function buildNursingMedicationFingerprint(order) {
            return [
                normalizeMedicationRoute(order.route),
                order.timingMode === 'protocol' ? 'protocol' : 'scheduled',
                normalizeNursingCellText(order.scheduleType),
                normalizeNursingCellText(order.qHours),
                normalizeNursingCellText(order.doseAmount),
                buildNursingMedicationDose(order),
                normalizeNursingCellText(order.protocolIntervals).toLocaleLowerCase(),
                normalizeNursingCellText(order.protocolRepeatValue),
                normalizeNursingCellText(order.protocolRepeatUnit),
                normalizeNursingCellText(order.protocolMaxDoses),
                normalizeNursingCellText(order.protocolStopAt)
            ].join('|');
        }

        function buildNursingMedicationKey(order, segmentNumber) {
            return [
                normalizeNursingCellText(order.name).toLocaleLowerCase(),
                buildNursingMedicationFingerprint(order),
                String(segmentNumber || 0)
            ].join('|');
        }

        function getMedicationOrderTimestamp(value, fallback) {
            var parsed = value ? new Date(value) : null;
            return parsed && !isNaN(parsed.getTime()) ? parsed.getTime() : fallback;
        }

        function collectNursingMedicationOrders() {
            var rawOrders = [];
            var sourceIndex = 0;
            var addOrder = function (order) {
                if (!order || !normalizeNursingCellText(order.name)) return;
                var normalizedOrder = {
                    name: normalizeNursingCellText(order.name),
                    route: normalizeMedicationRoute(order.route),
                    m: normalizeNursingCellText(order.m || '0'),
                    a: normalizeNursingCellText(order.a || '0'),
                    e: normalizeNursingCellText(order.e || '0'),
                    n: normalizeNursingCellText(order.n || '0'),
                    d: normalizeNursingCellText(order.d || ''),
                    unit: normalizeNursingCellText(order.unit),
                    note: normalizeNursingCellText(order.note),
                    timingMode: order.timingMode === 'protocol' ? 'protocol' : 'scheduled',
                    scheduleType: normalizeNursingCellText(order.scheduleType),
                    qHours: normalizeNursingCellText(order.qHours),
                    doseAmount: normalizeNursingCellText(order.doseAmount),
                    effectiveAt: normalizeNursingCellText(order.effectiveAt),
                    protocolDose: normalizeNursingCellText(order.protocolDose),
                    protocolIntervals: normalizeNursingCellText(order.protocolIntervals),
                    protocolRepeatValue: normalizeNursingCellText(order.protocolRepeatValue),
                    protocolRepeatUnit: normalizeNursingCellText(order.protocolRepeatUnit) || 'hours',
                    protocolMaxDoses: normalizeNursingCellText(order.protocolMaxDoses),
                    protocolStopAt: normalizeNursingCellText(order.protocolStopAt),
                    sourceIndex: sourceIndex++
                };
                if (normalizedOrder.timingMode === 'protocol') normalizedOrder.scheduleType = 'protocol';
                if (!normalizedOrder.scheduleType) {
                    var legacyFrequency = ['m', 'a', 'e', 'n'].reduce(function (total, key) {
                        return total + (parseFloat(normalizedOrder[key]) > 0 ? 1 : 0);
                    }, 0);
                    normalizedOrder.scheduleType = { 2: 'bid', 3: 'tid', 4: 'qid' }[legacyFrequency] || '';
                }
                if (!normalizedOrder.doseAmount) {
                    normalizedOrder.doseAmount = ['m', 'a', 'e', 'n'].map(function (key) {
                        return normalizedOrder[key];
                    }).find(function (value) { return parseFloat(value) > 0; }) || '';
                }
                normalizedOrder.dose = buildNursingMedicationDose(normalizedOrder);
                normalizedOrder.fingerprint = buildNursingMedicationFingerprint(normalizedOrder);
                rawOrders.push(normalizedOrder);
            };

            document.querySelectorAll('#rx_tbody tr.rx-main-row, #rx_protocol_tbody tr.protocol-main-row').forEach(function (row) {
                var prefix = row.classList.contains('protocol-main-row') ? 'prx' : 'rx';
                var nameField = row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-name');
                if (!nameField) return;
                var routeField = row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-route');
                var unitField = row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-unit');
                addOrder(Object.assign({
                    name: nameField.value,
                    route: routeField ? routeField.value : '',
                    m: row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-m') ? row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-m').value : '0',
                    a: row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-a') ? row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-a').value : '0',
                    e: row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-e') ? row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-e').value : '0',
                    n: row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-n') ? row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-n').value : '0',
                    d: row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-d') ? row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-d').value : '',
                    unit: unitField ? unitField.value : '',
                    note: row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-note') ? row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-note').value : ''
                }, getMedicationTimingData(row, '')));
            });

            var dailyRecords = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('#daily_monitoring_feed .ipd-mon-card')).map(function (card) {
                return card._monitoringCopyData;
            }).filter(Boolean);
            dailyRecords.sort(function (first, second) {
                return String(first.dtVal || '').localeCompare(String(second.dtVal || ''));
            });
            dailyRecords.forEach(function (record) {
                (record.medications || []).forEach(function (medication) {
                    addOrder(Object.assign({}, medication, {
                        effectiveAt: medication.effectiveAt || record.dtVal || ''
                    }));
                });
            });

            rawOrders.sort(function (first, second) {
                var firstTime = getMedicationOrderTimestamp(first.effectiveAt, first.sourceIndex);
                var secondTime = getMedicationOrderTimestamp(second.effectiveAt, second.sourceIndex);
                return firstTime - secondTime || first.sourceIndex - second.sourceIndex;
            });

            var lastFingerprintByMedicine = {};
            var segmentCountByMedicine = {};
            var orders = [];
            rawOrders.forEach(function (order) {
                var medicineKey = normalizeNursingCellText(order.name).toLocaleLowerCase();
                if (lastFingerprintByMedicine[medicineKey] === order.fingerprint) return;
                var segmentNumber = segmentCountByMedicine[medicineKey] || 0;
                segmentCountByMedicine[medicineKey] = segmentNumber + 1;
                lastFingerprintByMedicine[medicineKey] = order.fingerprint;
                order.key = buildNursingMedicationKey(order, segmentNumber);
                order.segmentNumber = segmentNumber;
                orders.push(order);
            });

            orders.sort(function (first, second) {
                var priorityDifference = getMedicationRoutePriority(first.route) - getMedicationRoutePriority(second.route);
                if (priorityDifference) return priorityDifference;
                var nameDifference = first.name.localeCompare(second.name, undefined, { sensitivity: 'base', numeric: true });
                if (nameDifference) return nameDifference;
                return getMedicationOrderTimestamp(first.effectiveAt, first.sourceIndex) - getMedicationOrderTimestamp(second.effectiveAt, second.sourceIndex);
            });
            return orders;
        }

        function createNursingMedicationRow(section, columnCount) {
            var row = document.createElement('tr');
            row.style.height = '22px';
            row.setAttribute('data-generated-medication-row', 'true');
            for (var index = 0; index < columnCount + 3; index++) row.appendChild(document.createElement('td'));
            section.body.insertBefore(row, section.ioHeaderRow);
            return row;
        }

        function getNursingMedicationFrequency(order) {
            if (!order) return 0;
            if (order.scheduleType === 'bid') return 2;
            if (order.scheduleType === 'tid') return 3;
            if (order.scheduleType === 'qid') return 4;
            if (order.scheduleType === 'qh') {
                var qHours = parseFloat(order.qHours);
                return qHours > 0 ? 24 / qHours : 0;
            }
            return ['m', 'a', 'e', 'n'].reduce(function (total, key) {
                return total + (parseFloat(order[key]) > 0 ? 1 : 0);
            }, 0);
        }

        function getNursingMedicationIntervalHours(frequency) {
            return { 1: 24, 2: 12, 3: 8, 4: 6 }[frequency] || 0;
        }

        function formatNursingMedicationTime(date) {
            if (!(date instanceof Date) || isNaN(date.getTime())) return '';
            return String(date.getHours()).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
        }

        function formatNursingMedicationDate(date) {
            if (!(date instanceof Date) || isNaN(date.getTime())) return '';
            return String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0') + '/' + String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
        }

        function formatNursingMedicationDateTime(date) {
            if (!(date instanceof Date) || isNaN(date.getTime())) return '';
            return formatNursingMedicationDate(date) + '/' + date.getFullYear() + ' ' + formatNursingMedicationTime(date);
        }

        function getNursingMedicationDateKey(date) {
            if (!(date instanceof Date) || isNaN(date.getTime())) return '';
            return date.getFullYear() + '-' + String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
        }

        function buildIntervalMedicationScheduleStates(startTime, intervalHours, durationDays, capacity) {
            var doseCount = intervalHours > 0 && isFinite(durationDays) && durationDays > 0
                ? Math.ceil((durationDays * 24) / intervalHours)
                : (intervalHours > 0 ? capacity : 1);
            doseCount = Math.min(256, Math.max(1, doseCount));
            var states = [];
            var previousDateKey = '';
            for (var index = 0; index < doseCount; index++) {
                var scheduledTime = new Date(startTime.getTime() + (index * intervalHours * 60 * 60 * 1000));
                var dateKey = getNursingMedicationDateKey(scheduledTime);
                states.push({
                    scheduledAt: scheduledTime.toISOString(),
                    actualAt: '',
                    showDate: index === 0 || dateKey !== previousDateKey
                });
                previousDateKey = dateKey;
            }
            return states;
        }

        function buildNursingMedicationScheduleStates(startTime, frequency, durationDays, capacity) {
            return buildIntervalMedicationScheduleStates(startTime, getNursingMedicationIntervalHours(frequency), durationDays, capacity);
        }

        function getMedicationWardTimes(scheduleType) {
            if (scheduleType === 'bid') return [[6, 0], [19, 0]];
            if (scheduleType === 'tid') return [[6, 0], [14, 0], [19, 0]];
            return [];
        }

        function buildWardRoundMedicationScheduleStates(startTime, scheduleType, durationDays, capacity) {
            var wardTimes = getMedicationWardTimes(scheduleType);
            if (!wardTimes.length) return [];
            var hasDuration = isFinite(durationDays) && durationDays > 0;
            var endTime = hasDuration ? new Date(startTime.getTime() + durationDays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) : null;
            var stateLimit = Math.min(256, hasDuration ? Math.ceil(durationDays * wardTimes.length) + wardTimes.length : capacity);
            stateLimit = Math.max(1, stateLimit);
            var dayCursor = new Date(startTime.getFullYear(), startTime.getMonth(), startTime.getDate());
            var states = [];
            var previousDateKey = '';
            var safetyDays = 0;
            while (states.length < stateLimit && safetyDays < 370) {
                for (var timeIndex = 0; timeIndex < wardTimes.length && states.length < stateLimit; timeIndex++) {
                    var scheduledTime = new Date(dayCursor.getFullYear(), dayCursor.getMonth(), dayCursor.getDate(), wardTimes[timeIndex][0], wardTimes[timeIndex][1], 0, 0);
                    if (scheduledTime.getTime() < startTime.getTime()) continue;
                    if (endTime && scheduledTime.getTime() >= endTime.getTime()) return states;
                    var dateKey = getNursingMedicationDateKey(scheduledTime);
                    states.push({
                        scheduledAt: scheduledTime.toISOString(),
                        actualAt: '',
                        showDate: states.length === 0 || dateKey !== previousDateKey
                    });
                    previousDateKey = dateKey;
                }
                dayCursor.setDate(dayCursor.getDate() + 1);
                safetyDays++;
            }
            return states;
        }

        function parseMedicationIntervalItems(value) {
            var intervals = [];
            var source = String(value || '');
            var expression = /(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(hours?|hrs?|hr|h|ម៉ោង|minutes?|mins?|min|m|នាទី)/gi;
            var match;
            while ((match = expression.exec(source)) !== null) {
                var amount = parseFloat(match[1]);
                var unit = String(match[2] || '').toLocaleLowerCase();
                var isHours = /^(h|hr|hrs|hour|hours|ម៉ោង)$/.test(unit);
                if (isFinite(amount) && amount > 0) {
                    intervals.push({ value: match[1], unit: isHours ? 'hours' : 'minutes', minutes: isHours ? amount * 60 : amount });
                }
            }
            return intervals;
        }

        function parseMedicationIntervalSequence(value) {
            return parseMedicationIntervalItems(value).map(function (interval) { return interval.minutes; });
        }

        function getProtocolRepeatMinutes(order) {
            var amount = parseFloat(order && order.protocolRepeatValue);
            if (!isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) return 0;
            return order.protocolRepeatUnit === 'minutes' ? amount : amount * 60;
        }

        function buildProtocolMedicationScheduleStates(startTime, order, capacity) {
            var intervals = parseMedicationIntervalSequence(order.protocolIntervals);
            var repeatMinutes = getProtocolRepeatMinutes(order);
            var maxDoses = parseInt(order.protocolMaxDoses, 10);
            if (!isFinite(maxDoses) || maxDoses < 1) maxDoses = 0;
            var stopAt = order.protocolStopAt ? new Date(order.protocolStopAt) : null;
            if (stopAt && isNaN(stopAt.getTime())) stopAt = null;
            var openEnded = repeatMinutes > 0 && !maxDoses && !stopAt;
            var safetyLimit = Math.min(256, maxDoses || (repeatMinutes && stopAt ? 256 : (openEnded ? capacity : intervals.length + 1)));
            safetyLimit = Math.max(1, safetyLimit);
            var states = [];
            var currentTime = new Date(startTime.getTime());
            var previousDateKey = '';
            for (var index = 0; index < safetyLimit; index++) {
                var dateKey = getNursingMedicationDateKey(currentTime);
                states.push({
                    scheduledAt: currentTime.toISOString(),
                    actualAt: '',
                    showDate: index === 0 || dateKey !== previousDateKey
                });
                previousDateKey = dateKey;
                if (maxDoses && states.length >= maxDoses) break;
                var intervalMinutes = index < intervals.length ? intervals[index] : repeatMinutes;
                if (!intervalMinutes) break;
                var nextTime = new Date(currentTime.getTime() + intervalMinutes * 60000);
                if (stopAt && nextTime.getTime() > stopAt.getTime()) break;
                currentTime = nextTime;
            }
            return states;
        }

        function buildMedicationScheduleStates(startTime, order, capacity) {
            if (order && order.timingMode === 'protocol') {
                return buildProtocolMedicationScheduleStates(startTime, order, capacity);
            }
            if (order && (order.scheduleType === 'bid' || order.scheduleType === 'tid')) {
                return buildWardRoundMedicationScheduleStates(startTime, order.scheduleType, parseFloat(order.d), capacity);
            }
            if (order && order.scheduleType === 'qid') {
                return buildIntervalMedicationScheduleStates(startTime, 6, parseFloat(order.d), capacity);
            }
            if (order && order.scheduleType === 'qh') {
                return buildIntervalMedicationScheduleStates(startTime, parseFloat(order.qHours), parseFloat(order.d), capacity);
            }
            return buildNursingMedicationScheduleStates(
                startTime,
                getNursingMedicationFrequency(order),
                parseFloat(order && order.d),
                capacity
            );
        }

        function isOpenEndedMedicationOrder(order) {
            if (!order) return false;
            if (order.timingMode === 'protocol') {
                return getProtocolRepeatMinutes(order) > 0 && !(parseInt(order.protocolMaxDoses, 10) > 0) && !normalizeNursingCellText(order.protocolStopAt);
            }
            if (order.scheduleType === 'bid' || order.scheduleType === 'tid' || order.scheduleType === 'qid' || order.scheduleType === 'qh') {
                return !(parseFloat(order.d) > 0);
            }
            return getNursingMedicationFrequency(order) > 0 && !(parseFloat(order.d) > 0);
        }

        function captureNursingMedicationCellState(cell) {
            if (!cell) return null;
            var scheduledAt = cell.getAttribute('data-scheduled-at') || '';
            if (!scheduledAt) {
                if (cell.getAttribute('data-order-start-placeholder') === 'true') return null;
                var legacyText = normalizeNursingCellText(cell.textContent);
                return legacyText ? { legacyText: legacyText } : null;
            }
            return {
                scheduledAt: scheduledAt,
                actualAt: cell.getAttribute('data-actual-at') || '',
                showDate: cell.getAttribute('data-show-date') === 'true'
            };
        }

        function clearNursingMedicationDoseCell(cell) {
            if (!cell) return;
            cell.textContent = '';
            cell.removeAttribute('data-scheduled-at');
            cell.removeAttribute('data-actual-at');
            cell.removeAttribute('data-show-date');
            cell.removeAttribute('data-order-start-placeholder');
            cell.classList.remove('nursing-med-given');
            cell.setAttribute('title', currentLang === 'khmer' ? 'ចុចពីរដងដើម្បីចាប់ផ្តើមម៉ោងផ្តល់ឱសថ' : 'Double-click to start the medication schedule');
            cell.setAttribute('aria-label', currentLang === 'khmer' ? 'ម៉ោងផ្តល់ឱសថ' : 'Medication administration time');
        }

        function renderNursingMedicationDoseCell(cell, state) {
            clearNursingMedicationDoseCell(cell);
            if (!state) return;
            if (state.legacyText) {
                cell.textContent = state.legacyText;
                return;
            }

            var scheduled = new Date(state.scheduledAt);
            var actual = state.actualAt ? new Date(state.actualAt) : null;
            if (isNaN(scheduled.getTime())) return;
            if (actual && isNaN(actual.getTime())) actual = null;

            cell.setAttribute('data-scheduled-at', scheduled.toISOString());
            if (actual) cell.setAttribute('data-actual-at', actual.toISOString());
            cell.setAttribute('data-show-date', 'true');
            cell.classList.toggle('nursing-med-given', !!actual);

            var dose = document.createElement('div');
            dose.className = 'nursing-med-dose';

            var dateLabel = document.createElement('span');
            dateLabel.className = 'nursing-med-dose-date';
            dateLabel.textContent = formatNursingMedicationDate(actual || scheduled);
            dose.appendChild(dateLabel);

            var doseMain = document.createElement('span');
            doseMain.className = 'nursing-med-dose-main';
            var checkbox = document.createElement('input');
            checkbox.type = 'checkbox';
            checkbox.className = 'nursing-med-dose-check';
            checkbox.checked = !!actual;
            var timeLabel = document.createElement('span');
            timeLabel.className = 'nursing-med-dose-time';
            timeLabel.textContent = formatNursingMedicationTime(actual || scheduled);
            doseMain.appendChild(checkbox);
            doseMain.appendChild(timeLabel);
            dose.appendChild(doseMain);
            cell.appendChild(dose);

            var plannedText = formatNursingMedicationDateTime(scheduled);
            var actualText = actual ? formatNursingMedicationDateTime(actual) : '';
            if (currentLang === 'khmer') {
                checkbox.setAttribute('aria-label', actual ? 'បានផ្តល់ឱសថនៅម៉ោង ' + actualText : 'ធីកបន្ទាប់ពីផ្តល់ឱសថ ម៉ោងគ្រោង ' + plannedText);
                cell.setAttribute('title', actual ? 'ម៉ោងគ្រោង៖ ' + plannedText + ' • ម៉ោងបានផ្តល់៖ ' + actualText + ' • ចុចពីរដងដើម្បីកែម៉ោងបានផ្តល់' : 'ម៉ោងគ្រោង៖ ' + plannedText + ' • ធីកបន្ទាប់ពីផ្តល់ឱសថ');
            } else {
                checkbox.setAttribute('aria-label', actual ? 'Medication given at ' + actualText : 'Check after giving the dose scheduled for ' + plannedText);
                cell.setAttribute('title', actual ? 'Scheduled: ' + plannedText + ' • Given: ' + actualText + ' • Double-click to edit the given time' : 'Scheduled: ' + plannedText + ' • Check after giving the dose');
            }
        }

        function renderNursingMedicationStartDatePlaceholder(cell, effectiveAt) {
            clearNursingMedicationDoseCell(cell);
            var effectiveDate = effectiveAt ? new Date(effectiveAt) : null;
            if (!effectiveDate || isNaN(effectiveDate.getTime())) return;
            cell.setAttribute('data-order-start-placeholder', 'true');
            var label = document.createElement('span');
            label.className = 'nursing-med-start-date';
            label.textContent = formatNursingMedicationDate(effectiveDate);
            cell.appendChild(label);
            cell.setAttribute('title', currentLang === 'khmer' ? 'កាលបរិច្ឆេទចាប់ផ្តើម • ចុចពីរដងដើម្បីចាប់ផ្តើមម៉ោងផ្តល់ឱសថ' : 'Effective date • Double-click to start the medication schedule');
        }

        function captureNursingMedicationSchedules(table) {
            var section = getNursingMedicationSection(table);
            if (!section) return table._nursingMedicationSchedules || {};
            var columnCount = getNursingMedicationColumnCount(table);
            var captured = {};
            section.rows.forEach(function (row) {
                var key = row.getAttribute('data-medication-key');
                if (!key) return;
                var segmentIndex = parseInt(row.getAttribute('data-medication-segment-index'), 10) || 0;
                if (!captured[key]) captured[key] = [];
                getNursingTrailingCells(row, columnCount).forEach(function (cell, cellIndex) {
                    var state = captureNursingMedicationCellState(cell);
                    if (state) captured[key][segmentIndex * columnCount + cellIndex] = state;
                });
            });
            Object.keys(captured).forEach(function (key) {
                while (captured[key].length && !captured[key][captured[key].length - 1]) captured[key].pop();
            });
            table._nursingMedicationSchedules = Object.assign({}, table._nursingMedicationSchedules || {}, captured);
            return table._nursingMedicationSchedules;
        }

        function persistNursingMedicationScheduleFromRow(row) {
            var table = row && row.closest ? row.closest('.vital-tbl') : null;
            if (table) captureNursingMedicationSchedules(table);
        }

        function getNursingMedicationSavedSchedule(store, order, usedLegacyKeys) {
            if (store[order.key]) return store[order.key];
            var legacyKey = normalizeNursingCellText(order.name).toLocaleLowerCase();
            if (!usedLegacyKeys[legacyKey] && store[legacyKey]) {
                usedLegacyKeys[legacyKey] = true;
                store[order.key] = store[legacyKey];
                return store[order.key];
            }
            return [];
        }

        function syncNursingMedicationTable(table, orders, preserveStoredSchedules) {
            var section = getNursingMedicationSection(table);
            if (!section) return;
            var columnCount = getNursingMedicationColumnCount(table);
            var savedSchedules = preserveStoredSchedules
                ? (table._nursingMedicationSchedules || {})
                : captureNursingMedicationSchedules(table);
            var usedLegacyKeys = {};
            var descriptors = [];
            orders.forEach(function (order) {
                var schedule = getNursingMedicationSavedSchedule(savedSchedules, order, usedLegacyKeys);
                if (!schedule.length && order.effectiveAt) {
                    var effectiveStart = new Date(order.effectiveAt);
                    if (!isNaN(effectiveStart.getTime())) {
                        schedule = buildMedicationScheduleStates(effectiveStart, order, columnCount);
                        savedSchedules[order.key] = schedule;
                    }
                }
                var segmentCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(schedule.length / columnCount));
                for (var segmentIndex = 0; segmentIndex < segmentCount; segmentIndex++) {
                    descriptors.push({
                        order: order,
                        segmentIndex: segmentIndex,
                        schedule: schedule.slice(segmentIndex * columnCount, (segmentIndex + 1) * columnCount)
                    });
                }
            });

            while (section.rows.length < Math.max(5, descriptors.length)) {
                section.rows.push(createNursingMedicationRow(section, columnCount));
            }
            while (section.rows.length > Math.max(5, descriptors.length)) {
                var lastRow = section.rows[section.rows.length - 1];
                if (lastRow.getAttribute('data-generated-medication-row') !== 'true') break;
                lastRow.remove();
                section.rows.pop();
            }

            section.rows.forEach(function (row, rowIndex) {
                var descriptor = descriptors[rowIndex] || null;
                var order = descriptor ? descriptor.order : null;
                var cells = Array.prototype.slice.call(row.cells);
                var sourceCells = cells.slice(0, 3);
                var timeCells = cells.slice(3);

                sourceCells.forEach(function (cell) {
                    cell.removeAttribute('contenteditable');
                    cell.classList.remove('nursing-editable-cell');
                    cell.classList.add('nursing-medication-source-cell');
                });
                timeCells.forEach(function (cell, timeIndex) {
                    cell.removeAttribute('contenteditable');
                    cell.removeAttribute('inputmode');
                    cell.classList.remove('nursing-editable-cell');
                    cell.classList.add('nursing-med-time-cell');
                    var state = descriptor ? descriptor.schedule[timeIndex] : null;
                    if (state && timeIndex === 0 && descriptor.segmentIndex > 0 && state.scheduledAt) {
                        state = Object.assign({}, state, { showDate: true });
                    }
                    renderNursingMedicationDoseCell(cell, state);
                });

                row.classList.toggle('nursing-medication-continuation', !!(descriptor && descriptor.segmentIndex > 0));
                if (order) {
                    var frequency = getNursingMedicationFrequency(order);
                    var intervalHours = order.scheduleType === 'qid' ? 6 : (order.scheduleType === 'qh' ? parseFloat(order.qHours) || 0 : getNursingMedicationIntervalHours(frequency));
                    row._nursingMedicationOrder = order;
                    row.setAttribute('data-medication-key', order.key);
                    row.setAttribute('data-medication-segment-index', String(descriptor.segmentIndex));
                    row.setAttribute('data-medication-frequency', String(frequency));
                    row.setAttribute('data-medication-interval-hours', String(intervalHours));
                    row.setAttribute('data-medication-duration-days', normalizeNursingCellText(order.d || ''));
                    row.setAttribute('data-medication-timing-mode', order.timingMode || 'regular');
                    row.setAttribute('data-medication-schedule-type', order.scheduleType || '');
                    sourceCells[0].textContent = order.name;
                    sourceCells[1].textContent = order.dose;
                    sourceCells[2].textContent = getNursingMedicationRouteLabel(order.route);
                    if (!descriptor.schedule.length && descriptor.segmentIndex === 0 && timeCells[0]) {
                        renderNursingMedicationStartDatePlaceholder(timeCells[0], order.effectiveAt);
                    }
                } else {
                    row._nursingMedicationOrder = null;
                    row.removeAttribute('data-medication-key');
                    row.removeAttribute('data-medication-segment-index');
                    row.removeAttribute('data-medication-frequency');
                    row.removeAttribute('data-medication-interval-hours');
                    row.removeAttribute('data-medication-duration-days');
                    row.removeAttribute('data-medication-timing-mode');
                    row.removeAttribute('data-medication-schedule-type');
                    sourceCells.forEach(function (cell) { cell.textContent = ''; });
                }
            });
        }

        function syncNursingMedicationOrders() {
            var orders = collectNursingMedicationOrders();
            document.querySelectorAll('#sub_nursing .vital-tbl').forEach(function (table) {
                syncNursingMedicationTable(table, orders);
            });
        }

        function getCurrentNursingTime() {
            var now = new Date();
            return String(now.getHours()).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
        }

        function parseNursingMedicationTime(value, date) {
            var enteredTime = normalizeNursingCellText(value);
            var match = enteredTime.match(/^([01]?\d|2[0-3])[:.]([0-5]\d)$/);
            if (!match) return null;
            var result = new Date(date instanceof Date ? date.getTime() : Date.now());
            result.setHours(parseInt(match[1], 10), parseInt(match[2], 10), 0, 0);
            return result;
        }

        function showNursingMedicationTimeError() {
            window.alert(currentLang === 'khmer' ? 'សូមបញ្ចូលម៉ោងតាមទម្រង់ HH:mm ឧទាហរណ៍ 08:30' : 'Enter the time as HH:mm, for example 08:30');
        }

        function startNursingMedicationSchedule(row) {
            if (!row) return;
            var table = row.closest('.vital-tbl');
            var columnCount = getNursingMedicationColumnCount(table);
            if (!columnCount || !table) return;

            var enteredTime = window.prompt(
                currentLang === 'khmer' ? 'ម៉ោងផ្តល់ឱសថលើកដំបូង (HH:mm)' : 'First medication administration time (HH:mm)',
                getCurrentNursingTime()
            );
            if (enteredTime === null) return;
            var startTime = parseNursingMedicationTime(enteredTime, new Date());
            if (!startTime) {
                showNursingMedicationTimeError();
                return;
            }

            var order = row._nursingMedicationOrder;
            if (!order) return;
            var states = buildMedicationScheduleStates(startTime, order, columnCount);
            if (order.timingMode === 'protocol' && states.length === 1 && !parseMedicationIntervalSequence(order.protocolIntervals).length && !getProtocolRepeatMinutes(order)) {
                window.alert(currentLang === 'khmer'
                    ? 'គ្រូពេទ្យមិនទាន់បញ្ចូលចន្លោះពេលក្នុងពិធីសារព្យាបាលទេ។ បានកត់ត្រាតែម៉ោងលើកដំបូង។'
                    : 'No protocol intervals were entered by the doctor. Only the first administration time was recorded.');
            }
            var store = captureNursingMedicationSchedules(table);
            store[order.key] = states;
            table._nursingMedicationSchedules = store;
            syncNursingMedicationTable(table, collectNursingMedicationOrders(), true);
        }

        function extendOpenEndedNursingMedicationSchedule(row, completedCell) {
            var table = row && row.closest ? row.closest('.vital-tbl') : null;
            var order = row ? row._nursingMedicationOrder : null;
            if (!table || !order || !isOpenEndedMedicationOrder(order)) return;
            var columnCount = getNursingMedicationColumnCount(table);
            var segmentIndex = parseInt(row.getAttribute('data-medication-segment-index'), 10) || 0;
            var cellIndex = getNursingTrailingCells(row, columnCount).indexOf(completedCell);
            var store = captureNursingMedicationSchedules(table);
            var states = store[order.key] || [];
            var globalIndex = segmentIndex * columnCount + cellIndex;
            if (globalIndex !== states.length - 1 || !states[globalIndex] || !states[globalIndex].actualAt || states.length >= 256) return;

            var previousTime = new Date(states[states.length - 1].scheduledAt);
            var previousDateKey = getNursingMedicationDateKey(previousTime);
            for (var index = 0; index < columnCount && states.length < 256; index++) {
                previousTime = getNextMedicationScheduledTime(previousTime, order);
                if (!previousTime) break;
                var dateKey = getNursingMedicationDateKey(previousTime);
                states.push({
                    scheduledAt: previousTime.toISOString(),
                    actualAt: '',
                    showDate: dateKey !== previousDateKey
                });
                previousDateKey = dateKey;
            }
            store[order.key] = states;
            table._nursingMedicationSchedules = store;
            syncNursingMedicationTable(table, collectNursingMedicationOrders(), true);
        }

        function getNextMedicationScheduledTime(previousTime, order) {
            if (!(previousTime instanceof Date) || isNaN(previousTime.getTime()) || !order) return null;
            if (order.timingMode === 'protocol') {
                var protocolMinutes = getProtocolRepeatMinutes(order);
                return protocolMinutes > 0 ? new Date(previousTime.getTime() + protocolMinutes * 60000) : null;
            }
            if (order.scheduleType === 'bid' || order.scheduleType === 'tid') {
                var wardTimes = getMedicationWardTimes(order.scheduleType);
                for (var dayOffset = 0; dayOffset < 3; dayOffset++) {
                    for (var timeIndex = 0; timeIndex < wardTimes.length; timeIndex++) {
                        var candidate = new Date(previousTime.getFullYear(), previousTime.getMonth(), previousTime.getDate() + dayOffset, wardTimes[timeIndex][0], wardTimes[timeIndex][1], 0, 0);
                        if (candidate.getTime() > previousTime.getTime()) return candidate;
                    }
                }
                return null;
            }
            var intervalHours = order.scheduleType === 'qid'
                ? 6
                : (order.scheduleType === 'qh' ? parseFloat(order.qHours) : getNursingMedicationIntervalHours(getNursingMedicationFrequency(order)));
            return intervalHours > 0 ? new Date(previousTime.getTime() + intervalHours * 60 * 60 * 1000) : null;
        }

        function updateNursingMedicationGivenState(checkbox) {
            var cell = checkbox && checkbox.closest ? checkbox.closest('td.nursing-med-time-cell') : null;
            if (!cell) return;
            var state = captureNursingMedicationCellState(cell);
            if (!state || !state.scheduledAt) return;
            state.actualAt = checkbox.checked ? new Date().toISOString() : '';
            renderNursingMedicationDoseCell(cell, state);
            var row = cell.closest('tr[data-medication-key]');
            persistNursingMedicationScheduleFromRow(row);
            if (checkbox.checked) extendOpenEndedNursingMedicationSchedule(row, cell);
        }

        function editNursingMedicationGivenTime(cell) {
            var state = captureNursingMedicationCellState(cell);
            if (!state || !state.actualAt) return;
            var actualTime = new Date(state.actualAt);
            var enteredTime = window.prompt(
                currentLang === 'khmer' ? 'កែម៉ោងដែលបានផ្តល់ឱសថ (HH:mm)' : 'Edit the actual administration time (HH:mm)',
                formatNursingMedicationTime(actualTime)
            );
            if (enteredTime === null) return;
            var editedTime = parseNursingMedicationTime(enteredTime, actualTime);
            if (!editedTime) {
                showNursingMedicationTimeError();
                return;
            }
            state.actualAt = editedTime.toISOString();
            renderNursingMedicationDoseCell(cell, state);
            persistNursingMedicationScheduleFromRow(cell.closest('tr[data-medication-key]'));
        }

        function refreshNursingMedicationScheduleLanguage() {
            document.querySelectorAll('#sub_nursing td.nursing-med-time-cell[data-scheduled-at]').forEach(function (cell) {
                renderNursingMedicationDoseCell(cell, captureNursingMedicationCellState(cell));
            });
        }

        function initializeNursingEditableTables() {
            document.querySelectorAll('#sub_nursing .vital-tbl').forEach(function (table) {
                if (!table.getAttribute('data-nursing-events-bound')) {
                    table.setAttribute('data-nursing-events-bound', 'true');
                    table.addEventListener('input', function (event) {
                        if (event.target && event.target.classList.contains('nursing-io-entry-cell')) {
                            calculateNursingFluidTotals(table);
                        }
                    });
                    table.addEventListener('change', function (event) {
                        if (event.target && event.target.classList.contains('nursing-med-dose-check')) {
                            updateNursingMedicationGivenState(event.target);
                        }
                    });
                    table.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
                        if (event.target && event.target.classList.contains('nursing-editable-cell') && event.key === 'Enter') {
                            event.preventDefault();
                        }
                    });
                    table.addEventListener('dblclick', function (event) {
                        var cell = event.target && event.target.closest ? event.target.closest('td.nursing-med-time-cell') : null;
                        if (!cell || !table.contains(cell)) return;
                        if (event.target && event.target.classList && event.target.classList.contains('nursing-med-dose-check')) return;
                        event.preventDefault();
                        if (cell.getAttribute('data-actual-at')) {
                            editNursingMedicationGivenTime(cell);
                            return;
                        }
                        var medicationRow = cell.closest('tr[data-medication-key]');
                        if (!medicationRow || medicationRow.querySelector('td.nursing-med-time-cell[data-scheduled-at]')) return;
                        startNursingMedicationSchedule(medicationRow);
                    });
                }

                var rows = table.tBodies && table.tBodies[0] ? Array.prototype.slice.call(table.tBodies[0].rows) : [];
                rows.forEach(function (row, rowIndex) {
                    var chartManaged = rowIndex < 2 || row.classList.contains('graph-tr') || row.classList.contains('nursing-resp-row') || row.classList.contains('nursing-spo2-row');
                    if (chartManaged || row.closest('.midwife-assessment-pages')) return;
                    Array.prototype.slice.call(row.cells).forEach(function (cell) {
                        if (cell.classList.contains('nursing-calculated-cell') || cell.classList.contains('nursing-med-time-cell') || cell.classList.contains('nursing-medication-source-cell')) return;
                        if (!normalizeNursingCellText(cell.textContent) && !cell.children.length) {
                            cell.classList.add('nursing-editable-cell');
                            cell.setAttribute('contenteditable', 'true');
                            cell.setAttribute('role', 'textbox');
                        }
                    });
                });
                calculateNursingFluidTotals(table);
            });
        }

        function bindNursingMedicationSources() {
            var tbody = document.getElementById('rx_tbody');
            if (!tbody || tbody.getAttribute('data-nursing-sync-bound')) return;
            tbody.setAttribute('data-nursing-sync-bound', 'true');
            tbody.addEventListener('input', syncNursingMedicationOrders);
            tbody.addEventListener('change', syncNursingMedicationOrders);
        }

        function refreshNursingInteractiveTables() {
            syncNursingMedicationOrders();
            initializeNursingEditableTables();
        }

        function getNursingCareTimestamp() {
            var now = new Date();
            var day = String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
            var month = String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
            var year = now.getFullYear();
            var hours = String(now.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
            var minutes = String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
            return day + '/' + month + '/' + year + ' at ' + hours + ':' + minutes;
        }

        function initializeNursingCareCanvas(canvas) {
            if (!canvas || canvas.getAttribute('data-nursing-canvas-ready')) return;
            canvas.setAttribute('data-nursing-canvas-ready', 'true');
            var page = canvas.closest('.nursing-care-wound-page');
            var context = canvas.getContext('2d');
            if (!page || !context) return;
            var colorControl = page.querySelector('[data-nursing-brush-color]');
            var sizeControl = page.querySelector('[data-nursing-brush-size]');
            var clearControl = page.querySelector('[data-nursing-clear-canvas]');
            var undoControl = page.querySelector('[data-nursing-undo-canvas]');
            var bodyImage = new Image();
            var bodyImageReady = false;
            /* Each stroke is stored as { points: [{x,y},...], color, width } */
            var strokes = [];
            var currentStroke = null;
            var isDrawing = false;

            function getPoint(event) {
                var rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
                return {
                    x: (event.clientX - rect.left) * (canvas.width / rect.width),
                    y: (event.clientY - rect.top) * (canvas.height / rect.height)
                };
            }

            function drawStroke(stroke) {
                if (!stroke.points || stroke.points.length < 2) return;
                context.beginPath();
                context.moveTo(stroke.points[0].x, stroke.points[0].y);
                for (var i = 1; i < stroke.points.length; i++) {
                    context.lineTo(stroke.points[i].x, stroke.points[i].y);
                }
                context.strokeStyle = stroke.color;
                context.lineWidth = stroke.width;
                context.lineCap = 'round';
                context.lineJoin = 'round';
                context.stroke();
            }

            function redrawCanvas() {
                context.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
                if (bodyImageReady && bodyImage.width && bodyImage.height) {
                    var scale = Math.min(canvas.width / bodyImage.width, canvas.height / bodyImage.height);
                    var imageWidth = bodyImage.width * scale;
                    var imageHeight = bodyImage.height * scale;
                    context.drawImage(
                        bodyImage,
                        (canvas.width - imageWidth) / 2,
                        (canvas.height - imageHeight) / 2,
                        imageWidth,
                        imageHeight
                    );
                }
                strokes.forEach(drawStroke);
                if (isDrawing && currentStroke) {
                    drawStroke(currentStroke);
                }
            }

            function startDrawing(event) {
                if (event.button !== undefined && event.button !== 0) return;
                isDrawing = true;
                var pt = getPoint(event);
                currentStroke = {
                    points: [pt],
                    color: colorControl ? colorControl.value : '#ef4444',
                    width: sizeControl ? Number(sizeControl.value) || 3 : 3
                };
                if (canvas.setPointerCapture && event.pointerId !== undefined) {
                    try { canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (error) { }
                }
                event.preventDefault();
            }

            function moveDrawing(event) {
                if (!isDrawing || !currentStroke) return;
                currentStroke.points.push(getPoint(event));
                redrawCanvas();
                event.preventDefault();
            }

            function stopDrawing(event) {
                if (!isDrawing || !currentStroke) return;
                currentStroke.points.push(getPoint(event));
                if (currentStroke.points.length >= 2) {
                    strokes.push(currentStroke);
                }
                isDrawing = false;
                currentStroke = null;
                if (canvas.releasePointerCapture && event.pointerId !== undefined) {
                    try { canvas.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (error) { }
                }
                redrawCanvas();
                event.preventDefault();
            }

            canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', startDrawing);
            canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', moveDrawing);
            canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', stopDrawing);
            canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel', function (event) {
                if (!isDrawing) return;
                isDrawing = false;
                currentStroke = null;
                redrawCanvas();
                event.preventDefault();
            });
            if (undoControl) {
                undoControl.addEventListener('click', function () {
                    if (strokes.length) strokes.pop();
                    currentStroke = null;
                    isDrawing = false;
                    redrawCanvas();
                });
            }
            if (clearControl) {
                clearControl.addEventListener('click', function () {
                    strokes = [];
                    currentStroke = null;
                    isDrawing = false;
                    redrawCanvas();
                });
            }
            bodyImage.onload = function () {
                bodyImageReady = true;
                redrawCanvas();
            };
            bodyImage.onerror = function () {
                bodyImageReady = false;
                redrawCanvas();
            };
            bodyImage.src = '/public/anatomy-position.png';
            redrawCanvas();
        }

        function initializeNursingCarePages() {
            document.querySelectorAll('#sub_nursing .nursing-care-pages').forEach(function (block) {
                if (!block.getAttribute('data-nursing-care-bound')) {
                    block.setAttribute('data-nursing-care-bound', 'true');
                    block.addEventListener('input', function (event) {
                        var statusField = event.target && event.target.matches('[data-nursing-auto-timestamp]') ? event.target : null;
                        if (!statusField || !normalizeNursingCellText(statusField.value)) return;
                        var page = statusField.closest('.nursing-care-page');
                        var dateField = page ? page.querySelector('[data-nursing-date]') : null;
                        if (dateField && !normalizeNursingCellText(dateField.value)) {
                            dateField.value = getNursingCareTimestamp();
                        }
                    });
                }
                block.querySelectorAll('[data-nursing-body-canvas]').forEach(initializeNursingCareCanvas);
            });
        }

        function getNursingVitalRecords() {
            var records = [];
            var triageRecord = {
                source: 'triage',
                dtVal: '',
                temp: nursingNumber(document.getElementById('p2_temp') ? document.getElementById('p2_temp').value : ''),
                bp_sys: nursingNumber(document.getElementById('p2_bp_sys') ? document.getElementById('p2_bp_sys').value : ''),
                bp_dia: nursingNumber(document.getElementById('p2_bp_dia') ? document.getElementById('p2_bp_dia').value : ''),
                pulse: nursingNumber(document.getElementById('p2_pulse') ? document.getElementById('p2_pulse').value : ''),
                resp: nursingNumber(document.getElementById('p2_resp') ? document.getElementById('p2_resp').value : ''),
                spo2: nursingNumber(document.getElementById('p2_spo2') ? document.getElementById('p2_spo2').value : '')
            };
            var triageDate = document.getElementById('web_date') ? document.getElementById('web_date').value : '';
            var triageTime = document.getElementById('web_time') ? document.getElementById('web_time').value : '';
            triageRecord.dtVal = triageDate ? triageDate + (triageTime ? 'T' + triageTime : '') : '';

            if ([triageRecord.temp, triageRecord.bp_sys, triageRecord.bp_dia, triageRecord.pulse, triageRecord.resp, triageRecord.spo2].some(function (value) { return value !== null; })) {
                records.push(triageRecord);
            }

            var evolutionRecords = [];
            var feed = document.getElementById('daily_monitoring_feed');
            if (feed) {
                Array.prototype.slice.call(feed.querySelectorAll('.ipd-mon-card')).forEach(function (card) {
                    var data = card._monitoringCopyData;
                    if (!data) return;
                    evolutionRecords.push({
                        source: 'evolution',
                        dtVal: data.dtVal || '',
                        temp: nursingNumber(data.temp),
                        bp_sys: nursingNumber(data.bp_sys),
                        bp_dia: nursingNumber(data.bp_dia),
                        pulse: nursingNumber(data.pulse),
                        resp: nursingNumber(data.resp),
                        spo2: nursingNumber(data.spo2)
                    });
                });
            }

            evolutionRecords.sort(function (a, b) {
                if (!a.dtVal && !b.dtVal) return 0;
                if (!a.dtVal) return 1;
                if (!b.dtVal) return -1;
                return String(a.dtVal).localeCompare(String(b.dtVal));
            });
            return records.concat(evolutionRecords);
        }

        function classifyNursingBloodPressure(systolic, diastolic) {
            return assessBloodPressure(systolic, diastolic, getExactAge());
        }

        function formatNursingChartTime(record) {
            var text = record && record.dtVal ? String(record.dtVal) : '';
            var datePart = '';
            var timePart = '';
            if (text) {
                var parts = text.split('T');
                var dateBits = parts[0] ? parts[0].split('-') : [];
                datePart = dateBits.length === 3 ? dateBits[2] + '/' + dateBits[1] : (parts[0] || '');
                timePart = parts[1] ? parts[1].slice(0, 5) : '';
            }
            var sourceLabel = record && record.source === 'triage' ? 'T' : 'E';
            return sourceLabel + (datePart ? ' ' + datePart : '') + (timePart ? ' ' + timePart : '');
        }

        function nursingSvgElement(tagName, attributes) {
            var element = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', tagName);
            Object.keys(attributes || {}).forEach(function (name) {
                element.setAttribute(name, attributes[name]);
            });
            return element;
        }

        function addNursingSvgTitle(element, titleText) {
            var title = nursingSvgElement('title', {});
            title.textContent = titleText;
            element.appendChild(title);
        }

        function ensureNursingChartCapacity(table, recordCount) {
            var graphRows = table.querySelectorAll('tr.graph-tr');
            if (!graphRows.length) return;
            var currentCapacity = graphRows[0].querySelectorAll('.graph-td').length;
            // Keep one unused column after the final record so its value labels can stay on the right.
            var desiredCapacity = Math.max(16, recordCount + 1);
            if (desiredCapacity <= currentCapacity) return;

            var extraColumns = desiredCapacity - currentCapacity;
            var timeCol = table.querySelector('colgroup col[span]');
            if (timeCol) {
                timeCol.setAttribute('span', desiredCapacity);
                timeCol.style.width = (75 / desiredCapacity).toFixed(3) + '%';
            }

            Array.prototype.slice.call(table.tBodies[0].rows).forEach(function (row) {
                var timeSpanCell = Array.prototype.slice.call(row.cells).find(function (cell) {
                    return parseInt(cell.getAttribute('colspan') || '0', 10) === currentCapacity;
                });
                if (timeSpanCell) {
                    timeSpanCell.setAttribute('colspan', desiredCapacity);
                    return;
                }

                var fullSpanCell = Array.prototype.slice.call(row.cells).find(function (cell) {
                    return parseInt(cell.getAttribute('colspan') || '0', 10) === currentCapacity + 3;
                });
                if (fullSpanCell) {
                    fullSpanCell.setAttribute('colspan', desiredCapacity + 3);
                    return;
                }

                for (var index = 0; index < extraColumns; index++) {
                    var newCell = document.createElement('td');
                    if (row.classList.contains('graph-tr')) newCell.className = 'graph-td';
                    row.appendChild(newCell);
                }
            });
