            table.style.minWidth = Math.max(100, (desiredCapacity / 16) * 100) + '%';
        }

        function buildNursingChartLegend(parent, recordCount) {
            var legend = parent.querySelector('.nursing-chart-legend');
            if (!legend) {
                legend = document.createElement('div');
                legend.className = 'nursing-chart-legend';
                parent.insertBefore(legend, parent.firstChild);
            }

            var isKhmer = currentLang === 'khmer';
            legend.innerHTML = `
                <span class="nursing-legend-item"><span style="display:inline-block;width:18px;border-top:2px solid #f97316;"></span><span class="nursing-legend-dot" style="background:#fff;border:2px solid #f97316;"></span>${isKhmer ? 'សីតុណ្ហភាព' : 'Temperature'}</span>
                <span class="nursing-legend-item"><span style="display:inline-block;width:18px;border-top:2px dashed #2563eb;"></span><span class="nursing-legend-dot" style="background:#2563eb;border-radius:0;"></span>${isKhmer ? 'ជីពចរ' : 'Pulse'}</span>
                <span class="nursing-legend-item"><span class="nursing-legend-bp" style="border-color:#0088CC;"></span>${isKhmer ? 'សម្ពាធឈាម' : 'Blood pressure'}</span>
        `;
            legend.title = isKhmer
                ? 'ពណ៌ក្រហមជាការព្រមានឱ្យពិនិត្យឡើងវិញ មិនមែនជារោគវិនិច្ឆ័យទេ។'
                : 'Red is a screening review warning, not a diagnosis.';
        }

        function addNursingValueLabel(svg, registry, options) {
            var textValue = String(options.text);
            var estimatedWidth = Math.max(12, textValue.length * 4.1 + 3);
            var estimatedHeight = 9;
            var offsets = options.offsets || [0, -10, 10, -19, 19, -28, 28];
            var desiredX = options.x + (options.labelGap || 6);
            var chosenX = Math.max(options.bounds.left + 2, Math.min(options.bounds.right - estimatedWidth - 2, desiredX));
            var chosenY = options.y;

            for (var offsetIndex = 0; offsetIndex < offsets.length; offsetIndex++) {
                var candidateY = Math.max(options.bounds.top + estimatedHeight / 2, Math.min(options.bounds.bottom - estimatedHeight / 2, options.y + offsets[offsetIndex]));
                var candidateRect = {
                    left: chosenX,
                    right: chosenX + estimatedWidth,
                    top: candidateY - estimatedHeight / 2,
                    bottom: candidateY + estimatedHeight / 2
                };
                var overlaps = registry.some(function (existing) {
                    return !(candidateRect.right + 2 < existing.left || candidateRect.left - 2 > existing.right || candidateRect.bottom + 2 < existing.top || candidateRect.top - 2 > existing.bottom);
                });
                if (!overlaps || offsetIndex === offsets.length - 1) {
                    chosenY = candidateY;
                    registry.push(candidateRect);
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (Math.abs(chosenY - options.y) > 1) {
                svg.appendChild(nursingSvgElement('line', {
                    x1: options.x + 4,
                    y1: options.y,
                    x2: chosenX - 2,
                    y2: chosenY,
                    stroke: options.color,
                    class: 'nursing-label-leader ' + (options.className || '')
                }));
            }

            var text = nursingSvgElement('text', {
                x: chosenX,
                y: chosenY,
                fill: options.color,
                class: 'nursing-series-label ' + (options.className || ''),
                'text-anchor': 'start',
                'dominant-baseline': 'middle'
            });
            text.textContent = textValue;
            svg.appendChild(text);
        }

        function nursingYForScale(value, scaleValues, baselinePositions) {
            if (!scaleValues.length || scaleValues.length !== baselinePositions.length) return 0;
            var numericValue = nursingNumber(value);
            if (numericValue === null) return baselinePositions[baselinePositions.length - 1];
            if (numericValue >= scaleValues[0]) return baselinePositions[0];
            if (numericValue <= scaleValues[scaleValues.length - 1]) return baselinePositions[baselinePositions.length - 1];

            for (var index = 0; index < scaleValues.length - 1; index++) {
                var upperValue = scaleValues[index];
                var lowerValue = scaleValues[index + 1];
                if (numericValue <= upperValue && numericValue >= lowerValue) {
                    var ratio = (upperValue - numericValue) / (upperValue - lowerValue);
                    return baselinePositions[index] + ((baselinePositions[index + 1] - baselinePositions[index]) * ratio);
                }
            }
            return baselinePositions[baselinePositions.length - 1];
        }

        function drawNursingLineSeries(svg, records, xPositions, yForValue, fieldName, options, labelRegistry, bounds) {
            var previousPoint = null;
            records.forEach(function (record, index) {
                var value = record[fieldName];
                if (value === null || xPositions[index] === undefined) {
                    previousPoint = null;
                    return;
                }

                var assessment = assessVitalValue(fieldName, value, getExactAge());
                var point = { x: xPositions[index], y: yForValue(value) };
                if (previousPoint) {
                    svg.appendChild(nursingSvgElement('line', {
                        x1: previousPoint.x,
                        y1: previousPoint.y,
                        x2: point.x,
                        y2: point.y,
                        stroke: options.color,
                        'stroke-width': 2,
                        'stroke-linecap': 'round',
                        'stroke-dasharray': options.dashArray || '',
                        class: options.seriesClass
                    }));
                }

                var marker;
                if (options.marker === 'square') {
                    marker = nursingSvgElement('rect', {
                        x: point.x - 3.2, y: point.y - 3.2, width: 6.4, height: 6.4,
                        fill: options.color, stroke: options.color, 'stroke-width': 1,
                        class: 'marker-pulse'
                    });
                } else {
                    marker = nursingSvgElement('circle', {
                        cx: point.x, cy: point.y, r: 3.5,
                        fill: '#ffffff', stroke: options.color, 'stroke-width': 2,
                        class: 'marker-temp'
                    });
                }
                addNursingSvgTitle(marker, options.label + ': ' + value + (fieldName === 'temp' ? ' °C' : ' BPM'));
                svg.appendChild(marker);
                if (options.showLabels !== false) {
                    addNursingValueLabel(svg, labelRegistry, {
                        x: point.x,
                        y: point.y,
                        text: (assessment.abnormal ? '! ' : '') + (fieldName === 'temp' ? 'T ' + value + '°' : 'P ' + value),
                        color: assessment.abnormal ? '#dc2626' : options.color,
                        className: options.seriesClass,
                        bounds: bounds,
                        offsets: fieldName === 'temp' ? [0, -10, 10, -19, 19, -28, 28] : [0, 10, -10, 19, -19, 28, -28]
                    });
                }
                previousPoint = point;
            });
        }

        function drawNursingBloodPressure(svg, records, xPositions, yForValue, labelRegistry, bounds, showLabels) {
            records.forEach(function (record, index) {
                if (record.bp_sys === null || record.bp_dia === null || xPositions[index] === undefined) return;

                var assessment = classifyNursingBloodPressure(record.bp_sys, record.bp_dia);
                var color = assessment.abnormal ? '#dc2626' : '#0088CC';
                var x = xPositions[index];
                var systolicY = yForValue(record.bp_sys);
                var diastolicY = yForValue(record.bp_dia);
                var group = nursingSvgElement('g', { class: 'series-bp' + (assessment.abnormal ? ' bp-abnormal' : '') });

                group.appendChild(nursingSvgElement('line', {
                    x1: x, y1: systolicY, x2: x, y2: diastolicY,
                    stroke: color,
                    'stroke-width': assessment.abnormal ? 2.4 : 1.8
                }));
                group.appendChild(nursingSvgElement('line', {
                    x1: x - 4, y1: systolicY, x2: x + 4, y2: systolicY,
                    stroke: color, 'stroke-width': 2
                }));
                group.appendChild(nursingSvgElement('line', {
                    x1: x - 4, y1: diastolicY, x2: x + 4, y2: diastolicY,
                    stroke: color, 'stroke-width': 2
                }));
                group.appendChild(nursingSvgElement('circle', {
                    cx: x, cy: systolicY, r: 2.4, fill: '#ffffff', stroke: color, 'stroke-width': 1.5,
                    class: 'bp-systolic-marker'
                }));
                group.appendChild(nursingSvgElement('circle', {
                    cx: x, cy: diastolicY, r: 2.4, fill: color, stroke: color, 'stroke-width': 1,
                    class: 'bp-diastolic-marker'
                }));

                var titleText = 'BP: ' + record.bp_sys + '/' + record.bp_dia + ' mmHg; Pulse pressure: ' + assessment.pulsePressure + ' mmHg';
                if (assessment.reasons.length) titleText += '; ' + assessment.reasons.join(', ');
                addNursingSvgTitle(group, titleText);
                var bpHoverTarget = nursingSvgElement('line', {
                    x1: x,
                    y1: systolicY,
                    x2: x,
                    y2: diastolicY,
                    stroke: 'transparent',
                    'stroke-width': 12,
                    class: 'bp-hover-target'
                });
                addNursingSvgTitle(bpHoverTarget, titleText);
                group.appendChild(bpHoverTarget);
                svg.appendChild(group);
                if (showLabels !== false) {
                    addNursingValueLabel(svg, labelRegistry, {
                        x: x,
                        y: (systolicY + diastolicY) / 2,
                        text: (assessment.abnormal ? '! ' : '') + 'BP ' + record.bp_sys + '/' + record.bp_dia,
                        color: color,
                        className: 'series-bp',
                        bounds: bounds,
                        offsets: [0, -10, 10, -19, 19, -28, 28]
                    });
                }
            });
        }

        function drawNursingValueGroups(svg, records, xPositions, yForTemperature, yForPulseOrBp, registry, bounds) {
            records.forEach(function (record, index) {
                if (xPositions[index] === undefined) return;

                var entries = [];
                if (record.bp_sys !== null && record.bp_dia !== null) {
                    var bpAssessment = classifyNursingBloodPressure(record.bp_sys, record.bp_dia);
                    entries.push({
                        text: (bpAssessment.abnormal ? '! ' : '') + 'BP: ' + record.bp_sys + '/' + record.bp_dia,
                        color: bpAssessment.abnormal ? '#dc2626' : '#0088CC',
                        className: 'series-bp',
                        targetY: (yForPulseOrBp(record.bp_sys) + yForPulseOrBp(record.bp_dia)) / 2
                    });
                }
                if (record.pulse !== null) {
                    var pulseAssessment = assessVitalValue('pulse', record.pulse, getExactAge());
                    entries.push({
                        text: (pulseAssessment.abnormal ? '! ' : '') + 'P: ' + record.pulse,
                        color: pulseAssessment.abnormal ? '#dc2626' : '#2563eb',
                        className: 'series-pulse',
                        targetY: yForPulseOrBp(record.pulse)
                    });
                }
                if (record.temp !== null) {
                    var tempAssessment = assessVitalValue('temp', record.temp, getExactAge());
                    entries.push({
                        text: (tempAssessment.abnormal ? '! ' : '') + 'T: ' + record.temp + '°C',
                        color: tempAssessment.abnormal ? '#dc2626' : '#f97316',
                        className: 'series-temp',
                        targetY: yForTemperature(record.temp)
                    });
                }
                if (!entries.length) return;

                var lineHeight = 11;
                var boxPaddingX = 4;
                var boxPaddingY = 3;
                var boxHeight = (entries.length * lineHeight) + (boxPaddingY * 2);
                var longestText = entries.reduce(function (longest, entry) {
                    return entry.text.length > longest.length ? entry.text : longest;
                }, '');
                var boxWidth = Math.max(34, (longestText.length * 4.6) + (boxPaddingX * 2));
                var desiredX = xPositions[index] + 8;
                var boxX = Math.max(bounds.left + 2, Math.min(bounds.right - boxWidth - 2, desiredX));
                var averageTargetY = entries.reduce(function (total, entry) { return total + entry.targetY; }, 0) / entries.length;
                var preferredTop = averageTargetY - (boxHeight / 2);
                var verticalOffsets = [0, -boxHeight - 4, boxHeight + 4, -(boxHeight * 2) - 8, (boxHeight * 2) + 8];
                var chosenTop = Math.max(bounds.top + 2, Math.min(bounds.bottom - boxHeight - 2, preferredTop));
                var chosenRect = null;

                for (var offsetIndex = 0; offsetIndex < verticalOffsets.length; offsetIndex++) {
                    var candidateTop = Math.max(bounds.top + 2, Math.min(bounds.bottom - boxHeight - 2, preferredTop + verticalOffsets[offsetIndex]));
                    var candidateRect = {
                        left: boxX,
                        right: boxX + boxWidth,
                        top: candidateTop,
                        bottom: candidateTop + boxHeight
                    };
                    var overlaps = registry.some(function (existing) {
                        return !(candidateRect.right + 3 < existing.left || candidateRect.left - 3 > existing.right || candidateRect.bottom + 3 < existing.top || candidateRect.top - 3 > existing.bottom);
                    });
                    if (!overlaps || offsetIndex === verticalOffsets.length - 1) {
                        chosenTop = candidateTop;
                        chosenRect = candidateRect;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (chosenRect) registry.push(chosenRect);

                var group = nursingSvgElement('g', { class: 'nursing-value-group' });
                entries.forEach(function (entry, entryIndex) {
                    var labelY = chosenTop + boxPaddingY + (entryIndex * lineHeight) + (lineHeight / 2);
                    group.appendChild(nursingSvgElement('line', {
                        x1: xPositions[index] + 4,
                        y1: entry.targetY,
                        x2: boxX - 2,
                        y2: labelY,
                        stroke: entry.color,
                        class: 'nursing-value-leader ' + entry.className
                    }));
                });
                group.appendChild(nursingSvgElement('rect', {
                    x: boxX,
                    y: chosenTop,
                    width: boxWidth,
                    height: boxHeight,
                    rx: 2,
                    ry: 2,
                    class: 'nursing-value-box'
                }));
                entries.forEach(function (entry, entryIndex) {
                    var label = nursingSvgElement('text', {
                        x: boxX + boxPaddingX,
                        y: chosenTop + boxPaddingY + (entryIndex * lineHeight) + (lineHeight / 2),
                        fill: entry.color,
                        class: 'nursing-value-label ' + entry.className,
                        'text-anchor': 'start',
                        'dominant-baseline': 'middle'
                    });
                    label.textContent = entry.text;
                    group.appendChild(label);
                });
                svg.appendChild(group);
            });
        }

        function drawNursingCompactLabels(svg, records, xPositions, yForTemperature, yForPulseOrBp, registry, bounds) {
            records.forEach(function (record, index) {
                var x = xPositions[index];
                if (x === undefined) return;

                if (record.bp_sys !== null && record.bp_dia !== null) {
                    var bpAssessment = classifyNursingBloodPressure(record.bp_sys, record.bp_dia);
                    addNursingValueLabel(svg, registry, {
                        x: x,
                        y: (yForPulseOrBp(record.bp_sys) + yForPulseOrBp(record.bp_dia)) / 2,
                        text: (bpAssessment.abnormal ? '! ' : '') + 'BP ' + record.bp_sys + '/' + record.bp_dia,
                        color: bpAssessment.abnormal ? '#dc2626' : '#0088CC',
                        className: 'series-bp',
                        bounds: bounds,
                        offsets: [0, -10, 10, -19, 19, -28, 28]
                    });
                }

                if (record.pulse !== null) {
                    var pulseAssessment = assessVitalValue('pulse', record.pulse, getExactAge());
                    addNursingValueLabel(svg, registry, {
                        x: x,
                        y: yForPulseOrBp(record.pulse),
                        text: (pulseAssessment.abnormal ? '! ' : '') + 'P ' + record.pulse,
                        color: pulseAssessment.abnormal ? '#dc2626' : '#2563eb',
                        className: 'series-pulse',
                        bounds: bounds,
                        offsets: [0, 10, -10, 19, -19, 28, -28]
                    });
                }

                if (record.temp !== null) {
                    var tempAssessment = assessVitalValue('temp', record.temp, getExactAge());
                    addNursingValueLabel(svg, registry, {
                        x: x,
                        y: yForTemperature(record.temp),
                        text: (tempAssessment.abnormal ? '! ' : '') + 'T ' + record.temp + '°',
                        color: tempAssessment.abnormal ? '#dc2626' : '#f97316',
                        className: 'series-temp',
                        bounds: bounds,
                        offsets: [0, -10, 10, -19, 19, -28, 28]
                    });
                }
            });
        }

        function renderNursingNumericRow(table, selector, records, fieldName) {
            var row = table.querySelector(selector);
            if (!row) return;
            var valueCells = Array.prototype.slice.call(row.cells, 1);
            valueCells.forEach(function (cell, index) {
                cell.innerHTML = '';
                cell.removeAttribute('title');
                var record = records[index];
                if (!record || record[fieldName] === null || record[fieldName] === undefined) return;

                var assessment = assessVitalValue(fieldName, record[fieldName], getExactAge());
                var value = document.createElement('span');
                value.className = 'nursing-vital-value ' + (assessment.abnormal ? 'vital-abnormal' : 'vital-normal');
                value.textContent = record[fieldName];
                cell.appendChild(value);
                if (assessment.range) {
                    cell.title = (assessment.abnormal ? 'Outside range: ' : 'Normal range: ') + assessment.range[0] + '–' + assessment.range[1];
                }
            });
        }

        function renderNursingVitalChart(table, records) {
            ensureNursingChartCapacity(table, records.length);

            var stage = table.parentElement && table.parentElement.classList.contains('nursing-chart-stage') ? table.parentElement : null;
            if (!stage) {
                stage = document.createElement('div');
                stage.className = 'nursing-chart-stage';
                table.parentNode.insertBefore(stage, table);
                stage.appendChild(table);
            }
            buildNursingChartLegend(stage.parentNode, records.length);

            var oldOverlay = stage.querySelector('.nursing-chart-overlay');
            if (oldOverlay) oldOverlay.remove();

            renderNursingNumericRow(table, 'tr.nursing-resp-row', records, 'resp');
            renderNursingNumericRow(table, 'tr.nursing-spo2-row', records, 'spo2');

            var rows = table.tBodies && table.tBodies[0] ? table.tBodies[0].rows : [];
            if (rows.length < 16 || !stage.getBoundingClientRect().width) return;

            var timeRow = rows[0];
            timeRow.classList.add('nursing-chart-time-row');
            var timeCells = Array.prototype.slice.call(timeRow.cells, 1);
            timeCells.forEach(function (cell, index) {
                cell.innerHTML = '';
                if (records[index]) {
                    var label = document.createElement('span');
                    label.className = 'nursing-time-label';
                    label.textContent = formatNursingChartTime(records[index]);
                    label.title = records[index].source === 'triage' ? 'Triage' : 'Evolution';
                    cell.appendChild(label);
                }
            });

            var graphRows = Array.prototype.slice.call(table.querySelectorAll('tr.graph-tr'));
            if (!graphRows.length) return;
            var firstGraphCells = Array.prototype.slice.call(graphRows[0].querySelectorAll('.graph-td'));
            var lastGraphCells = Array.prototype.slice.call(graphRows[graphRows.length - 1].querySelectorAll('.graph-td'));
            if (!firstGraphCells.length || !lastGraphCells.length) return;

            var stageRect = stage.getBoundingClientRect();
            var topRect = firstGraphCells[0].getBoundingClientRect();
            var bottomRect = lastGraphCells[0].getBoundingClientRect();
            var graphTop = topRect.top - stageRect.top;
            var graphBottom = bottomRect.bottom - stageRect.top;
            var graphHeight = graphBottom - graphTop;
            if (graphHeight <= 0) return;

            var xPositions = firstGraphCells.map(function (cell) {
                var rect = cell.getBoundingClientRect();
                return rect.left - stageRect.left + (rect.width / 2);
            });

            var overlay = nursingSvgElement('svg', {
                class: 'nursing-chart-overlay',
                width: stage.scrollWidth,
                height: stage.scrollHeight,
                viewBox: '0 0 ' + stage.scrollWidth + ' ' + stage.scrollHeight,
                'aria-hidden': 'true'
            });
            stage.appendChild(overlay);

            // Each printed scale number is the exact value at the vertical
            // centre of its cell. The borders immediately above and below a
            // BP/PR number are +10 and -10; each minor division is 4 units.
            // A temperature number is centred in its two-row cell, whose top
            // and bottom borders are +0.5 °C and -0.5 °C; each temperature
            // division is 0.1 °C. Using the live cell centres keeps markers
            // precisely aligned even when screen or print sizing changes.
            var bpScaleValues = [];
            var bpScalePositions = [];
            var pulseScaleValues = [];
            var pulseScalePositions = [];
            var temperatureScaleValues = [];
            var temperatureScalePositions = [];

            graphRows.forEach(function (row) {
                var bpCell = row.cells[0];
                var pulseCell = row.cells[1];
                var bpValue = bpCell ? nursingNumber(bpCell.textContent) : null;
                var pulseValue = pulseCell ? nursingNumber(pulseCell.textContent) : null;

                if (bpValue !== null) {
                    var bpRect = bpCell.getBoundingClientRect();
                    bpScaleValues.push(bpValue);
                    bpScalePositions.push(bpRect.top - stageRect.top + (bpRect.height / 2));
                }
                if (pulseValue !== null) {
                    var pulseRect = pulseCell.getBoundingClientRect();
                    pulseScaleValues.push(pulseValue);
                    pulseScalePositions.push(pulseRect.top - stageRect.top + (pulseRect.height / 2));
                }

                var temperatureCell = Array.prototype.slice.call(row.cells, 2).find(function (cell) {
                    return !cell.classList.contains('graph-td') && nursingNumber(cell.textContent) !== null;
                });
                if (temperatureCell) {
                    var temperatureValue = nursingNumber(temperatureCell.textContent);
                    var temperatureRect = temperatureCell.getBoundingClientRect();
                    temperatureScaleValues.push(temperatureValue);
                    temperatureScalePositions.push(temperatureRect.top - stageRect.top + (temperatureRect.height / 2));
                }
            });

            // Add the visible outer borders as half-interval anchors so the
            // complete first and last scale blocks interpolate correctly.
            if (bpScaleValues.length) {
                bpScaleValues.unshift(bpScaleValues[0] + 10);
                bpScalePositions.unshift(graphTop);
                bpScaleValues.push(bpScaleValues[bpScaleValues.length - 1] - 10);
                bpScalePositions.push(graphBottom);
            }
            if (pulseScaleValues.length) {
                pulseScaleValues.unshift(pulseScaleValues[0] + 10);
                pulseScalePositions.unshift(graphTop);
                pulseScaleValues.push(pulseScaleValues[pulseScaleValues.length - 1] - 10);
                pulseScalePositions.push(graphBottom);
            }
            if (temperatureScaleValues.length) {
                temperatureScaleValues.unshift(temperatureScaleValues[0] + 0.5);
                temperatureScalePositions.unshift(graphTop);
                temperatureScaleValues.push(temperatureScaleValues[temperatureScaleValues.length - 1] - 0.5);
                temperatureScalePositions.push(graphBottom);
            }

            var yForBloodPressure = function (value) {
                return nursingYForScale(value, bpScaleValues, bpScalePositions);
            };
            var yForPulse = function (value) {
                return nursingYForScale(value, pulseScaleValues, pulseScalePositions);
            };
            var yForTemperature = function (value) {
                return nursingYForScale(value, temperatureScaleValues, temperatureScalePositions);
            };
            var labelRegistry = [];
            var labelBounds = {
                left: xPositions[0] ? xPositions[0] - (firstGraphCells[0].getBoundingClientRect().width / 2) : 0,
                right: xPositions.length ? xPositions[xPositions.length - 1] + (firstGraphCells[firstGraphCells.length - 1].getBoundingClientRect().width / 2) : stage.scrollWidth,
                top: graphTop,
                bottom: graphBottom
            };

            // Keep all three plotted vital signs in their own horizontal lane
            // inside every date/time column so their markers never cover one another.
            // Pulse uses the left lane, blood pressure the centre lane, and
            // temperature the right lane.  The inset is calculated per cell so
            // the separation remains correct on screen and when the table shrinks
            // to fit the printed page.
            var pulseXPositions = [];
            var bloodPressureXPositions = [];
            var temperatureXPositions = [];
            firstGraphCells.forEach(function (cell) {
                var rect = cell.getBoundingClientRect();
                var cellLeft = rect.left - stageRect.left;
                var safeInset = Math.max(5, Math.min(12, rect.width * 0.18));

                pulseXPositions.push(cellLeft + safeInset);
                bloodPressureXPositions.push(cellLeft + (rect.width / 2));
                temperatureXPositions.push(cellLeft + rect.width - safeInset);
            });

            drawNursingLineSeries(overlay, records, temperatureXPositions, yForTemperature, 'temp', {
                color: '#f97316', label: 'Temperature', marker: 'circle', seriesClass: 'series-temp', dashArray: '', showLabels: false
            }, labelRegistry, labelBounds);
            drawNursingLineSeries(overlay, records, pulseXPositions, yForPulse, 'pulse', {
                color: '#2563eb', label: 'Pulse', marker: 'square', seriesClass: 'series-pulse', dashArray: '6 4', showLabels: false
            }, labelRegistry, labelBounds);
            drawNursingBloodPressure(overlay, records, bloodPressureXPositions, yForBloodPressure, labelRegistry, labelBounds, false);
        }

        function renderNursingVitalCharts() {
            var records = getNursingVitalRecords();
            document.querySelectorAll('#sub_nursing .vital-tbl').forEach(function (table) {
                renderNursingVitalChart(table, records);
            });
            refreshNursingInteractiveTables();
        }

        function scheduleNursingChartRender() {
            var subNursing = document.getElementById('sub_nursing');
            if (subNursing && (subNursing.hidden || subNursing.style.display === 'none' || subNursing.offsetParent === null)) {
                return;
            }
            if (nursingChartRenderTimer) clearTimeout(nursingChartRenderTimer);
            nursingChartRenderTimer = setTimeout(function () {
                nursingChartRenderTimer = null;
                renderNursingVitalCharts();
            }, 50);
        }

            renderNursingVitalCharts();
            return window.printEmrReport({selectors:[formName === 'maternity' ? '#nursing_maternity' : '#nursing_general'],classes:['print-nursing'],sectionClasses:['nursing-print-target'],title:'Nursing process'});
        }

        // ==========================================
        // FIELD SYNC FUNCTIONS
        // ==========================================
        
        // Operational District coverage area detection and sync
        window.DEFAULT_OD_DISTRICT_CODES = ['1601', '1603', '1607']; // Andoung Meas, Borkeo, Oyadav
        window.DEFAULT_OD_DISTRICT_NAMES = ['បរកែវ', 'អណ្ដូងមាស', 'អូរយ៉ាដាវ', 'bar kaev', 'borkeo', 'andoung meas', 'ou ya dav', 'oyadav'];
        window.activeOdDistricts = null;

        window.fetchOperationalDistrictConfig = async function() {
            if (window.activeOdDistricts) return window.activeOdDistricts;
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/operational-district', { cache: 'no-store' });
                if (res.ok) {
                    const data = await res.json();
                    if (data && Array.isArray(data.districts)) {
                        window.activeOdDistricts = data.districts.map(function(d) { return String(d).padStart(4, '0'); });
                        return window.activeOdDistricts;
                    }
                }
            } catch (e) {
                console.warn('Could not load OD config, using defaults:', e);
            }
            window.activeOdDistricts = window.DEFAULT_OD_DISTRICT_CODES;
            return window.activeOdDistricts;
        };

        window.isDistrictInOD = function(districtCode, districtName) {
            var code = String(districtCode || '').trim().padStart(4, '0');
            var name = String(districtName || '').toLowerCase().trim();
            var odCodes = window.activeOdDistricts || window.DEFAULT_OD_DISTRICT_CODES;
            if (code && odCodes.indexOf(code) !== -1) return true;
            for (var i = 0; i < window.DEFAULT_OD_DISTRICT_NAMES.length; i++) {
                if (name && name.indexOf(window.DEFAULT_OD_DISTRICT_NAMES[i]) !== -1) return true;
            }
            return false;
        };

        window.setCoverageAreaManual = function(val) {
            var inOdRadio = document.getElementById('web_coverage_in_od');
            var outOdRadio = document.getElementById('web_coverage_out_od');
            var hiddenInput = document.getElementById('web_coverage_area');
            var isIn = val === 'in_od';
            if (inOdRadio) inOdRadio.checked = isIn;
            if (outOdRadio) outOdRadio.checked = !isIn;
            if (hiddenInput) hiddenInput.value = isIn ? 'in_od' : 'out_od';
            window.coverageAreaManuallyOverridden = true;
            if (typeof syncFields === 'function') syncFields();
        };

        window.updateCoverageAreaFromDistrict = function(districtCode, districtName) {
            var inOd = window.isDistrictInOD(districtCode, districtName);
            var inOdRadio = document.getElementById('web_coverage_in_od');
            var outOdRadio = document.getElementById('web_coverage_out_od');
            var hiddenInput = document.getElementById('web_coverage_area');
            if (inOdRadio) inOdRadio.checked = inOd;
            if (outOdRadio) outOdRadio.checked = !inOd;
            if (hiddenInput) hiddenInput.value = inOd ? 'in_od' : 'out_od';
            window.coverageAreaManuallyOverridden = false;
        };

        window.updateCoverageAreaFromRecord = function(recordData) {
            if (!recordData) return;
            var saved = recordData['scope:registration:id:web_coverage_area'] || recordData['id:web_coverage_area'];
            if (saved === 'in_od' || saved === 'out_od') {
                window.setCoverageAreaManual(saved);
                return;
            }
            var dCode = recordData['scope:registration:id:web_district_code'] || recordData['id:web_district_code'];
            var dName = recordData['scope:registration:id:web_district'] || recordData['id:web_district'];
            window.updateCoverageAreaFromDistrict(dCode, dName);
        };

        function getPrimaryDiagnosis(kind) {
            try {
                var codeElem = kind === 'opd' ? document.getElementById('diag_input') : document.getElementById('emr_pmrs_ipd_icd10');
                var textElem = kind === 'opd' ? document.getElementById('emr_pmrs_opd_diagnosis') : document.getElementById('emr_pmrs_ipd_diagnosis');
                var code = (codeElem ? codeElem.value : '').trim();
                var text = (textElem ? textElem.value : '').trim();
                if (code && text && !code.includes(text)) return code + ' - ' + text;
                if (code) return code;
                if (text) return text;
                var listElem = kind === 'opd' ? document.getElementById('emr_opd_diagnoses') : document.getElementById('emr_ipd_diagnoses');
                if (listElem && listElem.value) {
                    var list = JSON.parse(listElem.value);
                    if (Array.isArray(list)) {
                        for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
                            var item = list[i] || {};
                            var c = (item.icd10 || item.code || '').trim();
                            var t = (item.text || '').trim();
                            if (c && t && !c.includes(t)) return c + ' - ' + t;
                            if (c) return c;
                            if (t) return t;
                        }
                    }
                }
                var rec = typeof window.getLoadedEmrPatient === 'function' ? window.getLoadedEmrPatient()?.data : null;
                if (rec) {
                    var pCode = kind === 'opd' 
                        ? (rec['scope:medical:id:diag_input'] || rec['id:diag_input'] || '') 
                        : (rec['scope:medical:id:emr_pmrs_ipd_icd10'] || rec['id:emr_pmrs_ipd_icd10'] || '');
                    var pText = kind === 'opd'
                        ? (rec['scope:medical:id:emr_pmrs_opd_diagnosis'] || rec['id:emr_pmrs_opd_diagnosis'] || '')
                        : (rec['scope:medical:id:emr_pmrs_ipd_diagnosis'] || rec['id:emr_pmrs_ipd_diagnosis'] || '');
                    pCode = String(pCode).trim();
                    pText = String(pText).trim();
                    if (pCode && pText && !pCode.includes(pText)) return pCode + ' - ' + pText;
                    if (pCode) return pCode;
                    if (pText) return pText;

                    var rawJson = kind === 'opd'
                        ? (rec['scope:medical:id:emr_opd_diagnoses'] || rec['emr_opd_diagnoses'])
                        : (rec['scope:medical:id:emr_ipd_diagnoses'] || rec['emr_ipd_diagnoses']);
                    if (rawJson) {
                        var parsed = typeof rawJson === 'string' ? JSON.parse(rawJson) : rawJson;
                        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
                            for (var j = 0; j < parsed.length; j++) {
                                var row = parsed[j] || {};
                                var rc = (row.icd10 || row.code || '').trim();
                                var rt = (row.text || '').trim();
                                if (rc && rt && !rc.includes(rt)) return rc + ' - ' + rt;
                                if (rc) return rc;
                                if (rt) return rt;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (e) {}
            return '';
        }

        function syncAdmissionDates() {
            var dateIn = document.getElementById('web_date') ? document.getElementById('web_date').value : '';
            if (!dateIn) {
                var p2Date = document.getElementById('p2_entry_date');
                dateIn = p2Date ? p2Date.value : '';
            }
            if (!dateIn) {
                var rec = typeof window.getLoadedEmrPatient === 'function' ? window.getLoadedEmrPatient()?.data : null;
                dateIn = rec ? (rec['id:web_date'] || rec['system:admission_date'] || rec['scope:registration:id:web_date'] || '') : '';
            }

            var timeIn = document.getElementById('web_time') ? document.getElementById('web_time').value : '';
            if (!timeIn) {
                var recTime = typeof window.getLoadedEmrPatient === 'function' ? window.getLoadedEmrPatient()?.data : null;
                timeIn = recTime ? (recTime['id:web_time'] || recTime['scope:registration:id:web_time'] || '') : '';
            }

            var day = '', month = '', year = '';
            if (dateIn) {
                var d = dateIn.split('-');
                if (d.length === 3) {
                    year = d[0];
                    month = d[1];
                    day = d[2];
                }
            }

            // 1. Populate វេលាចូល ៖ ថ្ងៃទី...ខែ...ឆ្នាំ... ម៉ោង ...
            var timeDayElem = document.getElementById('print_adm_time_day');
            if (timeDayElem) timeDayElem.innerText = day || '.......';
            var timeMonthElem = document.getElementById('print_adm_time_month');
            if (timeMonthElem) timeMonthElem.innerText = month || '.......';
            var timeYearElem = document.getElementById('print_adm_time_year');
            if (timeYearElem) timeYearElem.innerText = year || '.......';
            var timeHourElem = document.getElementById('print_adm_time_hour');
            if (timeHourElem) timeHourElem.innerText = timeIn || '........';

            // 2. Populate ថ្ងៃទី...ខែ...ឆ្នាំ... on Director & Doctor signature lines
            var dirDay = document.getElementById('print_adm_dir_day');
            if (dirDay) dirDay.innerText = day ? ' ' + day + ' ' : '.......';
            var dirMonth = document.getElementById('print_adm_dir_month');
            if (dirMonth) dirMonth.innerText = month ? ' ' + month + ' ' : '.......';
            var dirYear = document.getElementById('print_adm_dir_year');
            if (dirYear) dirYear.innerText = year ? ' ' + year + ' ' : '.......';

            var docDay = document.getElementById('print_adm_doc_day');
            if (docDay) docDay.innerText = day ? ' ' + day + ' ' : '.......';
            var docMonth = document.getElementById('print_adm_doc_month');
            if (docMonth) docMonth.innerText = month ? ' ' + month + ' ' : '.......';
            var docYear = document.getElementById('print_adm_doc_year');
            if (docYear) docYear.innerText = year ? ' ' + year + ' ' : '.......';

            var formatted = day && month && year ? day + '/' + month + '/' + year : dateIn;
            var dirElem = document.getElementById('print_adm_date_director');
            if (dirElem) dirElem.innerText = formatted ? '៖ ' + formatted : '';
            var docElem = document.getElementById('print_adm_date_doctor');
            if (docElem) docElem.innerText = formatted ? '៖ ' + formatted : '';
        }
        window.syncAdmissionDates = syncAdmissionDates;

        function syncAdmissionReferralWard() {
            var printRefer = document.getElementById('print_refer');
            if (!printRefer) return;

            // 1. Check if OPD doctor selected a transfer ward
            var opdWardElem = document.getElementById('web_opd_transfer_ward');
            var opdWard = opdWardElem ? opdWardElem.value.trim() : '';
            if (!opdWard) {
                var rec = typeof window.getLoadedEmrPatient === 'function' ? window.getLoadedEmrPatient()?.data : null;
                opdWard = rec ? (rec['scope:medical:id:web_opd_transfer_ward'] || rec['id:web_opd_transfer_ward'] || rec['scope:opd:id:web_opd_transfer_ward'] || rec['system:transferredWard'] || '') : '';
                if (opdWard && opdWardElem && !opdWardElem.value) {
                    opdWardElem.value = opdWard;
                }
            }
            if (opdWard) {
                var loaded = window.getLoadedEmrPatient?.();
                var path = window.getEmrCarePath?.();
                var selectedWard = path?.selected?.find(function (entry) { return entry.code === opdWard; });
                var resolvedWard = selectedWard ? (currentLang === 'english' ? selectedWard.en : selectedWard.kh) : '';
                if (!resolvedWard && loaded?.departmentCode === opdWard) resolvedWard = currentLang === 'english' ? loaded.departmentNameEn : loaded.departmentNameKh;
                printRefer.value = resolvedWard || opdWard;
                return;
            }

            // 2. Triage referral wards, strictly EXCLUDING OPD (dept_opd)
            var ipdDepts = [];
            var otherDeptSelect = document.getElementById('p2_other_dept');
            var deptChecks = document.querySelectorAll('.dept-check:checked');
            deptChecks.forEach(function (cb) {
                var key = cb.getAttribute('data-dept-key');
                if (key === 'dept_opd') {
                    // Do not import OPD to admission form
                    return;
                }
                if (key === 'dept_other') {
                    if (otherDeptSelect && otherDeptSelect.value !== "") {
                        var opt = otherDeptSelect.options[otherDeptSelect.selectedIndex];
                        var optKey = opt.getAttribute('data-key');
                        if (optKey && dictionary[currentLang] && dictionary[currentLang][optKey]) {
                            ipdDepts.push(dictionary[currentLang][optKey]);
                        } else {
                            ipdDepts.push(opt.text);
                        }
                    } else if (dictionary[currentLang] && dictionary[currentLang][key]) {
                        ipdDepts.push(dictionary[currentLang][key]);
                    }
                } else {
                    if (dictionary[currentLang] && dictionary[currentLang][key]) {
                        ipdDepts.push(dictionary[currentLang][key]);
                    }
                }
            });

            printRefer.value = ipdDepts.join(', ');
        }

        function syncAdmissionDiagnosis() {
            var printDiag = document.getElementById('print_diag_in');

            var ipdDiag = getPrimaryDiagnosis('ipd');

            if (origin === 'opd') {
                chosen = opdDiag || ipdDiag;
            } else if (mode === 'ipd') {
                chosen = ipdDiag || opdDiag;
            } else if (mode === 'opd') {
                chosen = opdDiag || ipdDiag;
            } else {
                chosen = ipdDiag || opdDiag;
            }
            if (!chosen) {
                var diagInElem = document.getElementById('web_diag_in');
                chosen = diagInElem ? (diagInElem.value || '').trim() : '';

            if (!chosen) {
                var rec = typeof window.getLoadedEmrPatient === 'function' ? window.getLoadedEmrPatient()?.data : null;
                chosen = rec ? (rec['system:diagnosis'] || rec['id:web_diag_in'] || '') : '';
            }
            if (printDiag) {
                printDiag.value = chosen;
            }
            syncAdmissionDates();
            syncAdmissionReferralWard();
            populateAdmissionDoctorPrintSignature();
        }

        }

        // ==========================================
        // PEDIATRIC Z-SCORE CALCULATION
        // ==========================================
        function getLMS(val, dataObj) {
            var keys = Object.keys(dataObj).map(Number).sort(function (a, b) { return a - b; });
            if (keys.includes(val)) return dataObj[val];

            var lower = keys[0], upper = keys[keys.length - 1];
            if (val <= lower) return dataObj[lower];
            if (val >= upper) return dataObj[upper];

            for (var i = 0; i < keys.length - 1; i++) {
                if (val > keys[i] && val < keys[i + 1]) {
                    lower = keys[i];
                    upper = keys[i + 1];
                    break;
                }
            }

            var lowerData = dataObj[lower];
            var upperData = dataObj[upper];
            var ratio = (val - lower) / (upper - lower);

            return {
                l: lowerData.l + ((upperData.l - lowerData.l) * ratio),
                m: lowerData.m + ((upperData.m - lowerData.m) * ratio),
                s: lowerData.s + ((upperData.s - lowerData.s) * ratio)
            };
        }

        function calculateFormula(y, l, m, s) {
            if (l === 0) return Math.log(y / m) / s;
            return (Math.pow(y / m, l) - 1) / (l * s);
        }

        function getStatus(zScore) {
            if (zScore < -3) return { text: "កង្វះអាហារូបត្ថម្ភធ្ងន់ធ្ងរ (<-3SD)", color: "#dc2626" };
            if (zScore >= -3 && zScore < -2) return { text: "កង្វះអាហារូបត្ថម្ភមធ្យម (-3SD ដល់ -2SD)", color: "#f97316" };
            if (zScore >= -2 && zScore < 0) return { text: "ទម្ងន់ធម្មតា (-2SD ដល់ Median)", color: "#0088CC" };
            if (zScore >= 0 && zScore <= 1) return { text: "ទម្ងន់ធម្មតា (Median ដល់ +1SD)", color: "#0088CC" };
            if (zScore > 1 && zScore <= 2) return { text: "លើសទម្ងន់ (+1SD ដល់ +2SD)", color: "#eab308" };
            if (zScore > 2 && zScore <= 3) return { text: "ធាត់ (+2SD ដល់ +3SD)", color: "#eab308" };
            return { text: "ធាត់ខ្លាំង (>+3SD)", color: "#dc2626" };
        }

        function calculatePediatricZScores(ageMonths, heightCm, weightKg, sex) {
            // Calculate WFA (Weight for Age)
            var wfaData = getLMS(ageMonths, whoData.wfa[sex]);
            var zWFA = calculateFormula(weightKg, wfaData.l, wfaData.m, wfaData.s);
            var statusWFA = getStatus(zWFA);

            // Calculate WFH (Weight for Height)
            var wfhData = getLMS(heightCm, whoData.wfh[sex]);
            var zWFH = calculateFormula(weightKg, wfhData.l, wfhData.m, wfhData.s);
            var statusWFH = getStatus(zWFH);

            // Update dashboard display
            var dashW_a = document.getElementById('dash_w_a');
            if (dashW_a) {
                dashW_a.innerText = statusWFA.text;
                dashW_a.style.color = statusWFA.color;
            }

            var dashW_h = document.getElementById('dash_w_h');
            if (dashW_h) {
                dashW_h.innerText = statusWFH.text;
                dashW_h.style.color = statusWFH.color;
            }
        }

        function updatePediatricDisplay() {

            if (dashPed) {
                if (ageData.years !== null && ageData.years <= 5) {
                    dashPed.style.display = 'flex';
                } else {
                    dashPed.style.display = 'none';
                }
            }
        }

        // ==========================================
        // AGE CALCULATION FUNCTIONS
        // ==========================================
        function normalizeAgeDigits(value) {
            var khmerDigits = '០១២៣៤៥៦៧៨៩';
            return String(value || '').replace(/[០-៩]/g, function (digit) {
                return String(khmerDigits.indexOf(digit));
            });
        }

        function parseManualAgeInput(rawValue) {
            var text = normalizeAgeDigits(rawValue).trim().toLowerCase();
            if (!text) return null;

            var yearMatch = text.match(/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(?:ឆ្នាំ|years?|yrs?|yr|y)(?=\s|$)/i);
            var monthMatch = text.match(/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(?:ខែ|months?|mos?|mo)(?=\s|$)/i);
            var dayMatch = text.match(/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(?:ថ្ងៃ|days?|d)(?=\s|$)/i);
            var hasUnit = !!(yearMatch || monthMatch || dayMatch);

            var yearsValue = yearMatch ? parseFloat(yearMatch[1]) : 0;
            var monthsValue = monthMatch ? parseFloat(monthMatch[1]) : 0;
            var daysValue = dayMatch ? parseFloat(dayMatch[1]) : 0;

            if (!hasUnit) {
                if (!/^\d+(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(text)) return null;
                yearsValue = parseFloat(text);
            }

            if (![yearsValue, monthsValue, daysValue].every(function (value) { return isFinite(value) && value >= 0; })) return null;

            var totalMonths = (yearsValue * 12) + monthsValue + (daysValue / 30.4375);
            var completedMonths = Math.floor(totalMonths);
            var displayMonths = completedMonths % 12;
            var displayDays = Math.round((totalMonths - completedMonths) * 30.4375);
            if (displayDays >= 30) {
                displayMonths++;
                displayDays = 0;
            }
            if (displayMonths >= 12) displayMonths = 0;

            return {
                years: Math.floor(totalMonths / 12),
                totalMonths: totalMonths,
                months: displayMonths,
                days: displayDays,
                source: 'manual'
            };
        }

        function getAgeFromDOBValue(dobVal) {
            if (!dobVal) return null;
            var parts = String(dobVal).split('-');
            if (parts.length !== 3) return null;

            var dob = new Date(Number(parts[0]), Number(parts[1]) - 1, Number(parts[2]));
            var today = new Date();
            if (isNaN(dob.getTime()) || dob > today) return null;

            var years = today.getFullYear() - dob.getFullYear();
            var months = today.getMonth() - dob.getMonth();
            var days = today.getDate() - dob.getDate();

            if (days < 0) {
                months--;
                days += new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), 0).getDate();
            }
            if (months < 0) {
                years--;
                months += 12;
            }

            return {
                years: years,
                totalMonths: (years * 12) + months + (days / 30.4375),
                months: months,
                days: days,
                source: 'dob'
            };
        }

        function formatAgeForDisplay(ageData) {
            if (!ageData || ageData.years === null) return '';
            if (ageData.years >= 1) {
                return currentLang === 'khmer' ? ageData.years + ' ឆ្នាំ' : ageData.years + ' Yrs';
            }

            var parts = [];
            if (ageData.months > 0) parts.push(ageData.months + (currentLang === 'khmer' ? ' ខែ' : ' Mos'));
            if (ageData.days > 0 || ageData.months === 0) parts.push(ageData.days + (currentLang === 'khmer' ? ' ថ្ងៃ' : ' Days'));
            return parts.join(' ');
        }

        function getExactAge() {
            var dobVal = document.getElementById('web_dob') ? document.getElementById('web_dob').value : '';
            var dobAge = getAgeFromDOBValue(dobVal);
            if (dobAge) return dobAge;

            var ageValue = document.getElementById('web_age') ? document.getElementById('web_age').value : '';
            return parseManualAgeInput(ageValue) || { years: null, totalMonths: null, months: null, days: null, source: null };
        }

        function handleManualAgeInput() {
            syncFields();
            evaluateTriageStage1();
            evaluateTriageVitalStates();
            updatePediatricDisplay();
        }

        function formatManualAgeInput() {
            var dobVal = document.getElementById('web_dob') ? document.getElementById('web_dob').value : '';
            if (dobVal) {
                calculateAgeFromDOB();
                return;
            }

            var ageInput = document.getElementById('web_age');
            var parsedAge = ageInput ? parseManualAgeInput(ageInput.value) : null;
            if (ageInput && parsedAge) ageInput.value = formatAgeForDisplay(parsedAge);
            handleManualAgeInput();
        }

        function calculateAgeFromDOB() {
            var dobVal = document.getElementById('web_dob') ? document.getElementById('web_dob').value : '';
            var dobAge = getAgeFromDOBValue(dobVal);
            if (!dobAge) {
                handleManualAgeInput();
                return;
            }

            var ageInput = document.getElementById('web_age');
            if (ageInput) ageInput.value = formatAgeForDisplay(dobAge);

            syncFields();
            evaluateTriageStage1();
            evaluateTriageVitalStates();
            updatePediatricDisplay();
        }

        // ==========================================
        // TRIAGE EVALUATION FUNCTIONS
        // ==========================================
        function evaluateTriageStage1() {
            var spo2Input = document.getElementById('p2_spo2') ? document.getElementById('p2_spo2').value : '';
            var spo2Checkbox = document.getElementById('cb_s1_spo2');
            if (spo2Input !== "" && spo2Checkbox) {
                var spo2 = parseFloat(spo2Input);
                spo2Checkbox.checked = (spo2 <= 90);
            }

            var pulseInput = document.getElementById('p2_pulse') ? document.getElementById('p2_pulse').value : '';
            var ageData = getExactAge();
            var circ1Cb = document.getElementById('cb_s1_circ1');
            var circ2Cb = document.getElementById('cb_s1_circ2');

            if (pulseInput !== "" && circ1Cb && circ2Cb) {
                var pulse = parseFloat(pulseInput);
                circ1Cb.checked = false;
                circ2Cb.checked = false;

                if (ageData.years === null) {
                    if (pulse <= 60 || pulse >= 140) circ1Cb.checked = true;
                } else {
                    if (ageData.totalMonths < 1) { // under 1 month
                        if (pulse > 140) circ2Cb.checked = true;
                        if (pulse <= 60) circ1Cb.checked = true;
                    } else if (ageData.years <= 14) { // child
                        if (pulse <= 60 || pulse >= 160) circ1Cb.checked = true;
                    } else { // adult
                        if (pulse <= 50 || pulse >= 140) circ1Cb.checked = true;
                    }
                }
            }

            var anyChecked = false;
            var s1Checks = document.querySelectorAll('.s1-check');
            s1Checks.forEach(function (cb) {
                if (cb.checked) anyChecked = true;
            });

            var alertCell = document.getElementById('p2_red_alert_cell');
            var alertCb = document.getElementById('p2_red_alert_cb');
            if (alertCell && alertCb) {
                if (anyChecked) {
                    alertCb.checked = true;
                    alertCell.classList.add('red-alert-active');
                } else {
                    alertCb.checked = false;
                    alertCell.classList.remove('red-alert-active');
                }
            }
            updateRoutingSystem();
        }

        function evaluateTriageStage2() {
            var anyChecked = false;
            var s2Checks = document.querySelectorAll('.s2-check');
            s2Checks.forEach(function (cb) {
                if (cb.checked) anyChecked = true;
            });

            var alertCell = document.getElementById('p2_orange_alert_cell');
            var alertCb = document.getElementById('p2_orange_alert_cb');
            if (alertCell && alertCb) {
                if (anyChecked) {
                    alertCb.checked = true;
                    alertCell.classList.add('orange-alert-active');
                } else {
                    alertCb.checked = false;
                    alertCell.classList.remove('orange-alert-active');
                }
            }
            updateRoutingSystem();
        }

        function updateRoutingSystem() {
            var isEmergency = document.getElementById('p2_red_alert_cb') ? document.getElementById('p2_red_alert_cb').checked : false;
            var isOrange = document.getElementById('p2_orange_alert_cb') ? document.getElementById('p2_orange_alert_cb').checked : false;
            var isEmergencyFinal = isEmergency || isOrange;

            var bottomRedCb = document.getElementById('route_red_cb');
            var bottomGreenCb = document.getElementById('route_green_cb');

            if (bottomRedCb) bottomRedCb.checked = isEmergencyFinal;
            if (bottomGreenCb) bottomGreenCb.checked = !isEmergencyFinal;

            var otherDeptSelect = document.getElementById('p2_other_dept');
            var otherCheckbox = document.getElementById('cb_dept_other');

            if (isEmergencyFinal && otherDeptSelect && otherCheckbox) {
                otherDeptSelect.value = "emergency";
                otherCheckbox.checked = true;
                var deptChecks = document.querySelectorAll('.dept-check');
                deptChecks.forEach(function (cb) {
                    if (cb.getAttribute('data-dept-key') !== 'dept_other') {
                        cb.checked = false;
                        cb.disabled = true;
                    }
                });
            } else {
                if (otherDeptSelect && otherDeptSelect.value === "emergency") {
                    otherDeptSelect.value = "";
                    if (otherCheckbox) otherCheckbox.checked = false;
                }
                var deptChecks2 = document.querySelectorAll('.dept-check');
                deptChecks2.forEach(function (cb) {
                    cb.disabled = false;
                });
            }
            syncDepartments();
        }

        // ==========================================
        // DEPARTMENT SYNC
        // ==========================================
        function syncDepartments() {
            var isEmergency = document.getElementById('p2_red_alert_cb') ? document.getElementById('p2_red_alert_cb').checked : false;
            var isOrange = document.getElementById('p2_orange_alert_cb') ? document.getElementById('p2_orange_alert_cb').checked : false;
            var isEmergencyFinal = isEmergency || isOrange;

            var otherDeptSelect = document.getElementById('p2_other_dept');
            var otherCheckbox = document.getElementById('cb_dept_other');

            if (otherDeptSelect && otherCheckbox) {
                if (otherDeptSelect.value === "emergency" && !isEmergencyFinal) {
                    var alertMsg = dictionary[currentLang] ? dictionary[currentLang]['alert_no_er'] : "Cannot send to ER without priority signs.";
                    alert(alertMsg);
                    otherDeptSelect.value = "";
                }
                if (otherDeptSelect.value !== "") otherCheckbox.checked = true;
            }

            var selectedDepts = [];
            var deptChecks = document.querySelectorAll('.dept-check:checked');
            deptChecks.forEach(function (cb) {
                var key = cb.getAttribute('data-dept-key');
                if (key === 'dept_other') {
                    if (otherDeptSelect && otherDeptSelect.value !== "") {
                        var opt = otherDeptSelect.options[otherDeptSelect.selectedIndex];
                        var optKey = opt.getAttribute('data-key');
                        if (optKey && dictionary[currentLang] && dictionary[currentLang][optKey]) {
                            selectedDepts.push(dictionary[currentLang][optKey]);
                        } else {
                            selectedDepts.push(opt.text);
                        }
                    } else if (dictionary[currentLang] && dictionary[currentLang][key]) {
                        selectedDepts.push(dictionary[currentLang][key]);
                    }
                } else {
                    if (dictionary[currentLang] && dictionary[currentLang][key]) {
                        selectedDepts.push(dictionary[currentLang][key]);
                    }
                }
            });

            var finalReferral = selectedDepts.join(', ');
            var dashDept = document.getElementById('dash_dept_in');
            if (dashDept) dashDept.innerText = finalReferral || "-";
            syncAdmissionReferralWard();

            var carePath = typeof window.getEmrCarePath === 'function'
                ? window.getEmrCarePath()
                : { mode: isEmergencyFinal ? 'ipd' : 'opd' };
            var servType = carePath.mode === 'ipd'
                ? (dictionary[currentLang] ? dictionary[currentLang]['serv_ipd'] : 'សម្រាកពេទ្យ')
                : (dictionary[currentLang] ? dictionary[currentLang]['serv_opd'] : 'ពិគ្រោះក្រៅ');
            var dashServ = document.getElementById('dash_serv_type');
            if (dashServ) dashServ.innerText = finalReferral ? servType : "-";

            syncRightsForm();
            syncAdmissionDiagnosis();
        }

        // ==========================================
        // RIGHTS FORM SYNC
        // ==========================================
        function syncRightsForm() {
            var lastName = document.getElementById('web_last_name') ? document.getElementById('web_last_name').value : '';
            var firstName = document.getElementById('web_first_name') ? document.getElementById('web_first_name').value : '';
            var nameVal = lastName + (lastName && firstName ? ' ' : '') + firstName;
            var ageVal = document.getElementById('web_age') ? document.getElementById('web_age').value : '';
            var sexRadio = document.querySelector('input[name="sex_radio"]:checked');
            var sexText = sexRadio ? sexRadio.value : "";
            var natSelect = document.getElementById('web_nat');
            var natVal = natSelect && natSelect.selectedIndex >= 0 && natSelect.options[natSelect.selectedIndex] ? natSelect.options[natSelect.selectedIndex].text : "ខ្មែរ / Khmer";

            var rightsName = document.getElementById('rights_pat_name');
            if (rightsName) rightsName.value = nameVal;
            var agrName = document.getElementById('agr_pat_name');
            if (agrName) agrName.value = nameVal;
            var agrAge = document.getElementById('agr_pat_age');
            if (agrAge) agrAge.value = ageVal;
            var agrSex = document.getElementById('agr_pat_sex');
            if (agrSex) agrSex.value = sexText;
            var agrNat = document.getElementById('agr_pat_nat');
            if (agrNat) agrNat.value = natVal;

            var dateIn = document.getElementById('web_date') ? document.getElementById('web_date').value : '';
            var dashDateStr = "-";
            if (dateIn) {
                var d = dateIn.split('-');
                dashDateStr = d.length === 3 ? d[2] + '/' + d[1] + '/' + d[0] : dateIn;
            }
            var rightsDates = document.querySelectorAll('.rights_date_val');
            rightsDates.forEach(function (el) {
                el.innerText = dashDateStr;
            });

            var phone = document.getElementById('web_phone') ? document.getElementById('web_phone').value : '';
            var rightsPhone = document.getElementById('rights_phone');
            if (rightsPhone) rightsPhone.value = phone;
            var agrPhone = document.getElementById('agr_phone');
            if (agrPhone) agrPhone.value = phone;

            var dept = document.getElementById('print_refer') ? document.getElementById('print_refer').value : '';
            var rightsDept = document.getElementById('rights_dept');
            if (rightsDept) rightsDept.value = dept;

            var head = "";
            if (dept.includes("សង្គ្រោះបន្ទាន់")) head = "សឺង រិទ្ធី";
            else if (dept.includes("សម្ភព") || dept.includes("រោគស្ត្រី")) head = "បួក លីហ៊ន់";
            else if (dept.includes("ជំងឺទូទៅ") || dept.includes("ពិគ្រោះក្រៅ")) head = "អ៊ី គឹមឡេង";
            else if (dept.includes("ជំងឺកុមារ")) head = "ផេង សូភា";

            var rightsHead = document.getElementById('rights_head');
            if (rightsHead) rightsHead.value = head;
        }

        function updateInvSub() {
            var cat = document.getElementById('inv_category') ? document.getElementById('inv_category').value : '';
            var subSelect = document.getElementById('inv_sub');
            if (subSelect) {
                subSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- អនុប្រភេទ --</option>';
                if (cat && invData[cat]) {
                    invData[cat].forEach(function (sub) {
                        var opt = document.createElement('option');
                        opt.value = sub;
                        opt.innerHTML = sub;
                        subSelect.appendChild(opt);
                    });
                }
            }
        }

        function addInvestigation() {
            var cat = document.getElementById('inv_category') ? document.getElementById('inv_category').value : '';
            var sub = document.getElementById('inv_sub') ? document.getElementById('inv_sub').value : '';
            var textArea = document.getElementById('inv_list');
            if (cat && sub && textArea) {
                textArea.value += "- " + cat + " : " + sub + "\n";
                var catSelect = document.getElementById('inv_category');
                if (catSelect) catSelect.value = "";
                updateInvSub();
            }
        }

        function addOpdRxRow(preventFocus) {
            var tbody = document.getElementById('opd_rx_tbody');
            if (!tbody) return;
            var rowCount = tbody.querySelectorAll('tr.orx-main-row').length + 1;
            var tr = document.createElement('tr');
            tr.className = 'orx-main-row';
            tr.innerHTML = getMedicationEntryRowHtml('orx', rowCount, false, true);
            tbody.appendChild(tr);
            populateMedicationRouteSelect(tr.querySelector('.orx-route'), 'po');
            var scheduleSelect = tr.querySelector('.med-schedule-type');
            if (scheduleSelect) handleMedicationScheduleChange(scheduleSelect);
            reindexOpdRxRows();
            refreshMedicationTimingLanguage();
            if (!preventFocus) {
                var nameInput = tr.querySelector('.orx-name');
                if (nameInput) nameInput.focus();
            }
        }

        function removeOpdRxRow(button) {
            var row = button && button.closest ? button.closest('.orx-main-row') : null;
            if (row) row.remove();
            var tbody = document.getElementById('opd_rx_tbody');
            if (tbody && !tbody.querySelector('.orx-main-row')) addOpdRxRow();
            reindexOpdRxRows();
        }

        function reindexOpdRxRows() {
            document.querySelectorAll('#opd_rx_tbody .orx-main-row').forEach(function (row, index) {
                var indexCell = row.querySelector('.orx-index');
                if (indexCell) indexCell.textContent = index + 1;
            });
        }
