        // Operational District coverage area detection and sync
        window.DEFAULT_OD_DISTRICT_CODES = ['1601', '1603', '1607']; // Andoung Meas, Borkeo, Oyadav
        window.DEFAULT_OD_DISTRICT_NAMES = ['បរកែវ', 'អណ្ដូងមាស', 'អូរយ៉ាដាវ', 'bar kaev', 'borkeo', 'andoung meas', 'ou ya dav', 'oyadav'];
        window.activeOdDistricts = null;

        window.fetchOperationalDistrictConfig = async function() {
            if (window.activeOdDistricts) return window.activeOdDistricts;
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/operational-district', { cache: 'no-store' });
                if (res.ok) {
                    const data = await res.json();
                    if (data && Array.isArray(data.districts)) {
                        window.activeOdDistricts = data.districts.map(function(d) { return String(d).padStart(4, '0'); });
                        return window.activeOdDistricts;
                    }
                }
            } catch (e) {
                console.warn('Could not load OD config, using defaults:', e);
            }
            window.activeOdDistricts = window.DEFAULT_OD_DISTRICT_CODES;
            return window.activeOdDistricts;
        };

        window.isDistrictInOD = function(districtCode, districtName) {
            var code = String(districtCode || '').trim().padStart(4, '0');
            var name = String(districtName || '').toLowerCase().trim();
            var odCodes = window.activeOdDistricts || window.DEFAULT_OD_DISTRICT_CODES;
            if (code && odCodes.indexOf(code) !== -1) return true;
            for (var i = 0; i < window.DEFAULT_OD_DISTRICT_NAMES.length; i++) {
                if (name && name.indexOf(window.DEFAULT_OD_DISTRICT_NAMES[i]) !== -1) return true;
            }
            return false;
        };

        window.setCoverageAreaManual = function(val) {
            var inOdRadio = document.getElementById('web_coverage_in_od');
            var outOdRadio = document.getElementById('web_coverage_out_od');
            var hiddenInput = document.getElementById('web_coverage_area');
            var isIn = val === 'in_od';
            if (inOdRadio) inOdRadio.checked = isIn;
            if (outOdRadio) outOdRadio.checked = !isIn;
            if (hiddenInput) hiddenInput.value = isIn ? 'in_od' : 'out_od';
            window.coverageAreaManuallyOverridden = true;
            if (typeof syncFields === 'function') syncFields();
        };

        window.updateCoverageAreaFromDistrict = function(districtCode, districtName) {
            var inOd = window.isDistrictInOD(districtCode, districtName);
            var inOdRadio = document.getElementById('web_coverage_in_od');
            var outOdRadio = document.getElementById('web_coverage_out_od');
            var hiddenInput = document.getElementById('web_coverage_area');
            if (inOdRadio) inOdRadio.checked = inOd;
            if (outOdRadio) outOdRadio.checked = !inOd;
            if (hiddenInput) hiddenInput.value = inOd ? 'in_od' : 'out_od';
            window.coverageAreaManuallyOverridden = false;
        };

        window.updateCoverageAreaFromRecord = function(recordData) {
            if (!recordData) return;
            var saved = recordData['scope:registration:id:web_coverage_area'] || recordData['id:web_coverage_area'];
            if (saved === 'in_od' || saved === 'out_od') {
                window.setCoverageAreaManual(saved);
                return;
            }
            var dCode = recordData['scope:registration:id:web_district_code'] || recordData['id:web_district_code'];
            var dName = recordData['scope:registration:id:web_district'] || recordData['id:web_district'];
            window.updateCoverageAreaFromDistrict(dCode, dName);
        };

        // Initialize OD config
        window.fetchOperationalDistrictConfig();

        function syncVitals() {
            var temp = document.getElementById('p2_temp') ? document.getElementById('p2_temp').value : "-";
            var bp_sys = document.getElementById('p2_bp_sys') ? document.getElementById('p2_bp_sys').value : "-";
            var bp_dia = document.getElementById('p2_bp_dia') ? document.getElementById('p2_bp_dia').value : "-";
            var pulse = document.getElementById('p2_pulse') ? document.getElementById('p2_pulse').value : "-";
            var resp = document.getElementById('p2_resp') ? document.getElementById('p2_resp').value : "-";
            var glucose = document.getElementById('p2_glucose') ? document.getElementById('p2_glucose').value : "";
            var dashGlucose = document.getElementById('dash_glucose');
            if (dashGlucose) dashGlucose.innerText = glucose || "-";
            var weight = document.getElementById('p2_weight') ? document.getElementById('p2_weight').value : "-";
            var height = document.getElementById('p2_height') ? document.getElementById('p2_height').value : "-";
            var spo2 = document.getElementById('p2_spo2') ? document.getElementById('p2_spo2').value : "-";

            var dashTemp = document.getElementById('dash_temp');
            if (dashTemp) dashTemp.innerText = temp;
            var dashBp = document.getElementById('dash_bp');
            if (dashBp) dashBp.innerText = (bp_sys !== "-" || bp_dia !== "-") ? bp_sys + '/' + bp_dia : "-";
            var dashPulse = document.getElementById('dash_pulse');
            if (dashPulse) dashPulse.innerText = pulse;
            var dashResp = document.getElementById('dash_resp');
            if (dashResp) dashResp.innerText = resp;
            var dashWeight = document.getElementById('dash_weight');
            if (dashWeight) dashWeight.innerText = weight;
            var dashHeight = document.getElementById('dash_height');
            if (dashHeight) dashHeight.innerText = height;
            var dashSpo2 = document.getElementById('dash_spo2');
            if (dashSpo2) dashSpo2.innerText = spo2;

            var opdTemp = document.getElementById('opd_temp');
            if (opdTemp) opdTemp.value = temp;
            var opdBpSys = document.getElementById('opd_bp_sys');
            if (opdBpSys) opdBpSys.value = bp_sys;
            var opdBpDia = document.getElementById('opd_bp_dia');
            if (opdBpDia) opdBpDia.value = bp_dia;
            var opdPulse = document.getElementById('opd_pulse');
            if (opdPulse) opdPulse.value = pulse;
            var opdResp = document.getElementById('opd_resp');
            if (opdResp) opdResp.value = resp;
            var opdWeight = document.getElementById('opd_weight');
            if (opdWeight) opdWeight.value = weight;
            var opdHeight = document.getElementById('opd_height');
            if (opdHeight) opdHeight.value = height;

            var ipdTemp = document.getElementById('ipd_temp');
            if (ipdTemp) ipdTemp.value = temp;
            var ipdBpSys = document.getElementById('ipd_bp_sys');
            if (ipdBpSys) ipdBpSys.value = bp_sys;
            var ipdBpDia = document.getElementById('ipd_bp_dia');
            if (ipdBpDia) ipdBpDia.value = bp_dia;
            var ipdPulse = document.getElementById('ipd_pulse');
            if (ipdPulse) ipdPulse.value = pulse;
            var ipdResp = document.getElementById('ipd_resp');
            if (ipdResp) ipdResp.value = resp;
            var ipdWeight = document.getElementById('ipd_weight');
            if (ipdWeight) ipdWeight.value = weight;
            var ipdHeight = document.getElementById('ipd_height');
            if (ipdHeight) ipdHeight.value = height;
            var ipdSpo2 = document.getElementById('ipd_spo2');
            if (ipdSpo2) ipdSpo2.value = spo2;

            var weightNum = parseFloat(weight);
            var heightNum = parseFloat(height);
            if (!isNaN(weightNum) && !isNaN(heightNum) && heightNum > 0) {
                var h_m = heightNum / 100;
                var bmi = weightNum / (h_m * h_m);
                var bmiStr = bmi.toFixed(2);
                var dashBmi = document.getElementById('dash_bmi');
                if (dashBmi) dashBmi.innerText = bmiStr;
                var opdBmi = document.getElementById('opd_bmi');
                if (opdBmi) opdBmi.value = bmiStr;
            } else {
                var dashBmi2 = document.getElementById('dash_bmi');
                if (dashBmi2) dashBmi2.innerText = "-";
                var opdBmi2 = document.getElementById('opd_bmi');
                if (opdBmi2) opdBmi2.value = "";
            }

            // Auto-calculate Z-Scores for children <= 5 years
            var ageData = getExactAge();
            var sexRadio = document.querySelector('input[name="sex_radio"]:checked');
            var sex = sexRadio ? (sexRadio.value === 'ប្រុស' ? 'boy' : 'girl') : 'boy';

            if (ageData.years !== null && ageData.years <= 5 && weightNum > 0 && heightNum > 0) {
                calculatePediatricZScores(ageData.totalMonths, heightNum, weightNum, sex);
            }
            evaluateTriageVitalStates();
            scheduleNursingChartRender();
        }

        // ==========================================
        // PEDIATRIC Z-SCORE CALCULATION
        // ==========================================
        function getLMS(val, dataObj) {
            var keys = Object.keys(dataObj).map(Number).sort(function (a, b) { return a - b; });
            if (keys.includes(val)) return dataObj[val];

            var lower = keys[0], upper = keys[keys.length - 1];
            if (val <= lower) return dataObj[lower];
            if (val >= upper) return dataObj[upper];

            for (var i = 0; i < keys.length - 1; i++) {
                if (val > keys[i] && val < keys[i + 1]) {
                    lower = keys[i];
                    upper = keys[i + 1];
                    break;
                }
            }

            var lowerData = dataObj[lower];
            var upperData = dataObj[upper];
            var ratio = (val - lower) / (upper - lower);

            return {
                l: lowerData.l + ((upperData.l - lowerData.l) * ratio),
                m: lowerData.m + ((upperData.m - lowerData.m) * ratio),
                s: lowerData.s + ((upperData.s - lowerData.s) * ratio)
            };
        }

        function calculateFormula(y, l, m, s) {
            if (l === 0) return Math.log(y / m) / s;
            return (Math.pow(y / m, l) - 1) / (l * s);
        }

        function getStatus(zScore) {
            if (zScore < -3) return { text: "កង្វះអាហារូបត្ថម្ភធ្ងន់ធ្ងរ (<-3SD)", color: "#dc2626" };
            if (zScore >= -3 && zScore < -2) return { text: "កង្វះអាហារូបត្ថម្ភមធ្យម (-3SD ដល់ -2SD)", color: "#f97316" };
            if (zScore >= -2 && zScore < 0) return { text: "ទម្ងន់ធម្មតា (-2SD ដល់ Median)", color: "#0088CC" };
            if (zScore >= 0 && zScore <= 1) return { text: "ទម្ងន់ធម្មតា (Median ដល់ +1SD)", color: "#0088CC" };
            if (zScore > 1 && zScore <= 2) return { text: "លើសទម្ងន់ (+1SD ដល់ +2SD)", color: "#eab308" };
            if (zScore > 2 && zScore <= 3) return { text: "ធាត់ (+2SD ដល់ +3SD)", color: "#eab308" };
            return { text: "ធាត់ខ្លាំង (>+3SD)", color: "#dc2626" };
        }

        function calculatePediatricZScores(ageMonths, heightCm, weightKg, sex) {
            // Calculate WFA (Weight for Age)
            var wfaData = getLMS(ageMonths, whoData.wfa[sex]);
            var zWFA = calculateFormula(weightKg, wfaData.l, wfaData.m, wfaData.s);
            var statusWFA = getStatus(zWFA);

            // Calculate WFH (Weight for Height)
            var wfhData = getLMS(heightCm, whoData.wfh[sex]);
            var zWFH = calculateFormula(weightKg, wfhData.l, wfhData.m, wfhData.s);
            var statusWFH = getStatus(zWFH);

            // Update dashboard display
            var dashW_a = document.getElementById('dash_w_a');
            if (dashW_a) {
                dashW_a.innerText = statusWFA.text;
                dashW_a.style.color = statusWFA.color;
            }

            var dashW_h = document.getElementById('dash_w_h');
            if (dashW_h) {
                dashW_h.innerText = statusWFH.text;
                dashW_h.style.color = statusWFH.color;
            }
        }

        function updatePediatricDisplay() {
            var ageData = getExactAge();
            var dashPed = document.getElementById('dash_pediatric_vitals');

            if (dashPed) {
                if (ageData.years !== null && ageData.years <= 5) {
                    dashPed.style.display = 'flex';
                } else {
                    dashPed.style.display = 'none';
                }
            }
        }

        // ==========================================
        // AGE CALCULATION FUNCTIONS
        // ==========================================
        function normalizeAgeDigits(value) {
            var khmerDigits = '០១២៣៤៥៦៧៨៩';
            return String(value || '').replace(/[០-៩]/g, function (digit) {
                return String(khmerDigits.indexOf(digit));
            });
        }

        function parseManualAgeInput(rawValue) {
            var text = normalizeAgeDigits(rawValue).trim().toLowerCase();
            if (!text) return null;

            var yearMatch = text.match(/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(?:ឆ្នាំ|years?|yrs?|yr|y)(?=\s|$)/i);
            var monthMatch = text.match(/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(?:ខែ|months?|mos?|mo)(?=\s|$)/i);
            var dayMatch = text.match(/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(?:ថ្ងៃ|days?|d)(?=\s|$)/i);
            var hasUnit = !!(yearMatch || monthMatch || dayMatch);

            var yearsValue = yearMatch ? parseFloat(yearMatch[1]) : 0;
            var monthsValue = monthMatch ? parseFloat(monthMatch[1]) : 0;
            var daysValue = dayMatch ? parseFloat(dayMatch[1]) : 0;

            if (!hasUnit) {
                if (!/^\d+(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(text)) return null;
                yearsValue = parseFloat(text);
            }

            if (![yearsValue, monthsValue, daysValue].every(function (value) { return isFinite(value) && value >= 0; })) return null;

            var totalMonths = (yearsValue * 12) + monthsValue + (daysValue / 30.4375);
            var completedMonths = Math.floor(totalMonths);
            var displayMonths = completedMonths % 12;
            var displayDays = Math.round((totalMonths - completedMonths) * 30.4375);
            if (displayDays >= 30) {
                displayMonths++;
                displayDays = 0;
            }
            if (displayMonths >= 12) displayMonths = 0;

            return {
                years: Math.floor(totalMonths / 12),
                totalMonths: totalMonths,
                months: displayMonths,
                days: displayDays,
                source: 'manual'
            };
        }

        function getAgeFromDOBValue(dobVal) {
            if (!dobVal) return null;
            var parts = String(dobVal).split('-');
            if (parts.length !== 3) return null;

            var dob = new Date(Number(parts[0]), Number(parts[1]) - 1, Number(parts[2]));
            var today = new Date();
            if (isNaN(dob.getTime()) || dob > today) return null;

            var years = today.getFullYear() - dob.getFullYear();
            var months = today.getMonth() - dob.getMonth();
            var days = today.getDate() - dob.getDate();

            if (days < 0) {
                months--;
                days += new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), 0).getDate();
            }
            if (months < 0) {
                years--;
                months += 12;
            }

            return {
                years: years,
                totalMonths: (years * 12) + months + (days / 30.4375),
                months: months,
                days: days,
                source: 'dob'
            };
        }

        function formatAgeForDisplay(ageData) {
            if (!ageData || ageData.years === null) return '';
            if (ageData.years >= 1) {
                return currentLang === 'khmer' ? ageData.years + ' ឆ្នាំ' : ageData.years + ' Yrs';
            }

            var parts = [];
            if (ageData.months > 0) parts.push(ageData.months + (currentLang === 'khmer' ? ' ខែ' : ' Mos'));
            if (ageData.days > 0 || ageData.months === 0) parts.push(ageData.days + (currentLang === 'khmer' ? ' ថ្ងៃ' : ' Days'));
            return parts.join(' ');
        }

        function getExactAge() {
            var dobVal = document.getElementById('web_dob') ? document.getElementById('web_dob').value : '';
            var dobAge = getAgeFromDOBValue(dobVal);
            if (dobAge) return dobAge;

            var ageValue = document.getElementById('web_age') ? document.getElementById('web_age').value : '';
            return parseManualAgeInput(ageValue) || { years: null, totalMonths: null, months: null, days: null, source: null };
        }

        function handleManualAgeInput() {
            syncFields();
            evaluateTriageStage1();
            evaluateTriageVitalStates();
            updatePediatricDisplay();
        }

        function formatManualAgeInput() {
            var dobVal = document.getElementById('web_dob') ? document.getElementById('web_dob').value : '';
            if (dobVal) {
                calculateAgeFromDOB();
                return;
            }

            var ageInput = document.getElementById('web_age');
            var parsedAge = ageInput ? parseManualAgeInput(ageInput.value) : null;
            if (ageInput && parsedAge) ageInput.value = formatAgeForDisplay(parsedAge);
            handleManualAgeInput();
        }

        function calculateAgeFromDOB() {
            var dobVal = document.getElementById('web_dob') ? document.getElementById('web_dob').value : '';
            var dobAge = getAgeFromDOBValue(dobVal);
            if (!dobAge) {
                handleManualAgeInput();
                return;
            }

            var ageInput = document.getElementById('web_age');
            if (ageInput) ageInput.value = formatAgeForDisplay(dobAge);

            syncFields();
            evaluateTriageStage1();
            evaluateTriageVitalStates();
            updatePediatricDisplay();
        }

        // ==========================================
        // TRIAGE EVALUATION FUNCTIONS
        // ==========================================
        function evaluateTriageStage1() {
            var spo2Input = document.getElementById('p2_spo2') ? document.getElementById('p2_spo2').value : '';
            var spo2Checkbox = document.getElementById('cb_s1_spo2');
            if (spo2Input !== "" && spo2Checkbox) {
                var spo2 = parseFloat(spo2Input);
                spo2Checkbox.checked = (spo2 <= 90);
            }

            var pulseInput = document.getElementById('p2_pulse') ? document.getElementById('p2_pulse').value : '';
            var ageData = getExactAge();
            var circ1Cb = document.getElementById('cb_s1_circ1');
            var circ2Cb = document.getElementById('cb_s1_circ2');

            if (pulseInput !== "" && circ1Cb && circ2Cb) {
                var pulse = parseFloat(pulseInput);
                circ1Cb.checked = false;
                circ2Cb.checked = false;

                if (ageData.years === null) {
                    if (pulse <= 60 || pulse >= 140) circ1Cb.checked = true;
                } else {
                    if (ageData.totalMonths < 1) { // under 1 month
                        if (pulse > 140) circ2Cb.checked = true;
                        if (pulse <= 60) circ1Cb.checked = true;
                    } else if (ageData.years <= 14) { // child
                        if (pulse <= 60 || pulse >= 160) circ1Cb.checked = true;
                    } else { // adult
                        if (pulse <= 50 || pulse >= 140) circ1Cb.checked = true;
                    }
                }
            }

            var anyChecked = false;
            var s1Checks = document.querySelectorAll('.s1-check');
            s1Checks.forEach(function (cb) {
                if (cb.checked) anyChecked = true;
            });

            var alertCell = document.getElementById('p2_red_alert_cell');
            var alertCb = document.getElementById('p2_red_alert_cb');
            if (alertCell && alertCb) {
                if (anyChecked) {
                    alertCb.checked = true;
                    alertCell.classList.add('red-alert-active');
                } else {
                    alertCb.checked = false;
                    alertCell.classList.remove('red-alert-active');
                }
            }
            updateRoutingSystem();
        }

        function evaluateTriageStage2() {
            var anyChecked = false;
            var s2Checks = document.querySelectorAll('.s2-check');
            s2Checks.forEach(function (cb) {
                if (cb.checked) anyChecked = true;
            });

            var alertCell = document.getElementById('p2_orange_alert_cell');
            var alertCb = document.getElementById('p2_orange_alert_cb');
            if (alertCell && alertCb) {
                if (anyChecked) {
                    alertCb.checked = true;
                    alertCell.classList.add('orange-alert-active');
                } else {
                    alertCb.checked = false;
                    alertCell.classList.remove('orange-alert-active');
                }
            }
            updateRoutingSystem();
        }

        function updateRoutingSystem() {
            var isEmergency = document.getElementById('p2_red_alert_cb') ? document.getElementById('p2_red_alert_cb').checked : false;
            var isOrange = document.getElementById('p2_orange_alert_cb') ? document.getElementById('p2_orange_alert_cb').checked : false;
            var isEmergencyFinal = isEmergency || isOrange;

            var bottomRedCb = document.getElementById('route_red_cb');
            var bottomGreenCb = document.getElementById('route_green_cb');

            if (bottomRedCb) bottomRedCb.checked = isEmergencyFinal;
            if (bottomGreenCb) bottomGreenCb.checked = !isEmergencyFinal;

            var otherDeptSelect = document.getElementById('p2_other_dept');
            var otherCheckbox = document.getElementById('cb_dept_other');

            if (isEmergencyFinal && otherDeptSelect && otherCheckbox) {
                otherDeptSelect.value = "សង្គ្រោះបន្ទាន់";
                otherCheckbox.checked = true;
                var deptChecks = document.querySelectorAll('.dept-check');
                deptChecks.forEach(function (cb) {
                    if (cb.getAttribute('data-dept-key') !== 'dept_other') {
                        cb.checked = false;
                        cb.disabled = true;
                    }
                });
            } else {
                if (otherDeptSelect && otherDeptSelect.value === "សង្គ្រោះបន្ទាន់") {
                    otherDeptSelect.value = "";
                    if (otherCheckbox) otherCheckbox.checked = false;
                }
                var deptChecks2 = document.querySelectorAll('.dept-check');
                deptChecks2.forEach(function (cb) {
                    cb.disabled = false;
                });
            }
            syncDepartments();
        }

        // ==========================================
        // DEPARTMENT SYNC
        // ==========================================
        function syncDepartments() {
            var isEmergency = document.getElementById('p2_red_alert_cb') ? document.getElementById('p2_red_alert_cb').checked : false;
            var isOrange = document.getElementById('p2_orange_alert_cb') ? document.getElementById('p2_orange_alert_cb').checked : false;
            var isEmergencyFinal = isEmergency || isOrange;

            var otherDeptSelect = document.getElementById('p2_other_dept');
            var otherCheckbox = document.getElementById('cb_dept_other');

            if (otherDeptSelect && otherCheckbox) {
                if (otherDeptSelect.value === "សង្គ្រោះបន្ទាន់" && !isEmergencyFinal) {
                    var alertMsg = dictionary[currentLang] ? dictionary[currentLang]['alert_no_er'] : "Cannot send to ER without priority signs.";
                    alert(alertMsg);
                    otherDeptSelect.value = "";
                }
                if (otherDeptSelect.value !== "") otherCheckbox.checked = true;
            }

            var selectedDepts = [];
            var deptChecks = document.querySelectorAll('.dept-check:checked');
            deptChecks.forEach(function (cb) {
                var key = cb.getAttribute('data-dept-key');
                if (key === 'dept_other') {
                    if (otherDeptSelect && otherDeptSelect.value !== "") {
                        var opt = otherDeptSelect.options[otherDeptSelect.selectedIndex];
                        var optKey = opt.getAttribute('data-key');
                        if (optKey && dictionary[currentLang] && dictionary[currentLang][optKey]) {
                            selectedDepts.push(dictionary[currentLang][optKey]);
                        } else {
                            selectedDepts.push(opt.text);
                        }
                    } else if (dictionary[currentLang] && dictionary[currentLang][key]) {
                        selectedDepts.push(dictionary[currentLang][key]);
                    }
                } else {
                    if (dictionary[currentLang] && dictionary[currentLang][key]) {
                        selectedDepts.push(dictionary[currentLang][key]);
                    }
                }
            });

            var finalReferral = selectedDepts.join(', ');
            var printRefer = document.getElementById('print_refer');
            if (printRefer) printRefer.value = finalReferral;
            var dashDept = document.getElementById('dash_dept_in');
            if (dashDept) dashDept.innerText = finalReferral || "-";

            var servType = isEmergencyFinal ? (dictionary[currentLang] ? dictionary[currentLang]['serv_ipd'] : 'សម្រាកពេទ្យ') :
                (dictionary[currentLang] ? dictionary[currentLang]['serv_opd'] : 'ពិគ្រោះក្រៅ');
            var dashServ = document.getElementById('dash_serv_type');
            if (dashServ) dashServ.innerText = finalReferral ? servType : "-";

            syncRightsForm();
        }

        // ==========================================
        // RIGHTS FORM SYNC
        // ==========================================
        function syncRightsForm() {
            var lastName = document.getElementById('web_last_name') ? document.getElementById('web_last_name').value : '';
            var firstName = document.getElementById('web_first_name') ? document.getElementById('web_first_name').value : '';
            var nameVal = lastName + (lastName && firstName ? ' ' : '') + firstName;
            var ageVal = document.getElementById('web_age') ? document.getElementById('web_age').value : '';
            var sexRadio = document.querySelector('input[name="sex_radio"]:checked');
            var sexText = sexRadio ? sexRadio.value : "";
            var natSelect = document.getElementById('web_nat');
            var natVal = natSelect ? natSelect.options[natSelect.selectedIndex].text : "ខ្មែរ";

            var rightsName = document.getElementById('rights_pat_name');
            if (rightsName) rightsName.value = nameVal;
            var agrName = document.getElementById('agr_pat_name');
            if (agrName) agrName.value = nameVal;
            var agrAge = document.getElementById('agr_pat_age');
            if (agrAge) agrAge.value = ageVal;
            var agrSex = document.getElementById('agr_pat_sex');
            if (agrSex) agrSex.value = sexText;
            var agrNat = document.getElementById('agr_pat_nat');
            if (agrNat) agrNat.value = natVal;

            var dateIn = document.getElementById('web_date') ? document.getElementById('web_date').value : '';
            var dashDateStr = "-";
            if (dateIn) {
                var d = dateIn.split('-');
                dashDateStr = d.length === 3 ? d[2] + '/' + d[1] + '/' + d[0] : dateIn;
            }
            var rightsDates = document.querySelectorAll('.rights_date_val');
            rightsDates.forEach(function (el) {
                el.innerText = dashDateStr;
            });

            var phone = document.getElementById('web_phone') ? document.getElementById('web_phone').value : '';
            var rightsPhone = document.getElementById('rights_phone');
            if (rightsPhone) rightsPhone.value = phone;
            var agrPhone = document.getElementById('agr_phone');
            if (agrPhone) agrPhone.value = phone;

            var dept = document.getElementById('print_refer') ? document.getElementById('print_refer').value : '';
            var rightsDept = document.getElementById('rights_dept');
            if (rightsDept) rightsDept.value = dept;

            var head = "";
            if (dept.includes("សង្គ្រោះបន្ទាន់")) head = "សឺង រិទ្ធី";
            else if (dept.includes("សម្ភព") || dept.includes("រោគស្ត្រី")) head = "បួក លីហ៊ន់";
            else if (dept.includes("ជំងឺទូទៅ") || dept.includes("ពិគ្រោះក្រៅ")) head = "អ៊ី គឹមឡេង";
            else if (dept.includes("ជំងឺកុមារ")) head = "ផេង សូភា";

            var rightsHead = document.getElementById('rights_head');
            if (rightsHead) rightsHead.value = head;
        }

        function updateInvSub() {
            var cat = document.getElementById('inv_category') ? document.getElementById('inv_category').value : '';
            var subSelect = document.getElementById('inv_sub');
            if (subSelect) {
                subSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- អនុប្រភេទ --</option>';
                if (cat && invData[cat]) {
                    invData[cat].forEach(function (sub) {
                        var opt = document.createElement('option');
                        opt.value = sub;
                        opt.innerHTML = sub;
                        subSelect.appendChild(opt);
                    });
                }
            }
        }

        function addInvestigation() {
            var cat = document.getElementById('inv_category') ? document.getElementById('inv_category').value : '';
            var sub = document.getElementById('inv_sub') ? document.getElementById('inv_sub').value : '';
            var textArea = document.getElementById('inv_list');
            if (cat && sub && textArea) {
                textArea.value += "- " + cat + " : " + sub + "\n";
                var catSelect = document.getElementById('inv_category');
                if (catSelect) catSelect.value = "";
                updateInvSub();
            }
        }

        // ==========================================
        // RX TABLE FUNCTIONS
        // ==========================================
        function addOpdRxRow(preventFocus) {
            var tbody = document.getElementById('opd_rx_tbody');
            if (!tbody) return;
            var rowCount = tbody.querySelectorAll('tr.orx-main-row').length + 1;
            var tr = document.createElement('tr');
            tr.className = 'orx-main-row';
            tr.innerHTML = getMedicationEntryRowHtml('orx', rowCount, false, true);
            tbody.appendChild(tr);
            populateMedicationRouteSelect(tr.querySelector('.orx-route'), 'po');
            var scheduleSelect = tr.querySelector('.med-schedule-type');
            if (scheduleSelect) handleMedicationScheduleChange(scheduleSelect);
            reindexOpdRxRows();
            refreshMedicationTimingLanguage();
            if (!preventFocus) {
                var nameInput = tr.querySelector('.orx-name');
                if (nameInput) nameInput.focus();
            }
        }

        function removeOpdRxRow(button) {
            var row = button && button.closest ? button.closest('.orx-main-row') : null;
            if (row) row.remove();
            var tbody = document.getElementById('opd_rx_tbody');
            if (tbody && !tbody.querySelector('.orx-main-row')) addOpdRxRow();
            reindexOpdRxRows();
        }

        function reindexOpdRxRows() {
            document.querySelectorAll('#opd_rx_tbody .orx-main-row').forEach(function (row, index) {
                var indexCell = row.querySelector('.orx-index');
                if (indexCell) indexCell.textContent = index + 1;
            });
        }

                <td><select class="rx-select ${prefix}-route"><option value="po">លេប (PO)</option></select></td>
                <td class="ipd-schedule-cell">
                    <select class="rx-select med-schedule-type" onchange="handleMedicationScheduleChange(this)">
                        <option value="">-- ជ្រើស --</option>
                        <option value="qd_m">QD ព្រឹក</option>
                        <option value="qd_a">QD ថ្ងៃ</option>
                        <option value="qd_e">QD ល្ងាច</option>
                        <option value="qd_n">QD យប់</option>
                        <option value="bid">BID</option>
                        <option value="tid">TID</option>
                        <option value="qid">QID</option>
                        <option value="qh">QNH</option>
                    </select>
                    <span class="med-qh-inline" hidden><span>q</span><input type="number" min="1" max="72" step="0.5" class="med-q-hours" value="6" oninput="handleMedicationQuickChange(this)"><span>h</span></span>
                    <button type="button" class="med-protocol-toggle" hidden onclick="toggleMedicationProtocolPanel(this)"><i class="fa-solid fa-sliders"></i> <span data-med-ui-label="open_protocol">កំណត់ពិធីសារ</span></button>
                    <small class="med-schedule-summary"></small>
                    <input type="datetime-local" class="med-effective-at" style="display:none;" onchange="handleMedicationQuickChange(this)">
                </td>
                <td><input type="number" min="0" class="rx-num-input ${prefix}-d" oninput="handleMedicationQuickChange(this)"></td>
                <td><input type="text" class="rx-num-input ${prefix}-total rx-total-view" readonly value="0"></td>
                <td><input type="text" class="rx-select ${prefix}-note" placeholder="${isMonitoring ? 'សម្គាល់...' : '...'}"></td>
                <td class="no-print"><button class="btn-red" onclick="${removeHandler}"><i class="fa-solid fa-minus"></i></button></td>
            `;
        }

        function addRxRow(preventFocus) {
            var tbody = document.getElementById('rx_tbody');
            if (!tbody) return;
            var rowCount = tbody.querySelectorAll('tr.rx-main-row').length + 1;
            var tr = document.createElement('tr');
            tr.className = 'rx-main-row';
            tr.innerHTML = getMedicationEntryRowHtml('rx', rowCount, false);
            tbody.appendChild(tr);
            populateMedicationRouteSelect(tr.querySelector('.rx-route'), 'po');
            createMedicationTimingDetailRow(tr, 'rx');
            var startInput = tr.querySelector('.med-effective-at');
            if (startInput) startInput.value = formatMedicationLocalDateTime(new Date());
            refreshMedicationTimingLanguage();
            reindexRxRows();
            syncNursingMedicationOrders();
            if (!preventFocus) {
                var nameInput = tr.querySelector('.rx-name');
                if (nameInput) nameInput.focus();
            }
        }

        function removeRxRow(btn) {
            var tr = btn.closest('tr');
            var detailRow = getMedicationTimingDetailRow(tr);
            if (detailRow) detailRow.remove();
            if (tr) tr.remove();
            reindexRxRows();
            syncNursingMedicationOrders();
        }

        function reindexRxRows() {
            var rows = document.querySelectorAll('#rx_tbody tr.rx-main-row');
            rows.forEach(function (row, index) {
                var idxEl = row.querySelector('.rx-index');
                if (idxEl) idxEl.innerText = index + 1;
            });
        }

        function calcSum(inputElem) {
            var tr = inputElem.closest('tr');
            if (!tr) return;
            handleMedicationQuickChange(inputElem);
        }

        function getCounselWordCount(value) {
            var words = String(value || '').trim().match(/\S+/g);
            return words ? words.length : 0;
        }

        function updateCounselNote() {
            var checkbox = document.getElementById('web_rx_counsel');
            var textarea = document.getElementById('web_rx_counsel_note');
            var panel = document.getElementById('rx_counsel_panel');
            var printNote = document.getElementById('rx_counsel_print');
            var counter = document.getElementById('rx_counsel_word_count');
            var printLayout = document.getElementById('print-rx-layout');
            if (!textarea) return;

            var words = String(textarea.value || '').trim().match(/\S+/g) || [];
            if (words.length > 1000) {
                textarea.value = words.slice(0, 1000).join(' ');
                words = String(textarea.value || '').trim().match(/\S+/g) || [];
            }

            var isEnabled = !!(checkbox && checkbox.checked);
            var noteText = isEnabled ? textarea.value : '';

            if (panel) panel.classList.toggle('active', isEnabled);
            if (printNote) printNote.textContent = noteText;
            if (counter) {
                counter.textContent = words.length + ' / 1000 ' + (currentLang === 'khmer' ? 'ពាក្យ' : 'words');
            }
            document.querySelectorAll('.prx-counsel-txt').forEach(function (element) {
                element.textContent = noteText;
            });
            if (printLayout) {
                printLayout.classList.toggle('has-counsel-note', isEnabled && noteText.trim() !== '');
            }
        }

        function toggleCounselNote() {
            var checkbox = document.getElementById('web_rx_counsel');
            var panel = document.getElementById('rx_counsel_panel');
            var textarea = document.getElementById('web_rx_counsel_note');
            var isEnabled = !!(checkbox && checkbox.checked);

            if (panel) panel.classList.toggle('active', isEnabled);
            updateCounselNote();
            if (isEnabled && textarea) {
                setTimeout(function () { textarea.focus(); }, 0);
            }
        }

        // ==========================================
        // MODAL FUNCTIONS
        // ==========================================
        function resetMonForm() {
            var fieldIds = [
                'mon_input_temp', 'mon_input_bp_sys', 'mon_input_bp_dia',
                'mon_input_pulse', 'mon_input_resp', 'mon_input_spo2',
                'mon_input_evol', 'mon_input_conclusion'
            ];

            fieldIds.forEach(function (id) {
                var field = document.getElementById(id);
                if (field) field.value = '';
            });

            var tbody = document.getElementById('mon_rx_tbody');
            if (tbody) {
                tbody.innerHTML = '';
                for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
                    addMonRxRow(true);
                }
            }
        }

        function evaluateMonitoringVitalStates() {
            var ageData = getExactAge();
            var fieldMap = {
                temp: 'mon_input_temp',
                pulse: 'mon_input_pulse',
                resp: 'mon_input_resp',
                spo2: 'mon_input_spo2'
            };
            Object.keys(fieldMap).forEach(function (fieldName) {
                var input = document.getElementById(fieldMap[fieldName]);
                applyVitalInputState(input, assessVitalValue(fieldName, input ? input.value : '', ageData));
            });

            var systolicInput = document.getElementById('mon_input_bp_sys');
            var diastolicInput = document.getElementById('mon_input_bp_dia');
            var assessment = assessBloodPressure(
                systolicInput ? systolicInput.value : '',
                diastolicInput ? diastolicInput.value : '',
                ageData
            );
            applyVitalInputState(systolicInput, assessment);
            applyVitalInputState(diastolicInput, assessment);
            if (systolicInput && assessment.systolicRange) systolicInput.title = (currentLang === 'khmer' ? 'កម្រិតលេខលើតាមអាយុ៖ ' : 'Age systolic range: ') + assessment.systolicRange[0] + '–' + assessment.systolicRange[1] + ' mmHg';
            if (diastolicInput && assessment.diastolicRange) diastolicInput.title = (currentLang === 'khmer' ? 'កម្រិតលេខក្រោម៖ ' : 'Diastolic range: ') + assessment.diastolicRange[0] + '–' + assessment.diastolicRange[1] + ' mmHg';
        }

        function openMonModal() {
            editingMonitoringCard = null;
            resetMonForm();

            var now = new Date();
            now.setMinutes(now.getMinutes() - now.getTimezoneOffset());
            var dateInput = document.getElementById('mon_input_date');
            if (dateInput) dateInput.value = now.toISOString().slice(0, 16);
            document.querySelectorAll('#mon_rx_tbody .med-effective-at').forEach(function (input) {
                input.value = dateInput ? dateInput.value : '';
            });

            var modal = document.getElementById('mon_modal');
            if (modal) modal.classList.add('active');
            evaluateMonitoringVitalStates();
        }

        function closeMonModal() {
            var modal = document.getElementById('mon_modal');
            if (modal) modal.classList.remove('active');
            editingMonitoringCard = null;
        }

        function copyMonitoringRecord(button) {
            var card = button ? button.closest('.ipd-mon-card') : null;
            var data = card ? card._monitoringCopyData : null;
            if (!data) return;

            openMonModal();
            populateMonitoringTreatmentForm(data);
            var copiedStart = document.getElementById('mon_input_date');
            document.querySelectorAll('#mon_rx_tbody .med-effective-at').forEach(function (input) {
                input.value = copiedStart ? copiedStart.value : '';
            });
            evaluateMonitoringVitalStates();
        }

        function populateMonitoringTreatmentForm(data) {
            var evolField = document.getElementById('mon_input_evol');
            if (evolField) evolField.value = data.evol || '';
            var conclusionField = document.getElementById('mon_input_conclusion');
            if (conclusionField) conclusionField.value = data.conclusion || '';

            var tbody = document.getElementById('mon_rx_tbody');
            if (!tbody) return;
            tbody.innerHTML = '';

            if (data.medications && data.medications.length > 0) {
                data.medications.forEach(function (med) {
                    addMonRxRow();
                    var rows = tbody.querySelectorAll('tr.mrx-main-row');
                    var row = rows.length ? rows[rows.length - 1] : null;
                    if (!row) return;

                    var nameField = row.querySelector('.mrx-name');
                    if (nameField) nameField.value = med.name || '';
                    var routeField = row.querySelector('.mrx-route');
                    if (routeField) populateMedicationRouteSelect(routeField, med.route || 'po');
                    var doseField = row.querySelector('.mrx-dose');
                    var restoredDose = med.doseAmount || [med.m, med.a, med.e, med.n].find(function (value) {
                        return parseFloat(value) > 0;
                    }) || '';
                    if (doseField) doseField.value = restoredDose;
                    var daysField = row.querySelector('.mrx-d');
                    if (daysField) daysField.value = med.d || '';
                    var unitField = row.querySelector('.mrx-unit');
                    if (unitField) unitField.value = med.unit || 'គ្រាប់';
                    var noteField = row.querySelector('.mrx-note');
                    if (noteField) noteField.value = med.note || '';
                    var legacyFrequency = [med.m, med.a, med.e, med.n].reduce(function (total, value) {
                        return total + (parseFloat(value) > 0 ? 1 : 0);
                    }, 0);
                    var scheduleType = med.timingMode === 'protocol'
                        ? 'protocol'
                        : (med.scheduleType || ({ 2: 'bid', 3: 'tid', 4: 'qid' }[legacyFrequency] || (legacyFrequency === 1 ? 'qh' : '')));
                    var scheduleField = row.querySelector('.med-schedule-type');
                    if (scheduleField) scheduleField.value = scheduleType;
                    var qHoursField = row.querySelector('.med-q-hours');
                    if (qHoursField) qHoursField.value = med.qHours || (legacyFrequency === 1 ? '24' : '6');
                    var effectiveAt = row.querySelector('.med-effective-at');
                    if (effectiveAt) effectiveAt.value = med.effectiveAt || data.dtVal || '';
                    var detailRow = getMedicationTimingDetailRow(row);
                    if (detailRow) {
                        var protocolDose = detailRow.querySelector('.med-protocol-dose');
                        if (protocolDose) protocolDose.value = med.protocolDose || '';
                        populateMedicationProtocolIntervals(detailRow, med.protocolIntervals || '');
                        var repeatValue = detailRow.querySelector('.med-protocol-repeat-value');
                        if (repeatValue) repeatValue.value = med.protocolRepeatValue || '';
                        var repeatUnit = detailRow.querySelector('.med-protocol-repeat-unit');
                        if (repeatUnit) repeatUnit.value = med.protocolRepeatUnit || 'hours';
                        var maxDoses = detailRow.querySelector('.med-protocol-max-doses');
                        if (maxDoses) maxDoses.value = med.protocolMaxDoses || '';
                        var stopAt = detailRow.querySelector('.med-protocol-stop-at');
                        if (stopAt) stopAt.value = med.protocolStopAt || '';
                    }
                    if (scheduleField) handleMedicationScheduleChange(scheduleField);
                    var totalField = row.querySelector('.mrx-total');
                    if (totalField && normalizeNursingCellText(med.total)) totalField.value = med.total;
                });
            } else {
                for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
                    addMonRxRow(true);
                }
            }
        }

        function editMonitoringRecord(button) {
            var card = button ? button.closest('.ipd-mon-card') : null;
            var data = card ? card._monitoringCopyData : null;
            if (!card || !data) return;

            openMonModal();
            editingMonitoringCard = card;

            var fieldValues = {
                mon_input_date: data.dtVal || '',
                mon_input_temp: data.temp || '',
                mon_input_bp_sys: data.bp_sys || '',
                mon_input_bp_dia: data.bp_dia || '',
                mon_input_pulse: data.pulse || '',
                mon_input_resp: data.resp || '',
                mon_input_spo2: data.spo2 || ''
            };

            Object.keys(fieldValues).forEach(function (id) {
                var field = document.getElementById(id);
                if (field) field.value = fieldValues[id];
            });

            populateMonitoringTreatmentForm(data);
            evaluateMonitoringVitalStates();
        }

        function deleteMonitoringRecord(button) {
            var card = button ? button.closest('.ipd-mon-card') : null;
            if (!card) return;
            var confirmed = confirm(currentLang === 'khmer' ? 'តើអ្នកពិតជាចង់លុបទិន្នន័យនេះមែនទេ?' : 'Are you sure you want to delete this record?');
            if (!confirmed) return;
            card.remove();
            scheduleNursingChartRender();
        }

        function addMonRxRow(preventFocus) {
            var tbody = document.getElementById('mon_rx_tbody');
            if (!tbody) return;
            var rowCount = tbody.querySelectorAll('tr.mrx-main-row').length + 1;
            var tr = document.createElement('tr');
            tr.className = 'mrx-main-row';
            tr.innerHTML = getMedicationEntryRowHtml('mrx', rowCount, true);
            tbody.appendChild(tr);
            populateMedicationRouteSelect(tr.querySelector('.mrx-route'), 'po');
            createMedicationTimingDetailRow(tr, 'mrx');
            var monitoringDate = document.getElementById('mon_input_date');
            var startInput = tr.querySelector('.med-effective-at');
            if (startInput && monitoringDate) startInput.value = monitoringDate.value;
            refreshMedicationTimingLanguage();
            reindexMonRxRows();
            if (!preventFocus) {
                var nameInput = tr.querySelector('.mrx-name');
                if (nameInput) nameInput.focus();
            }
        }

        function removeMonRxRow(btn) {
            var tr = btn.closest('tr');
            var detailRow = getMedicationTimingDetailRow(tr);
            if (detailRow) detailRow.remove();
            if (tr) tr.remove();
            reindexMonRxRows();
        }

        function reindexMonRxRows() {
            var rows = document.querySelectorAll('#mon_rx_tbody tr.mrx-main-row');
            rows.forEach(function (row, index) {
                var idxEl = row.querySelector('.mrx-index');
                if (idxEl) idxEl.innerText = index + 1;
            });
        }

        function calcMonSum(inputElem) {
            var tr = inputElem.closest('tr');
            if (!tr) return;
            handleMedicationQuickChange(inputElem);
        }

        function saveDailyMonitoring() {
            var dtVal = document.getElementById('mon_input_date') ? document.getElementById('mon_input_date').value : '2026-08-29 21:24';
            var temp = document.getElementById('mon_input_temp') ? document.getElementById('mon_input_temp').value : '-';
            var bp_sys = document.getElementById('mon_input_bp_sys') ? document.getElementById('mon_input_bp_sys').value : '-';
            var bp_dia = document.getElementById('mon_input_bp_dia') ? document.getElementById('mon_input_bp_dia').value : '-';
            var pulse = document.getElementById('mon_input_pulse') ? document.getElementById('mon_input_pulse').value : '-';
            var resp = document.getElementById('mon_input_resp') ? document.getElementById('mon_input_resp').value : '-';
            var spo2 = document.getElementById('mon_input_spo2') ? document.getElementById('mon_input_spo2').value : '-';
            var evol = document.getElementById('mon_input_evol') ? document.getElementById('mon_input_evol').value : '-';
            var conclusion = document.getElementById('mon_input_conclusion') ? document.getElementById('mon_input_conclusion').value : '-';

            var dateDisplay = dtVal ? dtVal.replace('T', ' ') : '29-08-2026 21:24';

            var rxHtml = '';
            var medications = [];
            var monRows = document.querySelectorAll('#mon_rx_tbody tr.mrx-main-row, #mon_rx_protocol_tbody tr.protocol-main-row');
            monRows.forEach(function (row) {
                var prefix = row.classList.contains('protocol-main-row') ? 'mprx' : 'mrx';

                var nameEl = row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-name');
                if (!nameEl) return;
                var name = nameEl.value;
                if (name && name.trim() !== '') {
                    var routeEl = row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-route');
                    var route = routeEl ? normalizeMedicationRoute(routeEl.value) : 'po';
                    var m = row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-m') ? row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-m').value || '0' : '0';
                    var a = row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-a') ? row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-a').value || '0' : '0';
                    var e = row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-e') ? row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-e').value || '0' : '0';
                    var n = row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-n') ? row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-n').value || '0' : '0';
                    var d = row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-d') ? row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-d').value || '1' : '1';
                    var total = row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-total') ? row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-total').value || '0' : '0';
                    var unitEl = row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-unit');
                    var unit = unitEl ? unitEl.options[unitEl.selectedIndex].value : 'គ្រាប់';
                    var note = row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-note') ? row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-note').value || '' : '';

                    var timing = getMedicationTimingData(row, dtVal);
                    var medication = Object.assign({
                        name: name, route: route, m: m, a: a, e: e, n: n,
                        d: d, total: total, unit: unit, note: note
                    }, timing);
                    medications.push(medication);

                    var freqArr = [];
                    if (parseFloat(m) > 0) freqArr.push('ព្រឹក' + m);
                    if (parseFloat(a) > 0) freqArr.push('រសៀល' + a);
                    if (parseFloat(e) > 0) freqArr.push('ល្ងាច' + e);
                    if (parseFloat(n) > 0) freqArr.push('យប់' + n);

                    var timingDescription = timing.timingMode === 'protocol'
                        ? buildMedicationTimingInstruction(medication, currentLang)
                        : buildNursingMedicationDose(medication);
                    rxHtml += `
                        <div class="ipd-rx-item">
                            <div class="ipd-rx-name">${name}</div>
                            <div class="ipd-rx-desc">${getMedicationRouteLabel(route)} • ${timingDescription}<br><strong>${currentLang === 'khmer' ? 'ចំនួនថ្នាំ៖' : 'Quantity:'} ${total} ${unit}</strong></div>
                        </div>
                    `;
                }
            });

            if (!rxHtml) {
                rxHtml = '<div style="color:#94a3b8; font-style:italic;">គ្មានវេជ្ជបញ្ជាបន្ថែម</div>';
            }

            var recordAge = getExactAge();
            var recordAssessments = {
                temp: assessVitalValue('temp', temp, recordAge),
                bp: assessBloodPressure(bp_sys, bp_dia, recordAge),
                pulse: assessVitalValue('pulse', pulse, recordAge),
                resp: assessVitalValue('resp', resp, recordAge),
                spo2: assessVitalValue('spo2', spo2, recordAge)
            };
            var recordVitalClass = function (assessment) {
                if (!assessment || (!assessment.hasValue && !assessment.complete)) return '';
                return assessment.abnormal ? ' vital-abnormal' : ' vital-normal';
            };

            var card = document.createElement('div');
            card.className = 'ipd-mon-card';
            var headName = document.getElementById('rights_head');
            var headVal = headName ? headName.value : 'គ្រូពេទ្យព្យាបាល';
            card.innerHTML = `
                <div class="ipd-mon-header">
                    <div style="display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center;">
                        <input type="checkbox" checked style="accent-color: #00BFFF; transform: scale(1.1);">
                        <span class="ipd-date-pill"><i class="fa-regular fa-clock"></i> ${dateDisplay} <button type="button" class="no-print" title="បោះពុម្ពកំណត់ត្រាថ្ងៃនេះ" aria-label="បោះពុម្ពកំណត់ត្រាថ្ងៃនេះ" onclick="printMonitoringRecord(this)" style="background: transparent; border: none; color: #0284c7; cursor: pointer; margin-left: 4px; padding: 0;"><i class="fa-solid fa-print"></i></button></span>
                    </div>
                    <div style="color: #64748b; font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;">
                        <span>${dateDisplay} - ${headVal}</span>
                        <button type="button" class="no-print" title="ចម្លងកំណត់ត្រានេះ" aria-label="ចម្លងកំណត់ត្រានេះ" onclick="copyMonitoringRecord(this)" style="background: transparent; border: none; color: #0284c7; cursor: pointer; padding: 2px 4px; font-size: 14px;"><i class="fa-regular fa-copy"></i></button>
                        <button type="button" class="no-print" title="កែសម្រួលកំណត់ត្រានេះ" aria-label="កែសម្រួលកំណត់ត្រានេះ" onclick="editMonitoringRecord(this)" style="background: transparent; border: none; color: #0088CC; cursor: pointer; padding: 2px 4px; font-size: 14px;"><i class="fa-regular fa-pen-to-square"></i></button>
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-chevron-up" style="cursor: pointer;" title="${currentLang === 'khmer' ? 'បង្ហាញ ឬលាក់ព័ត៌មានលម្អិត' : 'Show or hide details'}" onclick="this.closest('.ipd-mon-card').querySelector('.ipd-body-grid').classList.toggle('no-print');"></i>
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-trash" style="cursor: pointer; color: #ef4444; margin-left: 8px;" title="${currentLang === 'khmer' ? 'លុបកំណត់ត្រានេះ' : 'Delete this record'}" onclick="deleteMonitoringRecord(this)"></i>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div style="color: #00BFFF; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;">
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-chart-line"></i> ${currentLang === 'khmer' ? 'សញ្ញាជីវិត' : 'Vital Signs'}
                </div>

                <div class="ipd-vitals-row">
                    <div class="ipd-vital-box">
                        <div class="v-title"><i class="fa-solid fa-temperature-half"></i> សីតុណ្ហភាព</div>
                        <div class="v-val${recordVitalClass(recordAssessments.temp)}">${temp} °C</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="ipd-vital-box">
                        <div class="v-title"><i class="fa-solid fa-heart-pulse"></i> សម្ពាធឈាម</div>
                        <div class="v-val${recordVitalClass(recordAssessments.bp)}">${bp_sys}/${bp_dia} <span style="font-size: 10px; font-weight: normal;">mmHg</span></div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="ipd-vital-box">
                        <div class="v-title"><i class="fa-solid fa-heart"></i> ចង្វាក់បេះដូង</div>
                        <div class="v-val${recordVitalClass(recordAssessments.pulse)}">${pulse} <span style="font-size: 10px; font-weight: normal;">BPM</span></div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="ipd-vital-box">
                        <div class="v-title"><i class="fa-solid fa-lungs"></i> ចង្វាក់ដង្ហើម</div>
                        <div class="v-val${recordVitalClass(recordAssessments.resp)}">${resp} <span style="font-size: 10px; font-weight: normal;">/min</span></div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="ipd-vital-box">
                        <div class="v-title"><i class="fa-solid fa-vial"></i> កំហាប់អុកស៊ីសែនក្នុងឈាម</div>
                        <div class="v-val${recordVitalClass(recordAssessments.spo2)}">${spo2} %</div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="ipd-body-grid">
                    <div>
                        <div class="ipd-side-sec">
                            <div class="ipd-side-title"><i class="fa-regular fa-file-lines"></i> ការវិវត្តន៍</div>
                            <div style="color: #0284c7; line-height: 1.6; font-size: 12px; white-space: pre-line;">${evol}</div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="ipd-side-sec conclusion">
                            <div class="ipd-side-title c-title"><i class="fa-regular fa-clipboard"></i> សេចក្តីសន្និដ្ឋាន</div>
                            <div style="color: #ea580c; font-weight: bold; font-size: 13px;">${conclusion}</div>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                        <div style="font-weight: bold; color: #334155; margin-bottom: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;">
                            <i class="fa-solid fa-capsules"></i> វេជ្ជបញ្ជា
                        </div>
                        ${rxHtml}
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
            card._monitoringCopyData = {
                dtVal: dtVal,
                temp: temp,
                bp_sys: bp_sys,
                bp_dia: bp_dia,
                pulse: pulse,
                resp: resp,
                spo2: spo2,
                evol: evol,
                conclusion: conclusion,
                medications: medications
            };

            var feed = document.getElementById('daily_monitoring_feed');
            if (editingMonitoringCard && editingMonitoringCard.parentNode) {
                editingMonitoringCard.parentNode.replaceChild(card, editingMonitoringCard);
            } else if (feed) {
                feed.prepend(card);
            }
            closeMonModal();
            scheduleNursingChartRender();
        }

        function escapeMonitoringPrint(value) {
            var textValue = value === null || value === undefined ? '' : String(value);
            return textValue.replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (char) {
                return {
                    '&': '&amp;',
                    '<': '&lt;',
                    '>': '&gt;',
                    '"': '&quot;',
                    "'": '&#39;'
                }[char];
            });
        }

        function formatMonitoringPrintDate(dtVal) {
            var dateText = '';
            var timeText = '';
            if (dtVal) {
                var parts = String(dtVal).split('T');
                var dateParts = parts[0] ? parts[0].split('-') : [];
                dateText = dateParts.length === 3 ? dateParts[2] + '/' + dateParts[1] + '/' + dateParts[0] : (parts[0] || '');
                timeText = parts[1] || '';
            }
            return { date: dateText, time: timeText };
        }

        function buildMonitoringTreatmentPrint(medications) {
            if (!medications || medications.length === 0) {
                return '<div>' + (currentLang === 'khmer' ? 'គ្មានវេជ្ជបញ្ជាបន្ថែម' : 'No additional prescription') + '</div>';
            }

            return medications.map(function (med) {
                var timingInstruction = med.timingMode === 'protocol'
                    ? buildMedicationTimingInstruction(med, currentLang)
                    : buildNursingMedicationDose(med);
                var instruction = [
                    escapeMonitoringPrint(getMedicationRouteLabel(med.route || 'po')),
                    escapeMonitoringPrint(timingInstruction)
                ].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');

                var noteHtml = med.note ? '<div>' + escapeMonitoringPrint(med.note) + '</div>' : '';
                return `
                    <div class="mon-print-med">
                        <div class="mon-print-med-name">${escapeMonitoringPrint(med.name || '')}</div>
                        <div>${instruction}</div>
                        <div>${currentLang === 'khmer' ? 'ចំនួន៖' : 'Quantity:'} ${escapeMonitoringPrint(med.total || '0')} ${escapeMonitoringPrint(med.unit || '')}</div>
                        ${noteHtml}
                    </div>
                `;
            }).join('');
        }

        function buildMonitoringPrintRow(data) {
            var printedDate = formatMonitoringPrintDate(data.dtVal);
            var khmer = currentLang === 'khmer';
            return `
                <tr class="mon-print-day">
                    <td class="mon-print-vitals">
                        <div><strong>${khmer ? 'កាលបរិច្ឆេទ៖' : 'Date:'}</strong> ${escapeMonitoringPrint(printedDate.date)}</div>
                        <div><strong>${khmer ? 'ម៉ោង៖' : 'Time:'}</strong> ${escapeMonitoringPrint(printedDate.time)}</div>
                        <div><strong>BP:</strong> ${escapeMonitoringPrint(data.bp_sys || '')}/${escapeMonitoringPrint(data.bp_dia || '')} mmHg</div>
                        <div><strong>HR:</strong> ${escapeMonitoringPrint(data.pulse || '')} BPM</div>
                        <div><strong>T:</strong> ${escapeMonitoringPrint(data.temp || '')} °C</div>
                        <div><strong>RR:</strong> ${escapeMonitoringPrint(data.resp || '')} /min</div>
                        <div><strong>O2 Sat:</strong> ${escapeMonitoringPrint(data.spo2 || '')} %</div>
                    </td>
                    <td class="mon-print-evolution">
                        <div>${escapeMonitoringPrint(data.evol || '')}</div>
                        <div class="mon-print-conclusion-title">${khmer ? 'រោគវិនិច្ឆ័យ' : 'Diagnosis'}</div>
                        <div>${escapeMonitoringPrint(data.conclusion || '')}</div>
                    </td>
                    <td class="mon-print-treatment">${buildMonitoringTreatmentPrint(data.medications)}</td>
                </tr>
            `;
        }

        function printMonitoringRecords(records) {
            if (!records || records.length === 0) {
                alert(currentLang === 'khmer' ? 'មិនទាន់មានកំណត់ត្រាតាមដានសម្រាប់បោះពុម្ពទេ។' : 'There are no daily monitoring records to print.');
                return;
            }

            var layout = document.getElementById('monitoring-print-layout');
            if (!layout) return;

            var patientName = document.getElementById('dash_name') ? document.getElementById('dash_name').innerText : '';
            var patientAge = document.getElementById('dash_age') ? document.getElementById('dash_age').innerText : '';
            var patientSex = document.getElementById('dash_sex') ? document.getElementById('dash_sex').innerText : '';

            var rowsHtml = records.map(function (record) {
                return buildMonitoringPrintRow(record);
            }).join('');
            var khmer = currentLang === 'khmer';

            layout.innerHTML = `
                <div class="mon-print-sheet">
                    <div class="mon-print-title">${khmer ? 'ការពិនិត្យតាមដាន និងការព្យាបាលប្រចាំថ្ងៃ' : 'Daily Monitoring and Treatment'}</div>
                    <div class="mon-print-patient">
                        <div><strong>${khmer ? 'ឈ្មោះ៖' : 'Name:'}</strong> ${escapeMonitoringPrint(patientName)}</div>
                        <div><strong>${khmer ? 'អាយុ៖' : 'Age:'}</strong> ${escapeMonitoringPrint(patientAge)}</div>
                        <div><strong>${khmer ? 'ភេទ៖' : 'Sex:'}</strong> ${escapeMonitoringPrint(patientSex)}</div>
                    </div>
                    <table class="mon-print-table">
                        <colgroup>
                            <col style="width: 25%;">
                            <col style="width: 35%;">
                            <col style="width: 40%;">
                        </colgroup>
                        <thead>
                            <tr>
                                <th class="mon-print-vitals">${khmer ? 'សញ្ញាជីវិត' : 'Vital Signs'}</th>
                                <th class="mon-print-evolution">${khmer ? 'ការវិវត្តន៍' : 'Evolution'}</th>
                                <th class="mon-print-treatment">${khmer ? 'ការព្យាបាល' : 'Treatment'}</th>
                            </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody>${rowsHtml}</tbody>
                    </table>
                </div>
            `;

            document.body.classList.add('print-monitoring');
            window.print();
            setTimeout(function () {
                document.body.classList.remove('print-monitoring');
            }, 500);
        }

        function printMonitoringRecord(button) {
            var card = button ? button.closest('.ipd-mon-card') : null;
            var data = card ? card._monitoringCopyData : null;
            if (data) printMonitoringRecords([data]);
        }

        function printAllMonitoringRecords() {
            var feed = document.getElementById('daily_monitoring_feed');
            if (!feed) return;
            var cards = Array.prototype.slice.call(feed.querySelectorAll('.ipd-mon-card'));
            var records = cards.map(function (card) {
                return card._monitoringCopyData;
            }).filter(function (data) {
                return !!data;
            }).reverse();
            printMonitoringRecords(records);
        }

        // ==========================================
        // PRINT FUNCTIONS
        // ==========================================
        function populateRxPrintData(sourceMode) {
            var hid = document.getElementById('web_health_id') ? document.getElementById('web_health_id').value : '';
            var nssf = document.getElementById('web_nssf') ? document.getElementById('web_nssf').value : '';
            var lastName = document.getElementById('web_last_name') ? document.getElementById('web_last_name').value : '';
            var firstName = document.getElementById('web_first_name') ? document.getElementById('web_first_name').value : '';
            var nameVal = lastName + (lastName && firstName ? ' ' : '') + firstName;
            var age = document.getElementById('web_age') ? document.getElementById('web_age').value : '';

            var sexRadio = document.querySelector('input[name="sex_radio"]:checked');
            var sexText = sexRadio ? sexRadio.value : "";

            var natSelect = document.getElementById('web_nat');
            var natVal = natSelect ? natSelect.options[natSelect.selectedIndex].text : "ខ្មែរ";

            var phone = document.getElementById('web_phone') ? document.getElementById('web_phone').value : '';
            var addr = document.getElementById('dash_addr') ? document.getElementById('dash_addr').innerText : '';
            var diagIn = document.getElementById('web_diag_in') ? document.getElementById('web_diag_in').value : '';
            var diagOut = document.getElementById('diag_input') ? document.getElementById('diag_input').value : '';
            var dateIn = document.getElementById('dash_date_in') ? document.getElementById('dash_date_in').innerText : '';
            var caseNo = document.getElementById('web_adm_no') ? document.getElementById('web_adm_no').value : '';

            var dobInput = document.getElementById('web_dob') ? document.getElementById('web_dob').value : '';
            var dobPrintStr = "";
            if (dobInput) {
                var d = dobInput.split('-');
                dobPrintStr = d.length === 3 ? d[2] + '/' + d[1] + '/' + d[0] : dobInput;
            }

            var followUpInput = document.getElementById('web_opd_followup') ? document.getElementById('web_opd_followup').value : '';
            var followUpStr = "";
            if (followUpInput) {
                var f = followUpInput.split('-');
                followUpStr = f.length === 3 ? f[2] + '/' + f[1] + '/' + f[0] : followUpInput;
            }

            updateCounselNote();
            var counselChecked = document.getElementById('web_rx_counsel') ? document.getElementById('web_rx_counsel').checked : false;
            var counselNoteInput = document.getElementById('web_rx_counsel_note');
            var counselText = counselChecked && counselNoteInput ? counselNoteInput.value : "";

            var today = new Date();
            var dd = String(today.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
            var mm = String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
            var yyyy = today.getFullYear();

            [1, 2].forEach(function (num) {
                var idHid = document.getElementById('prx_hid_' + num);
                if (idHid) idHid.innerText = hid;
                var idNssf = document.getElementById('prx_nssf_' + num);
                if (idNssf) idNssf.innerText = nssf;
                var idName = document.getElementById('prx_name_' + num);
                if (idName) idName.innerText = nameVal;
                var idDob = document.getElementById('prx_dob_' + num);
                if (idDob) idDob.innerText = dobPrintStr;
                var idAge = document.getElementById('prx_age_' + num);
                if (idAge) idAge.innerText = age;
                var idSex = document.getElementById('prx_sex_' + num);
                if (idSex) idSex.innerText = sexText;
                var idNat = document.getElementById('prx_nat_' + num);
                if (idNat) idNat.innerText = natVal;
                var idPhone = document.getElementById('prx_phone_' + num);
                if (idPhone) idPhone.innerText = phone;
                var idAddr = document.getElementById('prx_addr_' + num);
                if (idAddr) idAddr.innerText = addr;
                var idDiagIn = document.getElementById('prx_diag_in_' + num);
                if (idDiagIn) idDiagIn.innerText = diagIn;
                var idDiagOut = document.getElementById('prx_diag_out_' + num);
                if (idDiagOut) idDiagOut.innerText = diagOut;
                var idDate = document.getElementById('prx_date_' + num);
                if (idDate) idDate.innerText = dateIn;
                var idCase = document.getElementById('prx_case_' + num);
                if (idCase) idCase.innerText = caseNo;
                var idCounsel = document.getElementById('prx_counsel_' + num);
                if (idCounsel) idCounsel.textContent = counselText;
                var idFollow = document.getElementById('prx_follow_' + num);
                if (idFollow) idFollow.innerText = followUpStr;
            });

            var todayD = document.querySelectorAll('.prx_today_d');
            todayD.forEach(function (el) { el.innerText = dd; });
            var todayM = document.querySelectorAll('.prx_today_m');
            todayM.forEach(function (el) { el.innerText = mm; });
            var todayY = document.querySelectorAll('.prx_today_y');
            todayY.forEach(function (el) { el.innerText = yyyy; });

            var isOpdPrescription = sourceMode === 'opd';
            var uiRows = document.querySelectorAll(isOpdPrescription ? '#opd_rx_tbody tr.orx-main-row' : '#rx_tbody tr.rx-main-row');
            var tableRowsHTML = "";

            uiRows.forEach(function (row) {
                var prefix = getMedicationRowPrefix(row);
                var nameEl = row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-name');
                var name = nameEl ? normalizeNursingCellText(nameEl.value) : '';
                if (!name) return;

                var idxEl = row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-index');
                var index = idxEl ? idxEl.textContent : '';
                var routeEl = row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-route');
                var route = routeEl ? getMedicationRouteLabel(routeEl.value) : '';
                var m = row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-m') ? row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-m').value || '0' : '0';
                var a = row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-a') ? row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-a').value || '0' : '0';
                var e = row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-e') ? row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-e').value || '0' : '0';
                var n = row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-n') ? row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-n').value || '0' : '0';
                var d = row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-d') ? row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-d').value || '0' : '0';
                var total = row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-total') ? row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-total').value || '0' : '0';
                var unitEl = row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-unit');
                var unit = unitEl ? unitEl.options[unitEl.selectedIndex].text : '';
                var note = row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-note') ? row.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-note').value || '' : '';

                var schedType = getMedicationScheduleType(row);
                if (schedType === 'qh') {
                    var qh = row.querySelector('.med-q-hours');
                    var hr = qh ? qh.value : '6';
                    m = '—'; a = '—'; e = '—'; n = '—';
                    var qhStr = currentLang === 'khmer' ? "លេបរៀងរាល់ " + hr + " ម៉ោងម្ដង" : "Take every " + hr + " hours";
                    note = qhStr + (note ? " • " + note : "");
                } else if (schedType === 'protocol') {
                    m = '—'; a = '—'; e = '—'; n = '—';
                    var timing = getMedicationTimingData(row, '');
                    var timingInstruction = buildMedicationTimingInstruction(Object.assign({
                        name: name, route: routeEl ? routeEl.value : '', m: m, a: a, e: e, n: n, d: d,
                        unit: unit, doseAmount: getMedicationDoseAmount(row)
                    }, timing), currentLang);
                    note = [timingInstruction, note].filter(Boolean).join(' • ');
                } else {
                    if (m === '0') m = '—';
                    if (a === '0') a = '—';
                    if (e === '0') e = '—';
                    if (n === '0') n = '—';
                }

                if (!isOpdPrescription) {
                    var timing = getMedicationTimingData(row, '');
                    if (timing.effectiveAt && schedType !== 'qh' && schedType !== 'protocol') {
                        note = [(currentLang === 'khmer' ? 'ចាប់ផ្តើម៖ ' : 'Start: ') + timing.effectiveAt.replace('T', ' '), note].filter(Boolean).join(' • ');
                    }
                }

                tableRowsHTML += `
                    <tr>
                        <td>${escapeMonitoringPrint(index)}</td>
                        <td style="text-align:left;">${escapeMonitoringPrint(name)}</td>
                        <td>${escapeMonitoringPrint(route || '—')}</td>
                        <td>${escapeMonitoringPrint(m)}</td>
                        <td>${escapeMonitoringPrint(a)}</td>
                        <td>${escapeMonitoringPrint(e)}</td>
                        <td>${escapeMonitoringPrint(n)}</td>
                        <td>${escapeMonitoringPrint(d)}</td>
                        <td>${escapeMonitoringPrint(total + (unit ? ' ' + unit : ''))}</td>
                        <td>${escapeMonitoringPrint(note)}</td>
                    </tr>
                `;
            });

            var table1 = document.querySelector('#prx_table_1 tbody');
            if (table1) table1.innerHTML = tableRowsHTML;
            var table2 = document.querySelector('#prx_table_2 tbody');
            if (table2) table2.innerHTML = tableRowsHTML;
        }
